31589.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to implement EU Directive 2008/50/EC on air quality, including new rules allowing postponement and exemption from certain limit values for nitrogen dioxide and PM10 via general administrative orders. It also redefines air quality assessment terms, PM2.5 targets, and removes or narrows several planning and permit cross-references.
31589.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order approach by the need for flexibility and speed in implementation and to avoid a year or more of delay for national projects.
q: For sufficient flexibility and speed in the implementation process, the framework for postponement and exemption is set in the law, with further detail within that framework by general administrative order.

Omwille van voldoende flexibiliteit en snelheid in het implementatieproces wordt uitgegaan van het vastleggen van de kaders voor het uitstel en de vrijstelling in de wet met een nadere invulling, binnen dat wettelijke kader, bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: zones and agglomerations and deadlines for NO2 postponement
implementation of national air quality programme measures
rules and responsible authorities for measures against richtwaarden
rules on frequency and method of air quality assessment
minister establishes lists of zones and agglomerations
zones and deadlines for PM10 exemption
p: The minister is made primarily responsible for taking measures to meet the PM2.5 exposure obligation, which is excluded from case-by-case judicial and permitting review.

Limits the list of decisions subject to air quality testing and removes the ability to test certain plans and decisions against air quality norms, narrowing judicial and citizen review of administrative decisions affecting air quality."}],

parties: Asks how the Council of State's differing interpretation of the directive arises and whether the Chamber can pronounce on the AMvB's defining derogation zones; wants PM2.5 norms only once enforceable.
These members expect that the Chamber can express its judgment on these AMvBs.
Deze leden rekenen erop dat de Kamer haar oordeel over deze amvb's kan uitspreken.
Questions the government's fatalism if the Commission refuses derogation and asks who is responsible for protecting health and environment; also questions reliance on NSL measures for PM2.5.
Who is then responsible for protecting public health and the environment?
Wie is dan verantwoordelijk voor het beschermen van de volksgezondheid en het milieu?
Prefers full decoupling of project decisions from air quality limits to avoid delays, while asking what remedies (objection and appeal) exist against NSL-based measures and projects.
That does not alter that the VVD members continue to prefer a full decoupling of decisions from the limit values.
Dit neemt niet weg dat de leden van de VVD-fractie blijvend de voorkeur geven aan een volledige ontkoppeling van besluiten en de grenswaarden.
Asks about criteria for disproportionate costs and sufficient spatial spread, and whether NSL and the niet-in-betekenende-mate threshold are adjusted if targets fail.
Is there a (European) framework for determining whether measures can be labelled as disproportionate?
Is er een (Europees) kader voor het bepalen of maatregelen kunnen worden bestempeld als buitensporig?
Asks when PM2.5 concentration picture will be accurate enough and for which year the evaluation of national measures is planned.
The SGP members ask when the picture of PM2.5 concentrations is expected to be sufficiently accurate.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af wanneer het beeld van de PM 2,5 -concentraties naar verwachting voldoende nauwkeurig zal zijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Environmental Management Act to implement the new EU air quality directive, raising objections on derogation (phased grenswaarden), the scope of subtraction of natural sources, and entry into force for PM2.5. The government's nader rapport rejected most objections on derogation and natural sources, but followed the advice on entry into force for PM2.5 and made several drafting clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the derogation period should include a stepwise decline of the limit values to ensure compliance by the final date, which the government rejected as going beyond the directive.

The Afdeling argued that the maximum exceedance margin in the directive should be read against the 2010 margin, leading to a zero margin; the government rejected this reading as absurd and contrary to the directive's intent.

The Afdeling argued that subtraction of natural source contributions should be limited to exceedances fully attributable to natural sources and to limit values and plan thresholds; the government rejected this restrictive reading as contrary to recital 15 and the directive's purpose.
The Afdeling advised that provisions on PM2.5 should enter into force by the directive's two-year deadline, which the government followed while postponing application of the PM2.5 limit to 2015.
The Afdeling raised drafting points on the scope of article 5.16 and related provisions, which the government largely accommodated through clarifications and technical amendments.

31700-IXA.s: The bill establishes the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the National Debt (IXA), setting figures for debt financing and cash management in thousands of euros. It also sets the entry-into-force rule, making the law effective from 1 January of the budget year.
q: The budget statement for the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2009 belonging to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31769.s: The bill amends the Civil Code and several special statutes to set decision deadlines in line with the Wet dwangsom en beroep bij niet tijdig beslissen, which takes effect in 2009. It sets specific deadlines (twenty weeks, eight weeks, thirty months, thirteen weeks) for ministerial decisions on notifications, certificates of conduct, foreign adoption consent, private security licences and firearms exemptions.
q: So it is that We, having heard the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have deemed and understood as We hereby deem and understand
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Accepts a longer name-change deadline for careful investigation but insists speed must not come at the expense of care, and questions the length of the adoption waiting periods.
Moreover, in the view of these members, speed in changing a surname must not come at the expense of care.
Dit te meer daar, naar de mening van deze leden, snelheid bij het veranderen van een geslachtsnaam niet ten koste mag gaan van de zorgvuldigheid.

Objects that extending deadlines in a bill meant to enforce deadlines needs strong justification, and asks whether the Raad van State's advice to exclude adoption consent from the penalty regime was adequately answered.
Thirty months is an exceptionally long period that requires explicit justification.
Dertig maanden is een bijzonder lange periode die expliciete rechtvaardiging vereist.

Supports the aim of the penalty regime but asks critical questions about the extended deadlines, including the adoption period in light of the Kalsbeek commission report and the sunset of the VOG exemption.
These members ask the government to elaborate on this decision deadline in light of the Kalsbeek Commission report.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan op deze beslistermijn in het licht van het rapport van de Commissie Kalsbeek.
Regrets the need to lengthen deadlines, arguing the adoption extension conflicts with earlier Ombudsman recommendations and a motion asking the cabinet to solve adoption bottlenecks.
The GroenLinks members consider that extending the deadline for granting consent in principle from eight weeks to thirty months conflicts with earlier recommendations of the National Ombudsman.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie menen dat de verlenging van de termijn voor het verlenen van een beginseltoestemming van acht weken tot dertig maanden in is strijd met eerdere aanbevelingen van de nationale ombudsman.
Holds that practice alone must not dictate the length of a decision deadline and questions whether thirty months is reasonable, proposing one year instead.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Civil Code and several special laws to align decision deadlines with the Wet dwangsom en beroep bij niet tijdig beslissen, and objected to the blanket exemption of the Wjsg from the dwangsom regime and to the 30-month deadline for interlandelijke adoptie consent, recommending targeted adjustments and a reasoned justification. The minister's nader rapport accepted the remarks on the Wjsg (limiting the exemption to the verklaring omtrent gedrag) and the need for motivated deadlines, but kept the 30-month adoption deadline, explaining that the waiting time averages 18 months.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the dwangsom exemption for the entire Wjsg was broader than justified by the expected surge in verklaringen omtrent het gedrag, and the government narrowed the exemption to afdeling 5 of the Wjsg.
The Afdeling argued a financial sanction for exceeding the 30-month adoption consent deadline is inappropriate; the government kept the deadline but did not exclude it from the dwangsom regime.
The Afdeling asked that deadline changes be accompanied by a reasoned motivation, which the government said was provided in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling noted the explanatory note on Article II referred to a Aanbestedingswet bill since rejected, and asked for updating.

31859.s: The bill amends several Dutch statutes (disaster damage compensation, private security, arbitration, environmental permitting, odour nuisance from livestock, trade register, door-to-door sales, mining, and nature protection) to align them with the EU Services Directive and the forthcoming Dienstenwet. Most changes are technical procedural adjustments such as time limits, electronic communication, and removing permit requirements.
31859.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to bring national law into line with the Services Directive and does not offer a specific justification for the delegation itself.
q: Rules laid down under Article 5(3) of the Dienstenwet by or pursuant to a general administrative order apply mutatis mutandis to the electronic communication referred to in paragraph 3.
Artikel 5, derde lid, van de Dienstenwet bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur zijn gesteld, zijn van overeenkomstige toepassing op berichtenverkeer als bedoeld in het derde lid.
d: rules on electronic trade register communication

parties: Supports timely and complete implementation of the Services Directive and asks about implementation status in other member states and the language regimes of central contact points.
The CDA members attach importance to timely implementation of European regulation into national legislation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hechten aan een tijdige implementatie van Europese regelgeving in de nationale wetgeving.

Asks how the bill relates to the AMvB and departmental amendments, whether the Veegwet is dropped, and how the new directive power over authorities is limited to certain fundamental obligations, which may conflict with the Van Dijk motion.
Why is the directive power limited to a certain number of fundamental obligations?
Waarom is de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid beperkt tot een bepaald aantal fundamentele verplichtingen?
Opposes the Lex Silencio Positivo principle and argues that mining and private security permits carry serious public safety and environmental risks that justify keeping prior review.
These members are concerned about this.
Deze leden maken zich hier zorgen over.
Asks for concrete progress on screening legislation at local and provincial levels and for an overview of Lex Silencio Positivo application against other member states.
These members want to know concretely what 'on the right track' means in this case and the actual status, mainly regarding local authorities.
Deze leden willen graag concreet weten wat «goed op weg» in dit geval betekent en wat de concrete stand van zaken is, voornamelijk met betrekking tot de lokale overheden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the nota van wijziging to the Aanpassingswet dienstenrichtlijn, asking for clarification of differences between the services directive and the professional qualifications directive on administrative cooperation, and for reconsideration of including chapter 6A in the Dienstenwet ahead of the wet NErpe. The minister replied defending the approach, adjusting the designation of ministers in article 59a to match the NErpe bill, and amending the Wet op de architectentitel.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the differences between the two EU directives on administrative cooperation be explained and that the Wet op de architectentitel be aligned; the government explained the differences and amended the architect title act but kept its own approach.
The Afdeling questioned the need to anticipate the wet NErpe with a new chapter 6A given no acute problems had been shown; the minister disagreed and kept chapter 6A, limited to temporary measures.

The Afdeling noted that ministerial instruction powers over provinces, municipalities and water boards differed between article 59a and the wet NErpe; the government aligned article 59a with the NErpe bill.

31868.s: The bill allows vmbo schools to let vulnerable pupils follow an assistant vocational training (assistentopleiding) under the WEB, partly or wholly replacing the basisberoepsgerichte leerweg, under a cooperation agreement with a MBO institution. It also extends the experimental period for competence-based qualification structures in vocational education from 2010 to 2012.

parties: Asks who bears final responsibility when quality falls short, how the choice of pupils is made without a selection procedure, and why the experiment period must be extended.
Which institution bears final responsibility if something goes wrong?
Bij welke instelling ligt de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor als er iets niet goed gaat?
Welcomes the bill as a tailored alternative for vulnerable pupils who struggle in the school setting.
It is therefore a good thing that an assistant training programme within vmbo now offers pupils who struggle with the school environment an alternative.
Het is daarom een goede zaak dat nu met een assistentopleiding binnen het vmbo aan leerlingen, die moeite hebben met de schoolse omgeving, een alternatief wordt geboden.
Asks about the relation to lwoo, zmlk/zmok pupils, the growth of assistant programmes and complexity of routes for teachers and parents.
Won't it become very complex for teachers, pupils and parents to understand all the different routes to a starting qualification?
Wordt het niet erg complex voor leraren, leerlingen en ouders om alle verschillende routes naar een startkwalificatie te snappen?
Asks for evidence of success beyond participant numbers, the cost estimate and budget coverage, and why Actal did not advise on the bill.
The members also ask why Actal did not select this bill for advice.
Tevens vragen de leden waarom Actal dit wetsvoorstel niet heeft geselecteerd voor een advies.
Supports the aims of bringing a vulnerable group toward a starting qualification and anchoring the programme in law; no further remarks.
These members endorse the aims of the bill, namely guiding a vulnerable group of pupils toward a starting qualification.
Deze leden onderschrijven de doelen van het wetsvoorstel, te weten het toeleiden van een kwetsbare groep leerlingen naar een startkwalificatie.
Asks how quality is secured, whether vmbo teachers are qualified, who is held accountable for poor quality, and how financing is protected from transfers between education types.
Who is ultimately held to account for insufficient quality or results, these members ask.
Wie wordt dan uiteindelijk aangesproken bij onvoldoende kwaliteit of rendement, zo vragen deze leden.

31877.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to give works councils of public limited companies (NV) a right to state a position before the general meeting on major management decisions, appointment, suspension and dismissal of directors and supervisory board members, and remuneration policy. The position must be submitted with the approval request, may be explained at the meeting, and its absence does not invalidate the decision-making.
31877.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the works council role as restoring a balance of power between shareholders, the board and the supervisory board, and notes the works council's position is advisory and that its absence does not void decisions.
q: The absence of that position does not affect the decision-making on the approval request.
Het ontbreken van dat standpunt tast de besluitvorming over het verzoek om goedkeuring niet aan.
p: Major management decisions may not be submitted to the general meeting until the works council has had the opportunity to state a position, which must accompany the submission.
Proposals to appoint, suspend or dismiss a director must first allow the works council to state a position, which is submitted alongside the proposal.
Proposals on remuneration policy must first allow the works council to state a position, which is submitted alongside the proposal.
Proposals to appoint, suspend or dismiss a supervisory board member must first allow the works council to state a position.
Nominations for supervisory board members may not be submitted to the general meeting until the works council has been given the opportunity to state a position.

parties: Asks for fuller justification of why a non-binding speaking right suffices and whether the scope should be limited to listed companies, and asks whether consultation with the works council should be mandatory before proposals go to shareholders.
Can the government give a more thorough justification of why it now considers the voice of employees sufficiently secured by a non-binding speaking right?
Kan grondiger worden gemotiveerd waarom de regering nu van mening is dat de stem van de werknemers voldoende is geborgd door een vrijblijvend spreekrecht?

Questions whether the speaking right is too non-binding, whether shareholders should be obliged to respond, whether works councils lack access to the Enterprise Chamber, and whether a future evaluation and sanctions are needed.
Is the bill not too non-binding if the general meeting of shareholders is not obliged to respond to the works council's position?
Deze leden vragen voorts of het wetsvoorstel niet te vrijblijvend is als de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders niet verplicht is om op het standpunt van de ondernemingsraad te reageren.

Asks whether decisions taken without the works council's view could be voided under Civil Code articles 2:14 and 2:15, and whether sanctions will be introduced if works councils cannot use the right in practice.
Is the government prepared to introduce sanctions if it turns out that works councils in practice cannot sufficiently use the speaking right, these members ask.
Is de regering bereid om wel sancties in te voeren indien zou blijken dat ondernemingsraden in de praktijk niet voldoende van het spreekrecht gebruik kunnen maken, zo vragen deze leden.

Believes the government chose the wrong instrument, prefers a works council member sitting on the remuneration committee, warns the bill risks becoming symbolic law without sanctions and could harm the investment climate, and asks for reconsideration.
The VVD members ask the government to address possible horse-trading; in view of the above, they ask the government to reconsider the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op mogelijke koehandel. Gelet op het voorgaande vragen de leden deze leden de regering dan ook het wetsvoorstel te heroverwegen

Supports broader employee involvement in remuneration and asks whether the government considered requiring the supervisory or management board to consult the works council before sending proposals to shareholders, so that consequences can be raised.

These members ask the government to explain whether it considered including a provision in the bill obliging the supervisory board or management board to consult the works council before sending its proposals to the general meeting of shareholders.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering toe te lichten of is overwogen om in het wetsvoorstel een bepaling op te nemen waarin de Raad van Commissarissen of de Raad van Bestuur wordt verplicht om met de ondernemingsraad overleg te voeren

31958.s: The bill sets rules for the financial function of the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including a College financieel toezicht with ministerial oversight, budget and accounts procedures, borrowing limits and an interest-burden norm. It also gives the island bodies a closed list of local taxes and fees and regulates how these are levied and collected.
31958.j: The memorandum justifies the strict financial supervision as necessary during the transition, given past liquidity-driven management, and says the arrangement will be evaluated within five years.
q: The financial supervision, as it took shape in the temporary financial supervision decree for BES, is incorporated in this bill.
Het financiële toezicht, zoals dat vorm heeft gekregen in het Besluit tijdelijk financieel toezicht BES, is in dit wetsvoorstel geïncorporeerd.
d: appointment and removal of College financieel toezicht members
policy rules and binding instructions to the College
approval of island budgets against statutory criteria
further rules on bank accounts and cash management
detailed rules on accountants' audit reports
form and content of budget and annual accounts
further rules on the local taxes in chapter IV
p: The minister may take provisional measures replacing the College or its members if it seriously fails in its duties, after consultation and a chance to remedy.
If an island body fails to adopt measures to implement its budget, the minister may task the College with imposing special measures itself.
The minister may designate budget items on which no financial commitments may be entered before his approval.
Ministerial approval of budgets, and of amendments to them, may be partially granted or refused on broad criteria including financial interest.

parties: Asks the government to keep intensive financial supervision of the BES islands, to clarify ministerial mandates and approval powers, and to set clear rules for budget delays and personal liability of council members.
Along with the government, and unlike the Council of State, these members hold that intensive supervision of the financial management of the BES islands must be fully maintained.
Met de regering en in tegenstelling tot de Raad van State zijn deze leden van oordeel dat onverkort vastgehouden moet worden aan het intensieve toezicht op de financiële huishouding van de BES.

Asks whether disputes over supervisory powers should go to the Council of State as for municipalities, what legal remedies the island boards have, and how supervision by the Cft and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger is coordinated.
What stands in the way, in such a case, of the legal route that is also open to municipalities to bring the administrative dispute before the Council of State?
Wat verzet zich in een dergelijk geval tegen de juridische weg die ook voor gemeenten openstaat om het bestuurgeschil voor te leggen aan de Raad van State?
Criticises the incomplete law with many open ends and the absence of the tax law, and asks how the Rijksministerraad reviews budgets and how success of the islands' finances will be measured.
The SP members regret that the law on the financial function of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is incomplete and in their view has many open ends.
De leden van de SP-fractie betreuren het dat de wet financiële functie Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba onvolledig is en naar hun oordeel vele open einden kent.
Supports the planned evaluation after five years and the independence of Cft members, asks for specific evaluation criteria now, and asks when the minister's steering powers would be used.
They also support the intention to evaluate the financial supervision after five years.
Zij ondersteunen ook het voornemen om het financiële toezicht na vijf jaar te evalueren.

Regrets the absence of a sunset clause, questions the five-year evaluation period and the lack of parliamentary accountability by the minister for supervisory tasks, and asks whether earlier adjustments to supervision are possible.
These members regret that, as with the WolBES bill, this bill lacks a horizon provision.
Deze leden betreuren het dat er net als bij het wetsvoorstel WolBES een horizonbepaling in dit wetsvoorstel ontbreekt.

v.summary: The Council of State advises that the bill on the financial functions, taxation and financial relations of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is intensive and too closely modelled on the Netherlands' municipal system, raising concerns about democratic accountability of the financial oversight college, the lack of judicial/Kroon dispute resolution, and the fixed general grant and loan rules. The government's reply accepts some points (taxation, citizen remedies partly, renaming grants) but largely defends the intensive oversight as needed during the transition and keeps the dispute resolution under the administrative court.
concerns: The Council argues oversight by an independent zbo without direct democratic accountability fits poorly with Dutch intergovernmental relations and suggests ministerial mandate instead; the government moved the oversight decisions to the minister but kept the college.

The Council wants disputes over supervisory decisions resolved by the Crown (Kroonberoep) rather than the administrative court, since court review is limited to legality; the government refused, arguing an independent judge is best placed.

The Council finds the intensive preventive financial oversight exceeds that of municipalities and lacks justification during the transition; the government accepted that transition needs intensive guidance and added an evaluation clause.

The Council asks for an evaluation of the Besluit's experience and a concrete timeline for scaling back oversight, and for a reasoned general-grant model; the government added explanation and the evaluation clause but kept the structure.

The Council recommends a motivation requirement for specific grants and a reasoned basis for interest-free loans; the government partly adopted these but rejected the duty to motivate specific grants.
Drafting points on citation title, article numbering, terminology and redundant provisions were accepted and incorporated.
The Council asks for an information and framework on the general grant amount and indexation before enactment; the government deferred these to a general administrative order.

31994.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to tighten the asylum procedure, including changing the time-limits for rejected asylum applications from hours to days, and widening the court's ex nunc review so it can take into account new facts, evidence and policy changes arising after the contested decision. It also adds the question of whether removal should be suspended under article 64 to the decisions on residence permits, and provides transitional rules.
31994.j: The memorandum justifies the widened ex nunc review and shortened procedure as reducing repeat asylum applications and making the procedure more effective, while stressing that the independent courts retain control.
q: This reduces the need to submit second or subsequent applications. However, this lies in the hands of the independent judiciary in the Netherlands.
Dit vermindert de noodzaak voor het indienen van tweede of volgende aanvragen. Dit is echter in handen van de onafhankelijke rechtspraak in Nederland.
d: Artikel I, onderdelen D en E (artikelen 62, 69, 82)
number of days within which asylum applications are rejected in the accelerated procedure
p: The court must take into account new facts and policy changes after the contested decision, but may exclude them where the proper conduct of proceedings or undue delay requires, and the minister must respond in writing.

parties: Asks whether the revised article 83 meets the European Court's requirement of full and ex nunc assessment and whether repeated last-minute applications can be prevented.

Nevertheless, these members are not entirely reassured that the amendment of article 83 Aliens Act 2000 will sufficiently satisfy the European Court of Human Rights requirement of full and ex nunc assessment.

Niettemin zijn deze leden er niet geheel gerust op dat met de wijziging van artikel 83 Vw 2000 voldoende zal worden voldaan aan de eis van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) van «full and ex nunc assessment».
Supports faster procedures but insists on due care, the best interests of children, and asks whether the courts and IND are equipped for the changes.
The PvdA members agree with the government that the stacking of applications and immigration law proceedings must be prevented.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn het eens met de regering dat het stapelen van aanvragen en vreemdelingrechtelijke procedures moet worden voorkomen.
Argues due care must outweigh speed, calls for full ex nunc review by courts and criticises the four-week shelter period and limits on legal aid.
In the view of these members, sufficient time must be available at the start of the procedure to make a careful assessment that does justice to all circumstances of the individual case.

Naar mening van deze leden moet er voldoende tijd beschikbaar zijn om in het begin van de procedure een zorgvuldige afweging te kunnen maken die recht doet aan alle omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Asks whether the reforms will actually prevent stacking of procedures, whether extra judges are planned, and how delays from ex nunc review will be limited.
The VVD members would like the government to explain how the postponement of return on unfounded grounds is precisely prevented by these new measures.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zouden graag een toelichting van de regering willen krijgen hoe het uitstellen van terugkeer op onterechte gronden met deze nieuwe maatregelen precies wordt voorkomen.
Asks why full review is not provided for, arguing it would meet legal sentiment and reduce complaints to the European Court.
These members do not see full review reflected in the proposed article 83 Aliens Act 2000.
Deze leden zien de volle toetsing niet terug in het voorgestelde artikel 83 Vw 2000.
Supports the reform aims but asks how due care is guaranteed given short timeframes for corrections to hearings and how the ex nunc test meets European requirements.
These members ask the government to explain how due care is guaranteed, given that corrections and additions to the first and further hearing must take place within a short timeframe.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten op welke wijze de zorgvuldigheid geborgd is, nu correcties en aanvullingen op het eerste en nader gehoor binnen een kort tijdsbestek moeten plaatsvinden.
Regrets that full review as proposed in the Pechtold/Van der Ham bill is not adopted, arguing the amendment only partly meets the European requirement.
These members believe that the present proposal insufficiently meets the first element of this requirement.
Deze leden menen dat in het onderhavige voorstel onvoldoende aan het eerste element van dit vereiste tegemoet wordt gekomen.
Asks whether powers exist to counter deliberate withholding of information in the administrative phase and whether the four-week departure period is too generous.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the draft bill amending the Aliens Act 2000 to expand ex nunc review of new facts and evidence in asylum appeals, raising concerns about delay, costs, the unclear application of changed policy, the term 'bewijsmiddel', and the length of the explanatory memorandum. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, revising the explanatory memorandum and deleting the term 'bewijsmiddelen', while maintaining the expanded review and arguing delays would be limited by procedural safeguards.
concerns: The Council advised addressing measures to prevent the foreseen delay in appeal proceedings from the broader ex nunc review, which the government addressed by clarifying safeguards in the memorandum.
The Council noted the explanatory memorandum should clarify whether changed policy under article 83(1)(b) must be invoked by a party, which the government adopted.
The Council advised deleting the term 'bewijsmiddelen' from article 83 as it has no legal consequence, which the government did.
The Council advised aligning the explanatory memorandum's criterion for new facts with the wording of article 83(1), which the government did.
The Council advised limiting the explanatory memorandum to the bill itself; the government shortened the lower-regulation sections but kept a broad overview of asylum procedure measures.

32123-IXA.s: The bill formally establishes the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the National Debt (IXA), in thousands of euros, with the budget tables for financing the state debt and cash management. It sets entry into force on 1 January 2010, or retroactively from that date if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement for National Debt (IXA) for the year 2010 attached to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statute of the Nationale Schuld (National Debt, budget chapter IXA) to reflect the autumn budget adjustment (Najaarsnota), changing expenditure and receipt amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 December 2009 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The 2009 budget statute of the National Debt (IXA) is amended as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32360-IV.s: This supplementary budget law amends the 2009 departmental budget of Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties) by changing expenditure, commitments and revenue across policy articles on the guarantee function and promoting autonomy of Kingdom partners, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It is a budgetary adjustment and does not itself delegate rule-making power to the executive.
32360-IV.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by lower realised expenditure on support for the judiciary, the Public Prosecution Service and Coast Guard deployment, but gives no justification for any delegation or new powers.
q: The lower realisation of expenditure and commitments is caused by lower spending on support for the judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service and deployment of the Coast Guard.
De lagere realisatie van uitgaven en verplichtingen wordt veroorzaakt door lagere uitgaven voor de ondersteuning van de Rechterlijke Macht en het Openbaar Ministerie en inzet Kustwacht.

32360-VI.s: This is a second supplementary budget law (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Justice for fiscal year 2009, amending the departmental budget statement and the agency budget statements to reflect actual spending and revenue. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift power toward the executive, or alter oversight mechanisms.
32360-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendments by reference to variances between planned and realised expenditure, such as higher legal aid demand and lower reclassering spending.
q: In 2010 more use of legal aid was made than expected, therefore in 2009 EUR 69.8 million more was committed than estimated.
In 2010 wordt een hoger beroep op de rechtsbijstand gedaan dan verwacht, daarom is in 2009 € 69,8 mln. meer verplicht dan geraamd.

32399.s: The bill creates a legal framework for compulsory mental health care as a last resort for persons with psychiatric disorders posing significant risk of serious harm, replacing the Wet bopz. It establishes a multidisciplinary commission to advise the judge, requires court-issued treatment authorisations (zorgmachtiging), crisis measures by the mayor, self-binding declarations, guideline-based care, registration and a complaints procedure.
32399.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for careful preparation, reduction of coercion, uniform quality of care and integrated care tailored to the patient.
q: For adequate supervision it is important that the IGZ has insight into data on the implementation of compulsory care by care providers.
Voor adequaat toezicht is het van belang dat de IGZ inzicht heeft in de gegevens over de uitvoering van de verplichte zorg door de zorgaanbieders
d: forms of compulsory care, guidelines (richtlijnen) and quality norms
commission seat, organisation, composition, working method and appointment
models for requests, medical certificates, care plans and crisis-measure forms
content of the commission's registers and data retention rules
model house rules and detailed rules on the care register
p: Allows compulsory care, including temporary measures in unforeseen emergencies, on the basis of a broad risk criterion, with only a limited procedural safeguard.
Mayors may impose crisis measures and police may temporarily detain persons before a judicial decision, bypassing prior judicial authorisation, subject to later review.
A commission takes over the prosecutor's role and advises the judge, with the judge retaining the decision on authorisation.

parties: Asks whether capacity and the multidisciplinary commission will cause bureaucracy and delay, and about the scope of the harm criterion.
How will this principle work out in practice?
Hoe zal dit uitgangspunt in de praktijk tot zijn recht komen?
Supports the bill's principles but warns that the commission's advisory role may duplicate hearings before the judge, and demands better IGZ oversight of compulsory care.
The reciprocity principle means that the legitimacy to seriously infringe a person's fundamental freedom comes with an obligation to deliver good care, which is not regularly checked.

Het wederkerigheidsbeginsel brengt met zich mee dat tegenover de legitimatie om een vergaande inbreuk te plegen op iemands fundamentele vrijheid een inspanningsverplicht staat om goede zorg te leveren.
Asks whether the two-stage commission-then-judge procedure will cause duplication, delay and unclear division of tasks.

These members ask whether this two-stage procedure will not lead to unnecessary duplication, delays in the procedures and/or unclarity about the division of tasks between the commission and the judge.
Deze leden vragen of deze tweetrapsraket niet tot onnodig dubbelwerk, vertragingen in de procedures en/of onduidelijkheden over de taakverdeling tussen de commissie en de rechter zal leiden.
Asks whether a non-medically trained judge can deviate from the commission's advice and whether the commission should itself end compulsory care.
Why could the commission not itself decide to end the care?
Waarom zou de commissie niet zelf tot beëindiging van de zorg kunnen besluiten?
Worries that the mayor's crisis measure, taken without careful review, risks infringing fundamental rights, and questions how patient rights are protected.
Precisely because no careful review is possible in an acute situation, the risk that a citizen's fundamental rights are infringed increases considerably.
Juist omdat in een acute situatie geen zorgvuldige toetsing mogelijk is, neemt het risico aanzienlijk toe dat een burger in zijn fundamentele rechten wordt aangetast.
Asks how the mayor's role in crisis measures works in practice and how patients' interests are weighed against public order.
These members ask the government to explain how the mayor's role is filled in practice and how the review against the various legal principles and statutory criteria takes shape in practice.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering toe te lichten op welke wijze de rol van de burgemeester in de praktijk wordt ingevuld en op welke wijze de toets op de diverse rechtsbeginselen en wettelijke criteria in de praktijk zijn beslag krijgt.
Asks whether the double procedure slows treatment and forces people to repeat their story, and whether hearings far from home are a barrier.
Is a double procedure not being chosen in this way, with negative consequences for the speed of treatment and the need for those involved to tell their story more than once?
Wordt op die manier niet gekozen voor een dubbele procedure met de negatieve consequenties voor de snelheid van de behandeling en de noodzaak voor betrokkenen om meer keren hun verhaal te doen?
Asks who controls the independence of the geneesheer-directeur and how the officier van justitie's role in requesting compulsory care relates to the physician's authority.
Who ultimately monitors him? Is that only the judge and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ)?
Wie controleert hem uiteindelijk? Is dat alleen de rechter en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)?
Supports the bill's aims of limiting coercion but worries that removing the commission scatters tasks among many actors and weakens safeguards for independent assessment.
These members are however concerned whether the bill, after the far-reaching amendment note, is still as uncomplicated as originally intended.
Genoemde leden maken zich echter zorgen of het wetsvoorstel na de ingrijpende nota van wijziging nog wel zo ongecompliceerd is als vooraf werd beoogd.
Objects to dropping the multidisciplinary commission, questions the geneesheer-directeur's independence given many roles, and asks for costings of both variants.

These members however doubt whether the multidisciplinary perspective in drafting a request for a care authorisation remains sufficiently intact after the multidisciplinary commission is removed in the amended bill.

Genoemde leden betwijfelen echter of ook het multidisciplinaire perspectief bij het opstellen van een verzoek om een zorgmachtiging met het schrappen van de multidisciplinaire commissie voldoende overeind blijft in het gewijzigd wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether municipalities can realistically carry out compulsory care at home and how the bill's rules relate to the Wmo 2015 and other care laws.
After all, it is quite something to also impose compulsory mental health care in the home situation.
Het is immers nogal wat om ook verplichte ggz in de thuissituatie te gaan opleggen.

Asks that the multidisciplinary perspective be preserved and that the redistribution of commission tasks be balanced, and asks why the geneesheer-directeur's appointment by the supervisory board is not mandated.
In this context these members do find it important that the multidisciplinary approach is preserved and that the redistribution of the commission's tasks among existing actors is balanced.
Deze leden vinden het in dat kader wel belangrijk dat de multidisciplinaire invalshoek behouden blijft en dat de herverdeling van de taken van de commissie over de bestaande actoren evenwichtig is.
Finds the safeguards for the geneesheer-directeur's independence insufficient and asks for the multidisciplinary commission to be reinstated; also questions municipal discretion.

These members find the answers an insufficient guarantee of the necessary independence and maintain that the geneesheer-directeur may not independently decide on, for example, ending coercive measures.

Deze leden vinden de antwoorden onvoldoende waarborg voor de noodzakelijke onafhankelijkheid en blijven erbij dat de geneesheer-directeur niet eigenhandig mag beslissen over bijvoorbeeld beëindiging van dwangmaatregelen.
Questions whether independent decision-making on requests and ending of care orders is still guaranteed and asks how the geneesheer-directeur can combine care and legal-protection roles.
Asks whether the reduction of actors intended by the evaluation committee has been achieved and whether the government's duty under the reciprocity principle has been weakened.
The SGP members note that the tasks of the originally multidisciplinary commission are divided over a multitude of actors.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat de taken van de aanvankelijke multidisciplinaire commissie worden verdeeld over een veelheid van actoren.

Questions the legal basis and six or more days of deprivation of liberty without judicial review under the observation and crisis measures, and asks how rights of clients are safeguarded when moving between regimes.
With a stacking of measures, including the observation and crisis measures, there can be at least six days of deprivation of liberty without judicial review.
Met een stapeling van maatregelen, waaronder de observatie- en crisismaatregel, kan sprake zijn van ten minste zes dagen ontneming van de vrijheid, zonder rechterlijke toetsing.
Asks about the rights of different target groups, the role of the public prosecutor, the observation measure and whether it conflicts with a patient-centred treatment law.
For the PvdA members it is crucial that the public prosecutor may not designate compulsory care without the involvement of a medical director.
Voor de leden van de PvdA-fractie is het cruciaal dat het OM niet zonder tussenkomst van een geneesheer-directeur verplichte zorg mag aanwijzen.

Objects to the observation measure, to placing preparation of compulsory care with the public prosecutor, and to unequal legal protection between the Wvggz and Wzd, including possible violations of the UN disability convention.
These members have a major objection to the differences in legal equality that continue to exist for people subjected to compulsory care.
Deze leden hebben een groot bezwaar tegen de verschillen in rechtsgelijkheid die blijven bestaan voor mensen die gedwongen zorg opgelegd krijgen.
Asks how the UN convention relates to the bill, how the choice of legal regime is justified, and whether the public prosecutor is adequately equipped for its new active role.
How does the UN human rights convention relate to the compulsory mental health care bill and the care and coercion bill?
Hoe verhoudt het VN-verdrag van de rechten van de mens zich tot het wetsvoorstel verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg en het wetsvoorstel zorg en dwang?

Asks for justification of differing levels of legal protection, whether patients know they can request later judicial review, and why evaluators' recommendation for a single legal framework was not followed.
Can the government explain how the target group, psychogeriatric patients and people with intellectual disabilities, will be informed of their right to request a later judicial review?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe de doelgroep, psychogeriatrische patiënten en verstandelijk beperkten, geïnformeerd zal worden over hun recht om achteraf een toetsing van de rechter te eisen?

Asks about rights under the UN disability convention, differing protection regimes, conflicts between the Wvggz and the Beginselenwet verpleging terbeschikkingstelling in forensic institutions, and stigmatisation of mental health patients.

When a patient is placed in a Forensic Psychiatric Centre, articles of the Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikkingstelling are declared applicable that conflict with the principle that the patient's legal position under the Wvggz is preserved.

Als een patiënt is opgenomen in een Forensisch Psychiatrisch Centrum (FPC), worden er artikelen uit de Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikking gestelden (BVT) van toepassing verklaard die tegenstrijdig zijn met het uitgangspunt dat de rechtspositie van de patiënt zoals beschreven in de Wvggz behouden blijft.
Asks why a detailed standard procedure applies to care under the Wzd regardless of form, whereas the Wvggz allows multidisciplinary guidelines.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the second amendment note to the Wvggz (compulsory mental health care bill), finding it should proceed but needs better reasoning and adjustment on several points, notably the OM's active role, the observation measure under Article 5 ECHR, and data protection. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, adjusted the text and explanatory notes, and rejected a few suggestions such as a geneesheer-directeur equivalent in the Wzd.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the Openbaar Ministerie can structurally fulfil its new active regie role given its primary criminal-law mandate, expertise and resources; the government commits to an implementation plan and pilots.
The observation measure's compatibility with Article 5 ECHR is not explained in the explanatory notes and should be addressed; the government added the analysis.
The three-day observation term is questioned for unwilling persons and the lack of an extension mechanism; the government maintained the term with practice-based justification.
The hearing obligation for crisis measures and the places suitable for temporary compulsory care must be made workable and compatible with ECHR case law.
The relationship with the Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering and the procedural law applicable to Wvggz proceedings needs clarification.

Essential safeguards for ambulatory compulsory care should be in the statute itself rather than only in a general administrative order; the government kept the AMvB approach with a prior-submission provision.
The advice to add a geneesheer-directeur-like independent review function in the Wzd for PG/VG care was not adopted; the government argued the sectors are organised differently.
The need for a data-exchange basis per measure and phase must be justified; a schematic overview was added.
The right of hoger beroep against the zorgmachtiging was questioned; it was removed in the amended note.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg, which replaces the Wet Bopz, supporting its aims but raising mainly technical remarks on scope, groups affected, criteria, information rights, privacy, the crisis measure and evaluation. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, partly followed some, and rejected others such as the complaints-law framing, the conditional-discharge rules and limits on police powers.
concerns: Information about rights must be given in a language the patient understands, including before the commission procedure, with an interpreter where needed.
The commission's power to demand medical personal data should be limited to tasks where breaching confidentiality is necessary under privacy law.
Extra statutory safeguards for seclusion and restraint under Recommendation 10 should be written into the bill rather than relying on the general principles.
Conditions attached to conditional discharge should be limited so they do not restrict freedom of religion or political freedom.
The bill should set a deadline for the commission's advice on ending compulsory care, so discharge is not unduly delayed and access to a judge is preserved.
Investigative powers for absconding patients should be limited to serious cases, such as violence or sexual offences, and should cover searching places.
Groups falling outside the bill, such as the no-willingness-no-objection group, unclear numbers of boundary cases and detainees, need explanation in the explanatory memorandum.
The new harm criterion of significant risk of serious harm needs clearer explanation, including the difference between material and financial harm.
The explanatory memorandum should explain the change in which minister signs the bill, since responsibilities seem to have shifted.
The complaints procedure should be treated as a complaints right analogous to Awb chapter 9 and terminology should change accordingly.
Several minor drafting and redactional points were adopted or addressed, including terminology and cross-references.

32500-IXB.s: The bill sets the 2011 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the 2011 budgets of the Rijksvastgoed- en Ontwikkelingsbedrijf and Domeinen Roerende Zaken, in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2011 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum describing Finance policy on tax compliance, financial markets, public holdings and budget management.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this act for the year 2011 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32565-X.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Article X), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across operational and non-policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie

32696.s: The bill abolishes the Spaarfonds AOW, the AOW savings fund, by repealing its definition and articles 86 to 88 of the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen. It also amends article 84 to remove references to the fund's receipts and expenditure, citing greater transparency of public finances.
32696.j: The memorandum justifies the abolition by citing transparency of government finances and a small reduction in administrative burden, without any new delegation of power.
q: Whereas we have considered that, from the standpoint of transparency of government finances, it is desirable to abolish the AOW Savings Fund;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het uit oogpunt van transparantie van de overheidsfinanciën wenselijk is het Spaarfonds AOW op te heffen;

parties: Asks only when the law will take effect.
The VVD members have only one question about the bill: when will this law take effect?
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben maar een vraag over het wetsvoorstel: wanneer zal deze wet in werking treden?
Says the fund brought no real improvement to fiscal sustainability, so abolishing it has no adverse effects, but the sustainability issue remains pressing.
However, the savings fund does not bring any real improvement to the sustainability of public finances; it was merely a particular way of bookkeeping.
Het spaarfonds levert echter geen daadwerkelijke verbetering op voor de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën, het was slechts een bepaalde manier van boekhouden.
Asks what the fund actually contributed, how transparency can be achieved, and what happens to accumulated interest, demanding a detailed government response.
The CDA members would like a detailed response from the government on this point.
De leden van de CDA-fractie ontvangen graag een uitgebreide reactie van de regering op dit punt.
Questions whether the public was misled about the fund's guarantee of AOW, asks for the costs and content of government communication, and asks whether apologies or rectification are due.
The SP members ask whether it is correct that citizens were told by Postbus 51 that the AOW fund, containing EUR 115 billion, would make the AOW certain in the future.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het juist is dat burgers door Postbus 51 werden voorgehouden dat door het spaarfonds AOW waar € 115 mld. in zou zitten de AOW in de toekomst zeker zou zijn.

32768.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2009/81/EC on procurement in the defence and security fields, setting rules for contract award procedures, scope and thresholds, exclusion and selection criteria, and remedies. It also carves out certain defence and security contracts from general procurement rules and gives the Minister power to publish changes to thresholds and annexes.
32768.j: The memorandum justifies the exemptions and delegations by the need to protect essential national security interests and operational needs, citing Article 346 TFEU and the directive's security provisions.
d: amendments to directive annexes applying to service contract definition
publication of changes to EU thresholds
p: Exempts contracts from the act where they involve essential security information, intelligence activities, or operational conditions, reducing external review of executive procurement.
Allows award without public notice on grounds such as technical reasons, urgency or crisis, limited by strict necessity conditions.
Allows courts to consider defence and security interests when deciding on interim measures against contract awards.

parties: Supports an open European defence market but warns the Netherlands should not lead implementation and asks how Dutch industry interests and the Ten Broeke motion will be served.
At the same time, the members believe the Netherlands must guard against once again becoming the best boy in the European class in this area.
Tegelijkertijd zijn de leden van mening dat Nederland ervoor moet waken op dit gebied wederom het beste jongetje van de Europese klas te worden.
Asks whether the government implements the Ten Broeke motion, how far other member states have implemented, and requests overviews of compensation volumes and the Defence Industry Strategy.
The PvdA members ask to what extent the government, through this proposal, implements the Ten Broeke et al. motion.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen zich af in hoeverre de regering middels dit voorstel uitvoering geeft aan de motie Ten Broeke c.s.
Asks why a separate defence statute is needed rather than provisions in the general procurement act, and how misuse of the Article 346 exception and risks to the level playing field are prevented.
These members however also see a risk that these possibilities are not applied in practice in a comparable way.
Deze leden zien hier echter ook een risico dat deze mogelijkheden in de praktijk niet op vergelijkbare wijze wordt gehanteerd.
Asks how often Article 346 TFEU is invoked by the Netherlands and other states, whether its use should be reduced, and how exceptions are prevented from being used to exclude foreign bidders.
In what way is it prevented that exceptions other than those stated in the directive are used by member states to exclude foreign bidders?
Op welke manier wordt voorkomen dat andere uitzonderingen dan vermeld in de richtlijn zullen worden benut door lidstaten om buitenlandse aanbieders te weren?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the defence and security procurement bill but advises considering integration with the proposed general Procurement Act 20.. and clarifying the notice of an awarded contract. The government's reply accepts the proposal to explain the choice for a separate bill, moves the awarded-contract provision, and makes several technical and drafting adjustments.
concerns: The division finds the choice for a separate bill understandable given timely implementation, and asks that the explanatory memorandum address the aim of a clear, uniform legal framework.

The division questions why the notice of an awarded contract (art. 3.6) has a separate regime alongside the general publication rule and the surplus second and third paragraphs, and asks for explanation and amendment.
The division makes numerous redactional comments in an annex, most of which the government adopts.

32777.s: The bill gradually lowers the referentieminimumloon-based benefit percentages (from 197.5% to 100 of the minimum wage reference) by 2.5 percentage points twice a year starting 1 July 2012, through amendments to the WWB, WIJ, Anw, WIK and Huurtoeslag laws, with a sunset on 1 January 2032. It also adjusts the minimum income reference point in the rent allowance law and aligns references to the minimum wage.
32777.j: The memorandum justifies the gradual reduction by arguing that benefit development should be comparable to the minimum wage, that the activating system will reduce benefit claims, and that the phased reduction gives people time to adjust.
q: The gradual phase-out over 20 years ensures that people have ample time to adapt to the new situation.
De geleidelijke afbouw over 20 jaar zorgt ervoor dat mensen ruim de tijd hebben om zich aan te passen aan de nieuwe situatie.
d: announcement of revised benefit percentage in Staatscourant

parties: Accepts the principle that work should pay but asks about indexation choices, the 20-year phase-out period, and the fluctuating gap between benefits and minimum wage.
The VVD members share the principle that work should pay and that a welfare benefit should not exceed the statutory minimum wage, but still have questions about the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie delen het principe dat werk moet lonen en dat een bijstandsuitkering niet hoger mag zijn dan het wettelijk minimumloon, maar hebben nog wel vragen over het wetsvoorstel.

Argues the measure is an ordinary cost-cutting exercise that pushes benefits below the subsistence minimum, harms children, and affects people who can never work; asks for alternatives and detailed figures.
The PvdA members, however, believe it is not acceptable to increase poverty in an attempt to force a step towards work.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden echter dat het geen pas heeft om armoede te vergroten in een poging een stap naar werk te forceren.
Asks about the purpose of the measure, its incentive effect on non-working partners, and why the timeline differs from the tax-side phase-out.

The PVV members further ask the government why the transferability of the general tax credit in tax law, which lasts 15 years, from 2009 was not aligned with the 20-year phase-out in the reference minimum wage from 2012.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering verder waarom de overdraagbaarheid van de algemene heffingskorting in de fiscaliteit, die 15 jaar bedraagt, vanaf 2009 niet wordt gelijkgeschakeld met de afbouw van 20 jaar zoals die plaats zal vinden vanaf 2012 in het referentieminimumloon.
Accepts the need for the measure for public finances but worries about purchasing-power effects and asks for detailed tables, cumulative effects and alternatives.
They do worry about the consequences for purchasing power, especially because many different measures will follow that may affect benefit recipients.
Zij maken zich wel zorgen over de gevolgen voor de koopkracht, juist ook omdat er al zeer veel verschillende maatregelen zullen volgen die mogelijk de uitkeringsgerechtigden zullen treffen.
Strongly opposes the cut of over one billion euro on minimum benefits and asks how many benefit recipients live in poverty and for overviews of income effects.
The SP members have viewed with horror the bill that is to lead to savings of more than one billion euro on minimum benefits to improve public finances.

De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met afschuw kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel dat moet leiden tot een bezuiniging van meer dan een miljard euro op minimumuitkeringen ter verbetering van de overheidsfinanciën.
Believes work should pay but benefits should not fall below the subsistence minimum; asks whether an Earned Income Tax Credit could be a better alternative.
They believe work should pay, but do not want benefits to fall below the subsistence minimum.
Zij menen dat werken moet lonen, maar willen niet dat uitkeringen onder het bestaansminimum zakken.
Supports the aim that work should be attractive but asks about alternatives, the 20-year phase-out schedule, income effects, and information provided to benefit recipients.
These members support the government's idea that work should be an attractive prospect for benefit recipients, but have several questions about the current proposal.
Deze leden steunen de gedachte van de regering dat werken voor uitkeringsgerechtigden een aantrekkelijk perspectief moet zijn, maar hebben bij het huidige voorstel meerdere vragen.

Insists that benefit recipients must not fall below the social minimum; questions whether the statutory definition of the social minimum is being lowered in real terms and asks for Nibud-based scenarios.
For the SGP members, it is crucial in the final assessment of this bill whether people with a benefit based on the reference minimum wage meet this condition.

Voor de leden van de SGP-fractie is het bij de definitieve beoordeling van dit wetsvoorstel cruciaal of voor mensen met een uitkering die gebaseerd is op het referentieminimumloon aan deze voorwaarde is voldaan.
Questions whether the bill is really about work incentives or about a structural savings of 1,063 million per year, and demands detailed income-effect tables against minimum budget benchmarks.

The PvdA members repeat their urgent request that the income effects and benefit levels resulting from phasing out the double tax credit in the reference minimum wage be set out in a table against the minimum example budget described by the Nibud.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie herhalen met klem de vraag om de inkomenseffecten en de hoogte van de uitkeringen als gevolg van het afbouwen van de dubbele heffingskorting in het referentieminimumloon in een schema af te zetten tegen de door het Nibud omschreven minimumvoorbeeldbegroting
Regrets the government's refusal to give clarity on income effects over twenty years and asks for detailed projections and an independent Nibud study.
These members ask the government to have the Nibud examine how the bill relates to the minimum example budgets.](Source text.)
Deze leden vragen de regering om het Nibud te laten onderzoeken hoe het onderhavige wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot de minimumvoorbeeldbegrotingen
Asks whether the social minimum remains adequate for necessary costs and requests the government relate the bill to Nibud budgets and the SCP report.
The D66 members hold that the social minimum must be sufficient for the necessary costs of getting by.](Source text.)
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat het sociaal minimum toereikend moet zijn voor de noodzakelijke kosten om rond te komen.
Argues the bill departs from the principle that a basic subsistence income is not taxed and asks whether recipients could fall below the social minimum.
Does the government acknowledge that phasing out the double tax credit could mean people fall below the social minimum?
Erkent de regering dat de consequentie van de afbouw van de dubbele heffingskorting in de fiscaliteit en de sociale zekerheid kan zijn dat mensen onder het sociaal minimum uitkomen?
The PvdA says the government refuses to answer several questions needed to properly consider the bill, and asks for factual answers before proceeding.
The PvdA members indicated that they wish to proceed with the bill, but in their view the government refuses to answer a number of questions.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben daarbij aangegeven dat zij de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel verder ter hand wensen te nemen, maar dat de regering naar de mening van deze leden weigert een aantal vragen te beantwoorden.
The SP asks whether the problem that benefit recipients end up with more net income than workers also applies to single persons, requesting further explanation of the government's figures.
Can the government indicate whether the problem identified by these members – that benefit recipients, without intervention, eventually receive more net than workers – also arises for single persons?

Kan de regering aangeven of het door deze leden geconstateerde probleem – dat bijstandsgerechtigden zonder ingrijpen op den duur netto meer krijgen dan werkenden – ook aan de orde is voor alleenstaanden?

32786.s: The bill replaces the deskundigheid (expertise) test with a geschiktheid (suitability) test in the Wft, Wfm BES and Wtt, extends suitability testing to supervisory board members, and strengthens cooperation between AFM and DNB, letting the non-licensing supervisor issue a binding recommendation. It also restricts supervisory discretion in betrouwbaarheid assessments by making certain criminal convictions mandatorily disqualifying via delegated rules.
32786.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the findings of parliamentary inquiries into the financial system and the DSB Bank commission, which called for stronger supervision of board members and better inter-supervisor cooperation.
q: In the current situation, in that case the licensing supervisor has a decisive vote.
In de huidige situatie heeft in dat geval de vergunningverlenende toezichthouder een doorslaggevende stem.
d: criminal offences mandating negative reliability finding
p: Supervisor's discretion over reliability is narrowed by mandatory negative findings for listed convictions, with an eight-year window, but judicial review of the supervisor's own discretion is reduced to a marginal check where the test is bound.
Artikel I, onderdeel C (Wft 1:49) and Artikel II, onderdeel A (Wfm BES 1:17)
The non-licensing supervisor can issue a binding recommendation that the licensing supervisor must follow, shifting decisive weight between two executive agencies.

parties: Asks how the shift of the suitability test to the supervisor finding doubt fits the Twin Peaks model and what the procedure and cooperation with Curaçao and Sint Maarten's central bank will look like.
Can the government further explain how this proposal relates to the Twin Peaks model?
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe dit voorstel zich verhoudt tot het Twin Peaks-model?
Asks which offences lead to a negative integrity judgment, when the test can apply after appointment, and how genuinely new information is established.
How is it determined whether there is (genuinely) new information, the PvdA members ask.
Hoe wordt vastgesteld of sprake is van (echt) nieuwe informatie, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Raises doubts about whether the EU directive allows open norms left to supervisors, the risk of differing interpretations by DNB and AFM, and whether their use can be controlled.
May both supervisors (DNB and AFM) give these norms a different interpretation?
Mogen beide toezichthouders (DNB en AFM) een verschillende invulling geven aan deze normen?

Asks why the integrity requirement is not fixed in the statute rather than in lower regulation, and why offences older than eight years are disregarded, pressing for clearer legal limits on supervisors' discretion.
Why can that not be laid down in the law? What is the biggest objection to it?
Waarom kan dat dan niet in de wet worden vastgelegd? Wat is het grootste bezwaar daartegen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised reconsidering the proposed binding recommendation between AFM and DNB on suitability and integrity tests, and justifying the EU-law compatibility of the suitability requirement. The minister's reply largely explains the rationale and clarifies the EU-law points, while adding only minor drafting changes.
concerns: The binding recommendation by the non-licensing supervisor disrupts the statutory division of tasks between AFM and DNB and may place the licensing supervisor in an awkward position; the government justified the mechanism but did not fully remove the concern.

The explanatory memorandum did not sufficiently demonstrate why the amendment is necessary given the positively evaluated cooperation; the reply supplies a rationale (indivisibility of integrity) and clarifies the general versus specific cooperation picture.

The explanation lacked justification under EU law for stricter suitability requirements; the reply states the new term is not intended to impose stricter rules and is not implementing directives, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
Redactional comments on the bill text were adopted, including wording corrections in articles 1:49 and the Aanwijzingen reference.

32795.s: The bill amends the Primary Education Act to give legal basis to internationally oriented primary education (IGBO) departments within regular primary schools, including English-language instruction and a state funding procedure. It sets admission criteria for these departments, a minimum pupil-number threshold for funding, and conditions under which funding ends or the department is closed.
32795.j: The memorandum justifies the funding conditions and the minister's forecast-based decision as necessary to keep the departments viable and education affordable.
q: The requirements of balanced national distribution of departments and not counting pupils for the forecast where there is room at another IGBO department nearby must guarantee the viability of new and existing departments and keep the education affordable.

Ook de eisen van een evenwichtige landelijke spreiding van afdelingen en het niet meetellen van leerlingen voor de prognose waarvoor binnen een redelijke afstand plaats is op een andere afdeling voor IGBO, moeten de draagkracht van de nieuwe en bestaande afdelingen garanderen en bedoeld onderwijs betaalbaar houden.
d: model for enrolment forecast and manner of submission
minister decides on funding of IGBO department
p: The minister gains discretion to approve or refuse department funding based on a forecast of pupil numbers and a national distribution test.
Funding ends or departments are closed automatically when pupil numbers fall below set thresholds over consecutive years, with specified transition rules.

parties: Points out an incorrect legal citation in the explanatory memorandum and the bill and asks the minister to correct it.
The correct reference, however, is Article 9, tenth paragraph, WPO.
De juiste verwijzing is echter artikel 9, tiende lid, WPO.
Supports the bill, notes it is feasible and enforceable without budgetary consequences, and asks no questions.
They have no questions and hope the wish of the IGBO foundation for this amendment to be enacted quickly can soon be met.
Zij hebben geen vragen en hopen dat snel tegemoet kan worden gekomen aan de wens van de stichting IGBO dat deze wetswijziging spoedig tot stand kan komen.
Welcomes the statutory anchoring of IGBO departments and supports the bill's aim.
The CDA members have noted with pleasure the underlying bill, which provides statutory anchoring for internationally oriented primary education departments, and support the thrust of this bill.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met genoegen kennisgenomen van het onderliggende wetsvoorstel dat een wettelijke verankering biedt voor afdelingen voor internationaal georiënteerd basisonderwijs en ondersteunen de strekking van dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks how IGBO costs are split between employers, parents and government, whether study costs differ from ordinary schools, and what the eligibility period is.
What period is involved, these members ask.
Over welke termijn gaat het, zo vragen deze leden.
Has noted the bill with interest and sees no reason to ask questions at this stage.
At this moment they see no reason to ask questions.
Zij zien op dit moment geen aanleiding voor het stellen van vragen.

32885.s: The bill implements three EU framework decisions (2008/909/JBZ, 2008/947/JBZ, 2009/299/JBZ) on mutual recognition and transfer of enforcement of custodial and alternative criminal sentences, including suspended sentences, probation and community service. It sets out the Minister of Justice's competence and a judicial review role by the Arnhem Court of Appeal's special chamber for foreign custodial sentences, while the public prosecutor handles non-custodial measures.
32885.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and transfer powers by EU framework decision obligations and the aim of resocialisation of offenders.
q: The decisions to be taken under the framework decisions essentially concern whether enforcement of a sentence can be transferred to another EU Member State for the purpose of the offender's resocialisation.

De beslissingen die op grond van de kaderbesluiten moeten worden genomen betreffen in essentie de vraag of de tenuitvoerlegging van een straf kan worden overgedragen aan een andere lidstaat van de EU met het oog op de resocialisatie van de veroordeelde
d: Minister competent for recognition and transmission of custodial judgments
additional supervisable obligations that may be enforced in NL
p: Ministerial consent to transfer and the defendant's consent are dispensed with in many cases, reducing individual control over transfer of enforcement.
The Minister decides on recognition, with the court's role limited to a non-binding assessment of refusal grounds and adaptation of the sentence.[Note: recognition decision rests with the Minister.]
For non-custodial sentences the public prosecutor, not a judge, decides recognition and enforcement, with no court role unless the citizen goes to civil court.

parties: Supports faster, more efficient cross-border cooperation on sanctions and mutual recognition, and asks about the criteria for binding to the Netherlands.
They are, as they have indicated before, in favour of making cooperation in criminal matters between member states faster and more efficient.
Zij zijn er, zoals zij al eerder hebben aangegeven, een voorstander van om de samenwerking in strafzaken tussen de lidstaten sneller en efficiënter te laten verlopen.
Supports European cooperation but is reserved on mutual recognition; questions the limited role of the Dutch judge and whether the convicted person has adequate legal remedies.
These members share the concerns of these organisations about the inadequate legal protection of the convicted person.
De aan het woord zijnde leden delen de zorgen van deze organisaties als het gaat over de gebrekkige rechtsbescherming voor de veroordeelde.
Asks about expected reductions of sentences for drug offences, the discretion to take account of early release in other states, and the criteria used by the Netherlands.
These members note that this is a possibility and not an obligation.
Deze leden constateren dat het een mogelijkheid is en geen verplichting.
Supports mutual recognition and resocialisation but asks how supervision by other member states will be guaranteed and what the financial consequences are.
These members ask what the financial consequences of all this are.
Deze leden vragen wat van dit alles de financiële gevolgen zijn.
Questions how far blind trust in other member states' judicial systems can go without any possibility to check the verdict, and raises capacity and transport safety concerns.
These members fundamentally ask how far trust can go, without any possibility of checking the correctness of the verdict or the care of the criminal process, in the law of other EU member states.

Deze leden stellen ten principale de vraag hoe ver het vertrouwen, zonder enige mogelijkheid van controle op de juistheid van het vonnis of zorgvuldigheid van het strafproces, in het recht van andere EU-lidstaten mag gaan.
Criticises the absence of a hearing, legal counsel and motivated decisions for the convicted person, and asks for a clear procedure and legal remedy.
