He receives no counsel, he is not heard, decisions concerning him need not be motivated, and the bill grants him no legal remedy.
Hij krijgt geen raadsman, hij wordt niet gehoord en beslissingen die hem betreffen behoeven niet te worden gemotiveerd en het wetsvoorstel kent hem geen rechtsmiddel toe.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing three EU framework decisions on mutual recognition of custodial and alternative sentences, but advises revisions on the relation with the EAW, conditional release timing, life sentences, the Handvest reference, and placement in a separate law. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, explains its discretion over early conditional release, the handling of life sentences via conversion to a temporary sentence, and why a separate law is preferred, and makes the advised drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller explanation of how the Kaderbesluit EAB relates to Kaderbesluit 2008/909/JBZ for surrender of own nationals, which the government added in the memorie van toelichting.
The Afdeling asked the government to explain how the minister will exercise its discretion to advance the conditional release date, and the government clarified this in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling found the conversion of a foreign life sentence into a temporary sentence inconsistent with Article 8(2) of the framework decision and the bill, and the government aligned the explanation and the bill with the framework decision's no-aggravation principle.

The Afdeling noted that Article 47 of the EU Charter has a narrower scope than Article 6 ECHR, and the government accepted this and explained that legal protection is available through the civil court.
The Afdeling gave editorial remarks on cross-references and the transposition table, which were adopted.

The Afdeling advised explaining the timeline for merging this bill into the Wet wederzijdse erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke sancties 2008, but the government saw no reason to merge the laws now.

33480-III.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the Queen and the Commission for oversight of intelligence and security services, mainly through supplementary budget adjustments tied to the autumn budget memorandum. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from 1 December 2012.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2012 to the budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the Queen and the Commission for oversight of intelligence and security services (III).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2012 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet der Koningin en de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (III).

33488.s: The bill tackles forced marriage by letting the public prosecutor block a marriage with court authorisation, widening the grounds and standing for annulment of forced marriages, and banning marriage below eighteen. It also tightens recognition of foreign marriages contrary to Dutch public order, including polygamous ones.
33488.j: The memorandum justifies the prosecutor's blocking and annulment powers by the difficulty of proving coercion and the need to protect vulnerable persons, while noting the power is subject to prior court authorisation.
q: For that reason it is proposed to give the public prosecutor the power to block a proposed marriage where it has sufficiently appeared that a marriage threatens to be concluded under coercion.

Om die reden wordt voorgesteld om het openbaar ministerie de bevoegdheid te verlenen om, indien genoegzaam is gebleken dat er onder invloed van dwang een huwelijk dreigt te worden gesloten, dit voorgenomen huwelijk te stuiten.
p: Artikel I onderdeel H (artikel 53 lid 3-4 Boek 1 BW)
The public prosecutor gains power to block a marriage where forced marriage is likely, subject to prior court authorisation.
Artikel I onderdeel J (artikel 71 Boek 1 BW)
The public prosecutor may petition for annulment of a forced marriage, a discretionary power that intrudes on private life and is bounded by the court annulment process.
Artikel II onderdeel C (artikel 32 Boek 10 BW)
Recognition of foreign marriages may be refused on public order grounds, with listed specific grounds, leaving room for administrative discretion.

parties: Asks whether the bill should be broader than cousin marriages and how the OM's power to halt marriages will work in practice.
They ask whether the proposal should not be drawn more broadly.
Vragen zij of het voorstel niet breder zou moeten worden getrokken.
Asks whether the chosen measures are effective enough to protect those affected and requests data on the extent of forced marriage.
They maintain that mapping the extent of forced marriage is necessary to formulate and carry out effective policy.
Zij blijven van mening dat het in beeld brengen van de omvang van het verschijnsel huwelijksdwang noodzakelijk is voor het formuleren en uitvoeren van effectief beleid ter zake.
Asks whether separate registration of forced marriage is possible and fears the OM will not always intervene when signals exist.
These members believe that where a marriage is threatened under coercion, the OM must always intervene.
Voornoemde leden menen dat in situaties waar onder invloed van dwang een huwelijk dreigt te worden gesloten het OM te allen tijde dient in te grijpen.
Supports OM powers but argues prevention should come first and questions the civil registry officer's position and safety, and the lack of data.
Everything must be done to detect and prevent coercion when marrying and to protect the (potential) victims.
Er moet alles aan worden gedaan om dwang bij het sluiten van een huwelijk te signaleren en te voorkomen en de (mogelijke) slachtoffers in bescherming te nemen.
Welcomes the measures but asks how investigations by police and OM will work and whether they will always occur.
These members ask whether such investigation will always take place and how burdensome it is for police and OM to investigate signals.
Voornoemde leden vragen of zulk onderzoek altijd zal plaatsvinden en hoe bewerkelijk het is voor de politie en het OM naar aanleiding van de binnengekomen signalen nader onderzoek te doen.
Asks about residence-permit consequences of annulment and whether other groups face elevated coercion risk.
For which other situations does it apply that an elevated risk of coercion is plausible?
Voor welke andere situaties geld dat het aannemelijk is dat er een verhoogd risico op dwang bestaat.
Asks why the minor-age exemption is being abolished and what legal consequences follow, and questions safeguards distinguishing coercion from genuine wishes to stay married.
These members ask what safeguards are built in to distinguish coercion from a sincere wish to keep the marriage.

Zij vragen welke waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om een goed onderscheid te kunnen maken tussen situaties waar sprake is van dwang en situaties waar sprake is van een oprechte wens om het huwelijk in stand te houden.
Notes the Council of State's criticism that the cousin-marriage measure is ineffective and stigmatising, and asks for evidence and prevention instead.
These members fear that this proposal leads to further stigmatisation and discrimination of these marriages.
Deze leden vrezen dat dit voorstel tot verdere stigmatisering en discriminatie van deze huwelijken leidt.
Asks why only one group must declare free consent, whether the annulment grounds are too strict, and how the time limits are applied, referring to the Council of State's advice.
They would like to know on what basis the government concludes that the statutory requirements for annulment are nonetheless too strict.
Graag vernemen zij op basis waarvan de regering tot de conclusie komt dat er toch sprake is van te strenge wettelijke eisen voor nietigverklaring.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the proposed ban on marriages between cousins in the third or fourth degree, arguing the justification is weak and the effectiveness low, and advised revising the polygamous marriage recognition and court-initiated annulment provisions. The government's reply accepted the advice on the polygamy and annulment points and on transitional and drafting matters, but maintained the cousin marriage measure, arguing it forms the final element of a broader anti-forced-marriage approach.
concerns: The Afdeling found the distinction for cousin marriages insufficiently justified and advised abandoning the impediment and the sworn declaration, which the government did not accept.
The Afdeling expected the sworn declaration to be ineffective and possibly counterproductive, deterring victims from seeking help; the government disagreed.
The Afdeling advised that the interests of victims of forced marriage should take precedence over public order in court-initiated annulment, which the government adopted.
The Afdeling asked for justification of the criterion of habitual residence in the Netherlands for recognising polygamous marriages, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling flagged the link between the new impediment and residence-permit family reunification rules and the mismatch between habitual residence and municipal registration; the government addressed these in the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling offered numerous drafting corrections and a transitional provision and savings clause, which were adopted.

33569.s: The bill amends the Dutch Notaries Act and related laws to change the legalisation of notarial signatures so that presidents of district courts handle it, and makes various technical and wording corrections. It also reshapes the disciplinary complaint rules, allowing the disciplinary judge to depart from the three-year limitation period where the claimant cannot reasonably be blamed for its expiry, and transfers oversight functions to the new chambers for notaries.
33569.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical and redactional improvements, and justifies the disciplinary time-limit exception by the need for the supervisory body to examine conduct older than three years.
q: With the proposed change, the disciplinary judge may, when assessing the admissibility of the complaint, depart from the limitation period if its expiry cannot reasonably be attributed to the complainant.

Met de voorgestelde wijziging kan de tuchtrechter bij de beoordeling van de ontvankelijkheid van de ingediende klacht afwijken van de vervaltermijn indien de afloop van deze termijn redelijkerwijs niet aan de klager verweten kan worden.
d: content and manner of submitting financial and other data to the Bureau
p: Allows the chair to suspend a complaint and gives the disciplinary judge discretion to avoid declaring a complaint inadmissible after the limitation period where the claimant cannot reasonably be blamed, which strengthens protection for complainants.
Requires the chamber to notify the notary in writing of the decision and how to appeal, and sends copies of decisions to the KNB and the Bureau.

parties: Asks why the amendments were not included in the earlier bill, what developments prompted them, and how notary quality is guaranteed if qualification requirements are relaxed.
After all, is there no reason for the requirements for appointment as notary or deputy to be stricter than those for candidate notaries?
Is er immers geen reden om de eisen voor de benoeming tot notaris c.q. waarnemer ten opzichte van de eisen voor de kandidaat-notaris zwaarder te laten zijn?
Argues the bill lacks a sufficient legal basis for the Financial Regulation and urges explicit statutory prohibitions and broader incident reporting covering quality and integrity.
However, the BFT is of the view that the bill provides insufficient legal basis for that regulation and that an addition to the law on this point is desirable.
Het BFT is echter van mening dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel onvoldoende wettelijke basis voor die verordening biedt en dat een aanvulling van de wet op dit punt gewenst is.
Asks what 'reasonably cannot be judged' means for the exception to the three-year complaint limitation and whether the BFT's supervisory instruments are adequate.
They ask whether the BFT's legal instruments for supervising notaries are adequate enough, given the proposals.
Zij vragen of het wettelijk instrumentarium van de BFT ten aanzien van de controle op notarissen wel adequaat genoeg is, gelet op de voorstellen.
Questions the vague complaint-exception standard, suggests a clear five-year limit, asks about sanctions for late reporting of side positions, and about privacy in the digital system.
These members fear that this exception is vague and open to multiple interpretations in practice.
Deze leden vrezen dat deze uitzondering vaag is en in de praktijk voor meerdere interpretaties vatbaar.

Accepts the proposed amendments given the clear treatment of consulted bodies' comments, and asks why the KNB's reporting rules were left to lower regulation and when the Minister will decide on digital submission.
They ask why it was chosen to include this in lower regulations rather than in the law itself.
Deze leden vragen waarom gekozen is voor opname in de lagere regelgeving en niet in de wet.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill amending the Notaries Act but objects to the relaxed appointment requirements for notaries and deputies, the proposed hardship clause on the complaint limitation period, and labelling a substantive amendment as a 'veegwet'. The government reply accepts the advice to justify the relaxed requirements and to rename the bill, and largely reframes the hardship clause as an adjustment to the limitation period, with redactional points also adopted.
concerns: The relaxation of appointment requirements for notaries and deputies needed a sound justification, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
The hardship clause is not an effective instrument for the BFT's concern about the three-year limitation period; alternatives such as extending the period should be considered.
The bill should not be labelled a veegwet because it contains substantive proposals; it should be called a bill amending the Notaries Act.
Redactional comments on wording and cross-references were largely adopted, though the suggestion to limit withdrawal powers to the chamber chair was not followed.

33659.s: The bill abolishes the mandatory cooperation in plusregio's (Chapter XI of the Wgr), redistributing their powers to provinces and municipalities and amending the Huisvestingswet, Wet BDU, Wet personenvervoer 2000 and related laws. It includes transitional rules for existing housing ordinances, concessions, transport plans and youth care delegations.
33659.j: The memorandum justifies transferring tasks by reference to the bestuursafspraken on governmental levels' task profiles and retaining intermunicipal coordination of housing where needed for balanced allocation.
q: The cabinet considers it important that a form of intermunicipal policy coordination in housing market regions where necessary for a balanced allocation of housing be retained.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat een vorm van intergemeentelijke beleidscoördinatie in woningmarktregio's waar dat voor een evenwichtige woonruimteverdeling noodzakelijk is, behouden blijft.
d: provincial transfer of youth care powers to regional bodies
provincial designation of housing market region
designation by general administrative order of areas where regional body grants concessions
p: Abolition of plusregio's removes a permanent regional body and shifts its tasks to provinces and municipalities.
Provincial executive may designate housing market regions and force a joint regional housing ordinance, expiring existing municipal ordinances after one year.
Competent authority under the soil protection act shifts from provincial bodies to municipal bodies.

parties: Asks what happens if a province declines a municipal request for a housing regulation area and how a transport region can be formed or refused.
Do the municipalities concerned then have another way to reach such a regulation, or must they take up the matter themselves?
Hebben de betrokken gemeenten dan nog een andere mogelijkheid om tot zo'n verordening te komen of moeten ze dit onderwerp dan zelf oppakken?
Asks whether provinces can impose mandatory cooperation on municipalities in housing matters while having no substantive role.

Questions how a province can compel several municipalities to cooperate on housing at one municipality's request, contrary to the bottom-up principle, and raises democratic legitimacy of majority voting in cooperations.
Do these members understand correctly that one municipality can ask the province, and the province can then force several municipalities to enter such an arrangement?
Begrijpen deze leden het goed dat één gemeente de provincie kan verzoeken, en dat deze laatste vervolgens meerdere gemeenten kan dwingen een dergelijke regeling aan te gaan?
Asks about democratic legitimacy versus efficiency and whether provinces should be given transport tasks and BDU funds for the Randstad regions.
To what extent does democratic legitimacy conflict with the desired effectiveness in public administration?
In hoeverre staat democratische legitimatie op gespannen voet met de gewenste slagvaardigheid in het openbaar bestuur?
Objects that the two transport regions do not meet the requirement of direct democratic accountability set by a motion, and asks why this undemocratic construction was chosen.
They ask the government why it chose this undemocratic construction involving the metropolitan regions.
Zij vragen de regering waarom gekozen is voor deze ondemocratische constructie waarbij de metropoolregio's betrokken zijn.
Notes that the transport region structure lacks direct democratic legitimacy and asks about the financing and accountability of the new regions.
the construction of transport regions also lacks direct democratic legitimacy, an objection that previously applied to the Wgr-plus regions.
ook de constructie van vervoersregio's een directe democratische legitimatie mist, een bezwaar dat eerder de Wgr-plusregio's gold.
Asks whether mandatory transport regions and mandatory housing arrangements fit with municipal autonomy and decentralisation principles.
Does this fit the principle of municipal autonomy and decentralisation?
Past dit wel bij het principe van gemeentelijke autonomie en decentralisatie?
Asks why the Utrecht region is treated differently in transport tasks and whether BDU funds will be labelled for urban transport.
Can the government further explain why it does not consider the desirability of direct allocation of public transport tasks and BDU funds to apply to Utrecht?
Kan de regering voorts aangeven waarom zij inhoudelijk en bestuurlijk de wenselijkheid van rechtstreekse toekenning van OV-taken en BDU-middelen niet vindt gelden voor Utrecht?
Asks whether municipalities can continue the arrangements voluntarily under the Wgr and what powers and funds would be lost.
Can the participating municipal boards choose to continue the arrangements voluntarily on the basis of the Wgr?
Kunnen de aangesloten gemeentebesturen er voor kiezen de verbanden op vrijwillige basis voort te zetten op basis van de Wgr?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised in 2012 against abolishing the Wgr-plus metropolitan regions (stadsregio's) without adequate replacement, criticising the thin motivation and ignored evaluations. The government's 2013 reply largely rejected these objections, adding a justification for the two transport regions and a transitional regime for youth care, while keeping the abolition.
concerns: The Afdeling found the motivation for abolishing the plusregio's insufficient and the evaluations unaddressed; the government replied that the evaluations are acknowledged but that it no longer sees a need for a statutory obligation.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the choice of only two transport regions and of the transfer of finances and tasks; the government added explanation and a transitional regulation.
The Afdeling raised the scale and competence overlap of provinces versus the new regions; the government accepted that provincial scale merits review and added a passage on it.
The Afdeling asked for mandatory consultation with municipalities; the government stated sufficient consultation already occurred under Gemeentewet art. 114.
The Afdeling made numerous drafting remarks, most of which were incorporated, with a few rejected with reasons.

33686.s: The bill inserts a new article 2.23a into the Environmental Management Act allowing the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment to set fees for its advisory reports to cover costs, subject to ministerial approval. It also applies General Administrative Law Act provisions on approval procedures to those fee decisions.
33686.j: The memorandum justifies the fee power by the need to ensure the commission's costs are covered and notes that users are consulted on proposed fees before they are set.
q: The fees referred to in the first paragraph are directly related to the advisory reports referred to in that paragraph and do not exceed what is necessary to cover the costs incurred for those reports.
De in het eerste lid bedoelde tarieven hebben een rechtstreeks verband met de in dat lid bedoelde adviezen en belopen niet meer dan nodig is ter dekking van de gemaakte kosten voor die adviezen.
d: setting fees for commission advisory reports

parties: Asks whether voluntary advice requested by initiators is publicly funded and whether the Commission must run cost-recovering tariffs, and how the ministry can influence the price/quality ratio through approval.
The VVD members ask whether voluntary advice is also requested by initiators and whether the government then also funds it under the current system.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of vrijwillige adviezen ook door initiatiefnemers worden aangevraagd en of de overheid ze dan ook bekostigt in het huidige systeem.
Has taken note of the bill and has no need to submit questions or input on the amendment.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill and have no need to provide input on the amendment of the Wet milieubeheer.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen behoefte om inbreng te leveren met betrekking tot de wijziging van de Wet milieubeheer.
Has taken note of the bill and currently has no questions.
The PVV members have taken note of the bill and at this time have no need to ask questions.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben op dit moment geen behoefte tot het stellen van vragen.

Worries that the funding change undermines the Commission voor de m.e.r.'s statutory advisory role and critical capacity, and asks how quality and independent advice are safeguarded under uncertain income.
The SP members are not at all reassured that the valuable contribution of the Commissie voor de m.e.r. will be safeguarded by this amendment proposal.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn er allerminst gerust op dat de waardevolle bijdrage van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. met onderhavig wijzigingsvoorstel geborgd blijft.
Has taken note of the bill and has no further questions.

Fears charging for voluntary advice will reduce requests and harm environmental quality, questions the ministry's dual role in setting and approving tariffs, and asks about consultation and reconsideration of the compensation decision.
The D66 members note that the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment is one of the parties given the opportunity to state its views on the level of the proposed tariffs.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu een van de partijen is die in de gelegenheid wordt gesteld om hun opvattingen over de hoogte van de voorgestelde tarieven kenbaar te maken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill allowing the Commission for Environmental Impact Assessment to charge fees for its advice but asks for better justification of consequences, the choice for commission-set tariffs, and safeguards against cross-subsidy and market distortion. The government reply largely accepts the drafting remarks, defends the commission's independence and cost-recovery approach, and explains why the Stichting Bureau is not named in the statute.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller analysis of the necessity and consequences of charging fees, including effects on decision quality and environmental goals, which the government only partly addresses by adding a section on cost passing-on while calling the risks negligible.
The Afdeling questions why tariff-setting power is given to the commission itself rather than the minister, and the government defends commission-set tariffs subject to ministerial approval.

The Afdeling warns the bill lacks safeguards against cross-subsidy between mandatory and optional advice, which could distort the market; the government disagrees that the commission competes in a market but points to tariff approval and separate cost reporting as safeguards.

The Afdeling makes drafting points on the wording of the tariff-setting provision and the order of subsections, which the government adopts, while declining to name the Stichting Bureau in the statute.

33749.s: The bill amends the Dutch Work of Foreigners Act and the Aliens Act 2000 to implement EU Directive 2011/98/EU by creating a combined residence and work permit (GVVA) handled by the IND, with UWV giving advice on labour aspects. It also removes suspensive effect of appeals against withdrawal of work permits and applies comparable refusal and withdrawal grounds to the combined permit.
33749.j: The memorandum justifies the shift by saying continued work during appeal is undesirable after an employer violation has been established, and that the combined permit must be governed by the same conditions as the work permit.
q: As a result, once the work permit is withdrawn the foreign national can immediately no longer work for the employer concerned, including during the objection and appeal procedure.
Hierdoor kan de vreemdeling zodra de twv is ingetrokken meteen niet meer werken bij de betreffende werkgever (ook niet gedurende de bezwaar- en beroepsprocedure).
d: rules on the advisory procedure by UWV
delegation of minister's permit powers to UWV
identifying data to be stated on permits
p: Withdrawal of a work permit no longer has suspensive effect during objection and appeal, so the foreign worker must stop working while the challenge is pending.

The minister may refuse or withdraw a combined permit on other grounds without first obtaining the required advice, with the explanatory memorandum noting a new decision may follow if a court finds the refusal wrongful.

parties: Asks whether the IND may depart from the UWV advice, and how the advisory process and enforcement by the Inspectie SZW are accountable.
Is this advice binding on the IND? In other words, may the IND deviate from the UWV advice?
Is dit advies bindend voor het IND? Met andere woorden, mag de IND afwijken van het advies van het UWV.
Asks how much weight the UWV advice carries for the IND and how much room the IND has to depart from it, and what the fraud sensitivity of the new procedure is.
How much weight does the advice the UWV gives to the IND carry in granting the permit?
Hoe zwaarwegend weegt het advies dat het UWV geeft aan de IND voor het verstrekken van de vergunning?
Asks whether the access conditions to the labour market are unchanged and whether the UWV advice will always be binding.
The SP members ask whether the UWV advice will always be binding, so that the IND can never grant a work permit if the UWV advises against one.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het advies van het UWV altijd bindend zal zijn en de IND dus nooit iemand vergunning tot arbeid kan verlenen indien het UWV geen vergunning voor arbeid adviseert
Asks about the consequences of late UWV advice and of exceeding the advice period, whether the Wet dwangsom applies, and whether a negative UWV advice automatically means no GVVA.
These members also ask for further explanation of whether the UWV advice is binding on the IND and whether a negative UWV advice automatically means the IND will also not issue a GVVA.
Tevens vragen deze leden om een nadere toelichting of de adviezen van het UWV aan de IND bindend zijn en een negatief advies van het UWV automatisch betekend dat de IND dus ook geen GVVA zal afgeven.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing Directive 2011/98/EU on a single application procedure and common rights for third-country workers, but asks for clarification of how the combined permit, residence card and supplementary document relate, and for the transitional regime to be adjusted so that the Directive applies directly to applications after 25 December 2013. The government's reply accepts these points, redefines the combined permit to include the supplementary document, limits retroactive effect to pre-deadline applications, and adopts the redactional corrections.
concerns: The bill, explanatory memorandum and transposition table did not clearly explain how the combined permit, the residence card and the supplementary document implement Articles 4(2), 5(3) and 6(1) of the Directive; the government redefined the combined permit and clarified the documents.

The retroactive effect (eerbiedigende werking) of the transitional provision risks conflict with the Directive where applications were filed after the transposition deadline; the government limited retroactive effect to applications filed before 25 December 2013.

The Dutch language version of Article 4(4) of the Directive differs from the French, English and German versions; the Council advised contacting the Commission and Council secretariat to rectify it, which the government accepted.
Redactional corrections to cross-references in the Wav and Vw2000 were proposed; the government adopted them except the first, already addressed in a separate bill.

33750-III.s: This bill formally sets the 2014 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs, its agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, the Royal Cabinet, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It is a routine annual budget law with no delegation of rule-making power or change in the balance between executive and checks.
q: The present statutory articles aim to fix the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services for the year 2014.

De onderhavige wetsartikelen strekken ertoe om de begrotingsstaten van respectievelijk het ministerie van Algemene Zaken, van het Kabinet van de Koning en van de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten voor het jaar 2014 vast te stellen.

33839.s: The bill establishes a basisregistratie ondergrond (basic subsurface registry) holding authentic data and models on Dutch subsurface and continental shelf, managed by the minister with an operational concession to TNO. It sets rules for reporting source documents, mandatory use of authentic data by public bodies, and procedures for disputed entries.
33839.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to adapt to new developments and to avoid fragmented sector-specific rules across many laws.
q: By designating the source documents by general administrative order rather than by statute, it is easier to respond to new developments.
Door de brondocumenten bij algemene maatregel van bestuur en niet bij wet aan te wijzen, kan eenvoudiger worden ingespeeld op nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
d: technical and administrative setup, operation and security of the registry
elements and method of the periodic control
manner of delivering source documents to the minister
designation of source documents to be delivered
further rules on source documents for the registry
designation of additional non-authentic and authentic data and models
rules on inspection and provision of data
exemptions from duty to report doubts and limits on reporting bodies
mandate to Organisation board to take decisions for the minister
p: Public bodies may use other data than authentic data where a statute otherwise provides, narrowing the mandatory-use duty.
Citizens need not supply authentic data to a public body where a statute so provides, a limited exception to the once-only principle.
The minister may order further investigation by the source holder and flag disputed data 'in onderzoek', suspending the mandatory-use duty during review.

parties: Asks whether preconditions for implementation (data delivery, detailed planning, funding, protocols, helpdesk, software readiness) will be met, and why all subsurface data are not included.
The VVD members support the principle of the subsurface register to centrally store subsurface data.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen het principe van de basisregistratie ondergrond om gegevens over de ondergrond centraal op te slaan.
Asks about the involvement of the House in adopting general administrative measures and requests a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure.
The PvdA members ask the government to explain why the bill does not provide for parliamentary involvement in adopting general administrative measures through a pre-consultation procedure.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering nader in te gaan op de vraag waarom het wetsvoorstel niet voorziet in de betrokkenheid van de Kamer bij de vaststelling van algemene maatregelen van bestuur door middel van een voorhangprocedure.

Criticises delegation of key content to general administrative measures and ministerial regulations, which sidelines the House, and asks about supervision, sanctions and the controls on confidential personal data.
The SP members consider that the choice to enact a limited law and regulate further elaboration by general administrative measure or ministerial regulation sidelines the House.

De keuze om een beperkte wet op te tuigen en verdere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel te regelen krachtens of bij algemene maatregel van bestuur of bij ministeriële regeling zet de Kamer volgens deze leden buiten spel.
Raises concern about governance, unclear stakeholder involvement, undefined constructions left to ministerial regulation, and asks for clarity on information security.
Asks how information security and privacy are safeguarded, and what the College bescherming persoonsgegevens said about internet publication of data.
These members also consider it very important that privacy is guaranteed and that the use of personal data is handled carefully.
Ook vinden deze leden het van groot belang dat de privacy gewaarborgd is en dat nauwkeurig wordt omgegaan met het gebruik van persoonsgegevens.
Asks about information security mechanisms, the risks of broadening scope, and the implementation timeline and cost burden for municipalities.
Well-functioning mechanisms are essential within the subsurface register, because most deliveries and consultations will take place through authorised parties.

Goed werkende mechanismen zijn binnen de basisregistratie ondergrond van wezenlijk belang, omdat het grootste gedeelte van de leveringen en raadplegingen gevolmachtigd (door het bedrijfsleven) zal plaatsvinden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Wet basisregistratie ondergrond (subsurface base registry) but raises points on accessibility and Inspire-compatibility, procurement of TNO without tender, completeness (cables and pipes excluded, ministerial confidential data, brondocumenten obligations), liability, internet disclosure and personal data, and financial underpinning, advising adjustments before submission. The minister's nader rapport largely accepts the points on procurement, liability, disclosure, personal data, and finances, while rejecting moving the source-document obligations into sectoral laws and not adding cables and pipes to the registry.
concerns: Advice to explain how Inspire obligations on accessibility and interoperability will be met; the memorie was supplemented but no technical description was added.
Procurement basis was wrongly referenced to the Besluit aanbestedingsregels; the reference was corrected to the Aanbestedingswet and the exemption explained.
Completeness concern that cables and pipes are excluded and the added value of the registry is limited; government disagrees and does not add them.
Advice to place the duty for authorities to deliver source documents in sectoral laws to improve compliance; government rejects this as fragmenting regulation.
Advice that the confidential-data exception for mining data should be reconsidered and public disclosure of certain data considered; government will review this in the AMvB process.
Advice to allow anyone to report inaccuracies, and to preserve the right of access to one's own personal data under the Wbp; both adopted.
Advice to clarify liability of the registry holder and of authorities and citizens relying on authentic data; memorie aanvuld.
Advice to substantiate the claimed efficiency benefits of 5.8 million euro per year; memorie supplemented, with further detail deferred to the AMvB.
Redactional comments on definitions, the Aw doorzendplicht, and transposition table; largely adopted except the transposition table and Inspire references.

33866.s: The bill amends the Dutch International Crimes Act to implement the 2010 Kampala amendments to the Rome Statute, extending jurisdiction over Dutch officials and vehicles, adding prohibited weapons, and creating a new offence of aggression (art. 8b) for state leaders. The entry into force is left to royal decree, which may set different dates for different parts of article I.
33866.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as implementing international obligations and notes that the Dutch courts must interpret offences in line with international law and the Elements of Crimes.
q: The articles of this act enter into force on a date to be set by royal decree, which may differ for the different parts of article I.
Artikel II De artikelen van deze wet treden in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip, dat voor de verschillende onderdelen van artikel I verschillend kan worden vastgesteld.
d: entry into force of the articles by royal decree

parties: Asks what the added value of the WIM is relative to the ICC and national judges, and whether prosecution in the Netherlands or at the ICC is preferable.
What is the added value of the WIM when it comes to prosecution and adjudication of the crime of aggression?
Wat is de toegevoegde waarde van de WIM als het gaat om vervolging en berechting ten aanzien van het misdrijf agressie?
Asks whether budgetary or capacity reasons could lead to not pursuing such cases, and whether consultation with the courts and prosecutors on workload and funding will occur.
These members ask whether there is a chance that for capacity or budgetary reasons, pursuing these kinds of cases will be abandoned.
Deze leden vragen of de kans aanwezig is dat om capaciteits- of budgettaire redenen wordt afgezien van het oppakken van dit soort zaken.
Welcomes that all advice of the Council of State has been adopted and sees no reason for additional questions.
They are pleased to read that the government has adopted all advice of the Council of State's advisory division.
Zij zijn verheugd te lezen dat de regering alle adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft overgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing the Kampala amendments adding the crime of aggression to the ICC, but advises clarifying the scope of the prohibition of aggression, the Dutch criminal jurisdiction (which should cover attacks on Dutch territory, ports, coasts or armed forces, not only Dutch nationals), and the position on dumdum bullets. The government's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended in line with these points, including the jurisdiction rule and explanatory notes on exceptions and bullets.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the current state of international law on exceptions to the prohibition of aggression and whether these should be reflected in the offence definition.

The Afdeling advised examining whether Dutch criminal jurisdiction over aggression should extend to attacks against Dutch territory, ports, coasts or armed forces, not only to offences against Dutch nationals.

The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that Dutch courts will assess dum-dum bullet cases only against the offence definition itself, and addressing whether the government shares the view that such bullets should remain usable in certain police operations.
The Afdeling made redactional comments on the wording of the Dutch translation of the Kampala amendments, which the government adopted.

33884.s: The bill sets new rules for measurement units and measuring instruments in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, requiring certification (ijk) and re-certification of covered instruments and creating a designated authority to carry out verification and supervision. It also amends the Warenwet BES and the Wetboek van Strafrecht BES on packaged goods and measurement fraud, and repeals the earlier IJkwet BES.
33884.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to tailor the rules to Caribbean Netherlands' scale and needs, and to leave technical detail to later ministerial regulations developed with the island executives.
q: The Bestuurscollege designates one authority tasked, subject to this Act, with performing certification and re-certification of instruments covered by rules under Article 3.

Het bestuurscollege wijst één instantie aan die tot taak heeft met inachtneming van het bij of krachtens deze wet bepaalde: a. ten aanzien van meetinstrumenten, waarvoor bij of krachtens artikel 3 voorschriften zijn gegeven, de ijk en herijk te verrichten
d: measurement units and standards for quantities
which measuring instruments require certification and their requirements
designation of the competent authority by the Bestuurscollege
organisation and working method of the authority by island ordinance
maximum fees for certification work by island ordinance
designation of inspectors by the Bestuurscollege
Bestuurscollege may order the authority to enforce compliance
p: Inspectors may enter any place except a dwelling without the occupant's consent, take instruments and records, and use the police's 'sterke arm' to gain access, with duty of cooperation imposed on everyone.
Seized instruments are not returned to the owner until certified or re-certified at the owner's cost.
The Minister may demand all data and documents from the competent authority and require it to submit to an audit of its compliance.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the IJkwet BES 2014 bill on measurement units and instruments for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, but asks the government to state in the explanatory memorandum why it departs from the five-year principle of legislative restraint after the constitutional reforms, and gives drafting remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) states it has clarified in the memorandum that the need for a modernised measurement system was already recognised when the 2010 act was drafted, and has adopted the drafting remarks except one on article 17, which it kept for better coverage of the provision.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to give reasons for departing from the principle of legislative restraint after the constitutional reforms, which the government accepted by clarifying the memorandum.

The Afdeling makes several drafting suggestions, including rewording of articles 1, 3, 7 and 8 and the chapter 5 heading, which were adopted, while its suggestion to change the power in article 17 was not followed.

33930-III.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statutes (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of General Affairs, the King's Cabinet, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency, adjusting appropriations and realised outcomes in euros. It is a supplementary closing law (slotwet) with no delegation of rule-making power, no shift of power to the executive, and no oversight changes.
q: The change is mainly the result of the personnel establishment not being fully staffed during the year.
De mutatie is hoofdzakelijk het gevolg van een niet volledige bezetting van de personele formatie gedurende het jaar.

33947.s: The bill adds a fifth paragraph to article 23 of the Fisheries Act 1963 so that written permission for angling with one or more rods need not carry the required data on paper, provided the grantor makes that data available electronically. The holder must be able to show the electronically available data to an enforcement officer on first demand.
q: it is desirable to provide for the possibility of supplying the data of the written permission for sport anglers electronically
het wenselijk is te voorzien in de mogelijkheid om gegevens van de schriftelijke toestemming voor sportvissers elektronisch te verstrekken

parties: Asks the government whether and by which criteria the licensing system under the Fisheries Act has been evaluated since its introduction.
are curious to what extent the licensing system has been evaluated since the introduction of the Fisheries Act.
zijn wel benieuwd in hoeverre het stelsel van vergunningverlening is geëvalueerd sinds de invoering van de Visserijwet.

33956.s: The bill amends the Dutch Civil Procedure Code, the Code of Criminal Procedure, the Wahv traffic enforcement act and the Publication Act so that summonses to persons without a known address are published in the Staatscourant instead of newspapers. It also allows the judge to order additional electronic notice and lets the Minister of Interior Affairs set rules on the Staatscourant's content and fees by ministerial regulation.
33956.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the Staatscourant serving as the single publication point for persons without a known address, and says ministerial rules on its content are needed for a clear statutory basis.
q: It is up to the judge to specify a suitable other method of electronic summons.
Het is daarbij aan de rechter een geschikte andere wijze van elektronische oproeping aan te geven.
d: publication of laws and decrees in Staatsblad and Staatscourant
entry into force set by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: The judge may order summonses of absent parties to be made additionally by other means, including possibly electronic notice, with privacy protection left to the judge's assessment.

parties: Asks whether people without a known address will realistically visit the online Staatscourant and whether the balance between efficiency and privacy is adequate.
In their view, this bill makes a good attempt to reconcile these interests with each other.
Naar hun mening is met onderhavig wetsvoorstel een goede poging gedaan deze belangen met elkaar te verenigen.
Asks about safeguards against long-term searchability of published notices by search engines and about why the prosecution service's role in service is not removed.
This means that the bill includes safeguards to prevent that years after publication the notices can still be linked to persons.
Dat brengt met zich mee dat er waarborgen in het wetsvoorstel zijn opgenomen om te voorkomen dat jaren na de bekendmaking die nog steeds aan personen kan worden gekoppeld.
Doubts that the online publication will reach the target group and asks how the balance with data protection is struck.
People do not consult the digital Staatscourant daily, and probably never.
Mensen raadplegen niet dagelijks en waarschijnlijk zelfs nooit de digitale Staatscourant.
Welcomes cost savings and the move to digital publication but asks for substantiation that the target group will actually see the notices and about data protection in practice.
They note that in the current digital era it is an anachronism to publish judicial notices for persons without a known residence in a newspaper.
Zij merken op dat het in het huidige digitale tijdperk een anachronisme is om gerechtelijke mededelingen voor personen die geen bekende woon-of verblijfplaats hebben, in een dagblad te publiceren
Asks about the timing of the review of the prosecution service's role and of other newspaper publications.
They ask when the government intends to review this.
Zij vragen wanneer de regering voornemens is dit te bezien.
Asks whether the publication restrictions will be laid down in a decree subject to prior parliamentary scrutiny and why a uniform four-month period applies.
They further ask whether the government believes such a regulation would justify prior submission of the decision to parliament.
Zij vragen voorts of de regering van mening is dat een dergelijke regeling voorhang van het besluit bij het parlement zou rechtvaardigen.
Asks how information is prevented from being copied to other websites and how the judge's discretion to choose another electronic method will be exercised.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports a bill moving public notices to persons without a known residence to the Staatscourant, but asks how private-life intrusions via other electronic channels (such as social media) will be limited and how the duty to trace actual whereabouts is ensured. The Minister's reply states that any additional electronic notice must offer comparable privacy protection, that social media is unlikely to be used, that bailiffs and clerks must check the population register and try to find an actual address, and that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
concerns: Other electronic notice (e.g. social media) must not reduce the privacy protection offered by Staatscourant publication; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to say so.

The duty to trace the actual whereabouts of persons without a known residence needs to be secured in practice; the reply relies on the population register check, bailiff and clerk procedures, and disciplinary and judicial oversight, and the memorandum was supplemented.

33983.s: The bill amends numerous Dutch statutes to align them with the Jeugdwet (Youth Act), transferring youth care responsibilities from bureaus jeugdzorg and the provinces to municipalities and certified institutions. It also makes technical and substantive changes to the Jeugdwet itself, including who may request court-ordered placements and how supervision and court appeals are handled.
33983.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to align statutes with the Jeugdwet and to avoid duplicate legal routes and to ensure smooth transition from the Wet op de jeugdzorg.
q: With this amendment this carelessness is corrected.
Met deze wijziging wordt deze onzorgvuldigheid hersteld.
d: definition of youth help triggered by criminal decisions and child protection measures
rules on gesloten jeugdhulp matters set by joint ministerial regulation
rules on data processing set by Minister of VWS regulation
rules on how the Sociale verzekeringsbank administers persoonsgebonden budgetten
ministers may authorise inspectors to file disciplinary complaints with professional bodies
transitional rules on youth care set by ministerial regulation
rules on measures restricting liberty of youths set by regulation
interbestuurlijk toezicht and indeplaatsstelling of municipalities transferred from provinces to national ministers
p: Municipal power to request closed youth care placements is removed where a certified institution already executes a child protection measure, shifting placement initiative to the institution and the courts.],
Interbestuurlijk toezicht over municipalities moves from the provinces to the national ministers, who may take over municipal tasks via indeplaatsstelling.]
Several youth care decisions are placed on the negative list, removing administrative appeal, though civil court review remains.

parties: Asks whether the transitional arrangement only obliges municipalities to agree on taking over staff, not to actually take them over.
Can these members assume that the transitional arrangement only entails an obligation to make agreements on taking over staff, and not an obligation to actually take over staff?

Kunnen deze leden ervan uitgaan dat uit de overgangsregeling alleen de verplichting volgt om afspraken te maken over overname van medewerkers en niet de verplichting om ook daadwerkelijk medewerkers over te nemen?
Asks for a feasibility test and wants the Rijk's power to direct non-performing municipalities (aanwijzingsbevoegdheid) retained after 1 January 2015.
Said members consider it sensible to temporarily retain the power of direction also after 1 January 2015 and to use it against municipalities that are not keeping up.
Genoemde leden vinden het verstandig om de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid tijdelijk ook na 1 januari 2015 te behouden en in te zetten tegen gemeenten die niet goed meekomen.
Asks about the privacy and legal-protection consequences of withholding existing case files and about the lack of participation rights for unaccompanied minors.
Can the government explain in more detail why unaccompanied minors and refugees would have no right to participation, ask the members of the SP faction?
Kan de regering uitgebreider toelichten waarom AMA’s en vluchtelingen geen recht zouden hebben op medezeggenschap, zo vragen de leden van de SP-fractie .
Asks about legal certainty and appeal routes for new decisions added to the Awb negative list, and why the Raad voor de rechtspraak's advice on a spoedmachtiging and maximum term was not adopted.
The members of the CDA faction ask the government to indicate, per decision, how legal certainty is guaranteed in these cases and how it is possible to appeal these decisions.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen aan de regering per besluit om aan te geven op welke wijze de rechtszekerheid in deze gevallen gewaarborgd is en op welke wijze het mogelijk is om beroep tegen deze beslissingen aan te tekenen.
Warns of chaos and doubts whether the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can guarantee care; questions the discretion of mayors and aldermen over medical treatment in closed youth care.
These members ask how the guarantee of continuity of youth care can be given.
Deze leden vragen hoe de garantie voor continuïteit van jeugdhulp gegeven kan worden.
Supports a statutory transitional regime but asks what the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can do if continuity remains a problem and asks for simultaneous entry into force as the Raad van State advised.
These members ask what measures the Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd can still take if continuity of youth care by a particular bureau jeugdzorg remains a problem despite the guarantees.

Deze leden vragen welke maatregelen vervolgens de Transitie Autoriteit Jeugd nog kan nemen als de continuïteit van de jeugdhulp door een bepaald bureau jeugdzorg ondanks de waarborgen een probleempunt blijft?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Invoeringswet Jeugdwet bill but advises simultaneous entry into force of the Jeugdwet, the implementing act and the child-protection laws (Stb. 2014, 130 and 131), plus consolidated texts of the affected Civil Code articles, and makes numerous drafting remarks. The government reply accepts simultaneous entry into force via one royal decree, provides consolidated texts, and adopts most drafting remarks, rejecting only the proposed relocation of one delegation basis.
concerns: The complexity of stacked amendments to Book 1 of the Civil Code, including the risk of non-simultaneous entry into force, reduces accessibility, so simultaneous entry into force is advised.
Numerous technical and cross-reference corrections are advised, most of which are adopted, except relocating the delegation basis on the vertrouwenspersoon.

34289.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 98/2013 on explosives precursors in Dutch law, prohibiting private persons from acquiring, bringing in, possessing or using restricted precursors without a licence, and creating a licensing regime administered by the Minister of Security and Justice. It also imposes reporting obligations on market operators for suspicious transactions, disappearances and thefts, and sets out enforcement, data-sharing and penalty provisions.
34289.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to respond quickly to new threats and to implement EU rules, and notes that ministerial regulations allow fast adjustment of substances and procedures.
q: This enables the cabinet to respond quickly to new threats and bring these substances under the scope of this Act.
Dit stelt het kabinet in staat om snel te reageren bij nieuwe dreigingen en deze stoffen onder de werking van deze wet te brengen.
d: designating additional explosives precursors and setting lower thresholds
licence model forms and other documents
application procedure, required documents and fees
rules on refusing licences for public order or security reasons
labelling and sales control rules for market operators
manner and place of reporting suspicious transactions, disappearances and thefts
designation of officials charged with supervision by ministerial decision
p: The Minister may grant, refuse, suspend, revoke licences and attach conditions, with licences limited to a maximum of two years and a prohibition on breaching conditions.
Licence refusal is permitted where necessary to protect essential security interests or public order, with details left to ministerial regulation and a requirement of proportionality for use.
Police and Royal Marechaussee must share personal and other data with the Minister or designated supervisors on request, broadening information flows about individuals.
Other administrative bodies must provide personal data on request or on their own initiative to the Minister or supervisors for enforcement of the Act.
Personal data are processed and retained for three to five years, with the Minister as data controller.

parties: Asks whether other member states use licensing or registration systems and whether prosecutions have occurred under the existing total ban.
These members ask whether persons have been prosecuted or convicted for violating the total ban since the regulation took effect on 2 September 2014.
Deze leden vragen of in de periode van de inwerkingtreding van de verordening op 2 september 2014 tot heden personen zijn aangeklaagd dan wel veroordeeld wegens het overtreden van het totaalverbod.
Worries that divergent national implementation may let precursors flow across borders and create a larger illegal market.
These members ask whether this could mean that in some member states precursors will be more easily available to private individuals than in others.
Deze leden vragen of dat kan betekenen dat er lidstaten zullen zijn waar voor particulieren precursoren gemakkelijker beschikbaar zijn dan in andere lidstaten.
Questions the proportionality of treating minor thefts of hydrogen peroxide as possibly terrorist-motivated and asks how the reporting duty can be proven.
Asks whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport is adequately equipped to supervise, citing earlier failures in the Fyra inquiry, and whether ministerial oversight is direct enough.
These members also ask whether the ILT as an organisation is sufficiently equipped and can be expected to carry out the named supervisory tasks.
Deze leden vragen ook of de ILT als organisatie voldoende is toegerust en in staat mag worden geacht om de genoemde taken als toezichthouder uit te voeren.
Asks why the government did not choose a total ban and what counts as a suspicious transaction, leaving key definitions to ministerial regulation.
The PVV members understand it is convenient to lay down matters in ministerial regulations, but nonetheless want to know what falls under suspicious transactions.
De leden van de PVV-fractie begrijpen dat het handig is om een en ander in ministeriële regelingen vast te leggen, maar willen desondanks graag weten wat onder verdachte transacties valt.
Questions the broad delegation allowing ministerial extension of the scope and suggests a sunset clause tied to EU decisions.
Precisely from that thought, these members ask whether there should not be a temporary delegation or a form of delegation under which the restriction lapses automatically.
Juist vanuit die gedachte vragen deze leden of er niet sprake zou moeten zijn van een tijdelijke delegatie of van een vorm van delegatie waarbij de beperking automatisch vervalt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the bill on explosive precursors, but asked the explanatory memorandum to address how licences must state the substances covered and the EU criteria for designating additional substances. The minister's reply states that both points were followed by supplementing the explanatory notes, and that technical and drafting corrections were also made.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify that licences must specify for which substance the licence is granted, as required by Article 7(2) of the Regulation.
The explanatory memorandum should set out the criteria from the Regulation that apply when national authorities designate additional substances or set lower concentration limits.
Several technical and redactional corrections were proposed, including article numbering, deletion of redundant references, and correction of the transposition table.

34379.s: The bill amends the Telecommunicatiewet to implement the EU open-internet (net neutrality) regulation 2015/2120, designating ACM as national regulatory authority for supervision and enforcement and removing most national net-neutrality rules from article 7.4a. It also lets an algemene maatregel van bestuur set rules implementing the regulation and adds the regulation to the Algemene wet bestuursrecht appeal provisions.
34379.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the implementing rules may embody substantive and policy choices, so the power is given to the government and the EU regulation requires national rule-making.
q: Because it cannot be excluded that the rules implementing the net neutrality regulation will reflect substantive and policy choices, the rule-making power is in principle delegated to the government.

Omdat niet is uit te sluiten dat in de regels ter uitvoering van de netneutraliteitsverordening inhoudelijke en beleidsmatige keuzes tot uitdrukking komen, wordt de regelgevende bevoegdheid in beginsel aan de regering gedelegeerd
d: rules implementing the net neutrality regulation for internet access providers
generally binding rules implementing the net neutrality regulation
p: Allows binding net neutrality rules for internet providers to be set by general administrative order without parliamentary approval, though limited to implementing an EU regulation.
Designates the minister as national regulatory authority empowered to issue generally binding rules under the EU regulation.

parties: Asks which certified monitoring mechanisms the ACM will use, how they will be granted, and how consumers can use evidence of significant discrepancies in speed.
The VVD members ask which mechanisms these are.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke mechanismes dit betreffen.
Asks why public enforcement by the ACM with fines and penalties is not used instead of civil procedures, and whether parliament should be consulted on the general administrative order.
These members ask whether public-law enforcement with fines and penalty payments is not much more effective and efficient than civil proceedings.
Deze leden vragen of publiekrechtelijke handhaving met boetes en dwangsommen niet veel effectiever en efficiënter is dan het voeren van civiele procedures.
Asks how the ACM will enforce against price discrimination, how actively it will act, and how end users can report violations of their rights.
These members are curious how the ACM will carry out this enforcement, how actively it will act, and how end users can indicate that their rights are being violated.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd hoe de ACM deze handhaving gaat uitvoeren, hoe actief zij hierin gaat optreden en op welke wijze eindgebruikers kunnen aangeven dat hun rechten geschonden worden.

Asks how compliance with reasonable traffic management rules is checked, whether vague criteria allow abuse, and how the fallback provision and the basis for the general administrative order will work.
These members ask how it is checked that internet access providers comply with the rules for applying reasonable traffic management.
Deze leden vragen hierbij op welke wijze wordt gecontroleerd dat aanbieders van internettoegang zich houden aan de regels om redelijk verkeersmanagement toe te passen.
Objects to EU regulation and asks what the sanctions are if the Netherlands refuses to implement it, and whether an opt-out is possible.
These members first urgently request that the government flatly refuse to let the European Union dismantle our net neutrality.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering allereerst met klem om botweg te weigeren om de Europese Unie onze netneutraliteit te laten slopen.
Asks whether BEREC guidelines or the general administrative order can tighten practical implementation, for example on zero-rating, and about consultation with stakeholders.

These members ask whether the government sees opportunities, through these guidelines or the basis in article 7.4a(2) on rules by general administrative order, to sharpen the practical implementation of the regulation, for example on zero-rating.

Deze leden vragen of de regering kansen ziet om via deze richtlijnen of via de grondslag in artikel 7.4a, tweede lid, van de Telecommunicatiewet betreffende het stellen van regels per algemene maatregel van bestuur de praktische uitvoering van de verordening aan te scherpen, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van zero-rating.
Asks what scope the general administrative order retains to counter price discrimination and how it will be shaped, and whether filtered-internet choice remains available.
These members ask what scope the mentioned general administrative order still has, for example to counter price discrimination and promote the rights of end users.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen welke ruimte de genoemde algemene maatregel van bestuur nog kent, om bijvoorbeeld prijsdiscriminatie tegen te gaan en de rechten van eindgebruikers te bevorderen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises sending the bill implementing the EU net neutrality regulation to parliament, but asks for the explanatory memorandum to address the differences between the existing and new regimes and their consequences for end users and providers. The government's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented with a comparison, adds amendments following the ACM's advice, and revises the entry-into-force provision.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should describe the differences between the existing net neutrality rules and the new EU regulation and their consequences, which the government has added in summary form.
The entry-into-force provision should be redrafted so that entry into force before the regulation's application date is excluded and any later entry into force occurs as early as possible.

34388.s: The bill gives the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) a statutory basis to process data, including personal data, to protect vital electronic information systems and to advise and assist affected organisations. It also creates a mandatory duty for vital providers to report serious ICT breaches to the minister, with rules on when confidential, traceable data may be shared with others.
34388.j: The memorandum justifies the new data powers by the need to put NCSC's tasks on a firmer statutory basis to prevent disruption of vital services and societal harm.
q: The articles 2 and 3 of this bill in particular serve that purpose.
Daartoe strekken met name de artikelen 2 en 3 van dit wetsvoorstel.
d: designating vital providers and products/services subject to reporting duty
interpretation of 'to a significant extent' via guidelines per sector
further rules on breach notification and data supply
designation of computer crisis teams receiving data
designation of computer crisis teams eligible for confidential data
p: Confidential data on identifiable providers may be shared without consent with intelligence services, designated crisis teams and, in some cases, the public, with the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur disapplied.
The minister may request data from bodies and organisations, and the general data-protection consent rule is disapplied for such disclosures.

parties: Asks whether a sanction for breaching the reporting duty should be added at the same time, since supervision and enforcement are left to the future NIS directive.
They ask whether, now that a reporting duty is included in this bill, it is not important to add a sanction for breaching that duty at the same time.
Zij vragen of het, nu in dit wetsvoorstel een meldplicht opgenomen is, niet van belang is dat een sanctie op het schenden van die meldplicht tegelijkertijd op te nemen.
Asks for clear, non-negotiable criteria for the 'in belangrijke mate' threshold and how the government will enforce responsibility of providers and sanction non-compliance.
Whether or not to report must not degenerate into discussion or negotiation, especially where the public interest requires it.
Al dan niet melden mag niet in discussie of onderhandeling ontaarden, zeker als het maatschappelijk belang daarom vraagt.
Raises concern about the vagueness of the 'in belangrijke mate' threshold, the lack of supervision and enforcement, and the handling of personal data and the risk of concealed incidents.
The SP members get the impression that not much thought has gone into supervision and enforcement of the reporting duty, or that it is at least glossed over too quickly.
De leden van de SP-fractie krijgen enigszins het idee dat niet heel veel is nagedacht over toezicht en handhaving van de meldplicht of dat daar in ieder geval te snel overheen gestapt wordt.
Questions the added value and triple reporting burden, the sectoral supervisors' primacy over NCSC advice, and privacy safeguards for data sharing with third parties.
The CDA members ask whether it is correct that in practice the bill creates a twofold reporting duty, and a threefold one in case of loss of personal data.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen of het klopt dat met het wetsvoorstel in de praktijk een tweeledige meldplicht ontstaat

Not yet convinced of the need to submit the reporting duty in incomplete form; questions the lack of a clear scope, the exclusion of DDoS attacks, and the purpose limitation exceptions for data sharing.
For now they are not convinced of the need to submit the reporting duty to the House in this incomplete form.
Zij zijn vooralsnog niet overtuigd van de noodzaak om de meldplicht op deze onvolledige wijze aan de Kamer voor te leggen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the cybersecurity bill's mandatory incident reporting obligation and its general exemption from the data-purpose limitation (Wbp art. 9(1)) were insufficiently justified, and that reporting disclosures to the Public Prosecution Service needed clarification. The minister's reply accepted several points (clarified purpose, narrowed references, optional implementing rules) but rejected the call to justify the reporting duty or disapply the purpose limitation differently, arguing the Wbp exemption is insufficient and the EU NIS directive will require later enforcement.
concerns: The added value of the mandatory reporting duty is insufficiently motivated, and if justified, enforcement should be considered; the minister defers enforcement to the forthcoming EU NIS directive.

Blanket disapplication of the purpose limitation in Wbp art. 9(1) for data requests to vital providers is not convincingly justified; the minister keeps the exemption but states it applies only to NCSC requests under art. 4(1) for necessary purposes.
Disclosure of identifiable confidential data to the Public Prosecution Service should be explained; the minister explains the restriction and its rationale in the explanatory memorandum.

Redactional points: replacing 'redelijkerwijs noodzakelijk' with 'noodzakelijk', rewording 'dienstig' in art. 9(2), and changing the first-person form of the explanatory memorandum; the minister adopted some but not all.

34397.s: The bill introduces a registration plate requirement for agricultural and forestry tractors, low-speed motor vehicles, mobile machines and their trailers, and bars new low-speed vehicles from traffic. It adds temporary conversion-period exemptions to 20 May 2018 and shifts the scope of exemptions to be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
34397.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying the vehicles to be designated are at least those exempt from the driving licence requirement, so the scope follows existing regulation.
q: It is proposed to replace that general exception with an exception for LBTs, MMBS and MMs designated by general administrative order.
Voorgesteld wordt die algemene uitzondering te vervangen door een uitzondering voor LBT’s, MMBS’en en MM’s die bij algemene maatregel van bestuur zijn aangewezen.
d: Artikel I B (artikel 37, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 2°)
vehicles exempt from registration plate requirement
Artikel I B (artikel 37, tweede lid, onderdeel c)
trailers exempt from registration plate requirement
rules on how registration and ownership transfer is applied for
p: Artikel I B (artikel 37, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 2°)
Which agricultural vehicles and mobile machines are exempt from the plate requirement is left to a general administrative order rather than the statute.

parties: Doubts the license plate requirement will improve safety and fears large administrative and financial burdens; asks for evidence, the Actal critique to be addressed, and an evaluation clause.
Given the uncertainty about the effect of this measure and the burdens it causes, the VVD members do not consider the license plate requirement a proportionate means.
Gegeven de onzekerheid over het effect van deze maatregel en de lasten die het veroorzaakt, vinden de leden van de VVD-fractie de kentekenplicht geen proportioneel middel.
Supports the bill as implementing a motion it adopted, but asks about remaining regulatory lag, enforcement of speed and alcohol rules, and the Chamber's involvement in the speed increase.

In this regard these members also point the government to the fourth recommendation of the earlier OvV report, which advises deciding on the maximum speed only once the license plate and APK requirements are in force.

In dit verband wijzen deze leden de regering ook op de vierde aanbeveling uit het eerder genoemde rapport van de OvV, waaruit blijkt dat de Onderzoekraad adviseert om pas een besluit te nemen over de maximumsnelheid als de kenteken- en APK-plicht zijn ingevoerd.
Has serious reservations about the costs, demands a validated calculation given the earlier bromfiets miscalculation, and asks whether the measure passes a subsidiarity test.
The CDA members have serious reservations about the costs that the introduction of the law would entail.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben ernstige bedenkingen bij de kosten die de invoering van de wet met zich mee zouden brengen.
Supports the road safety aim but asks for concrete targets, infrastructure adjustments, enforcement capacity of local enforcers, and measures to protect other road users.
The D66 members ask how things will be shaped regarding infrastructure and enforcement.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe een en ander wordt vormgegeven als het gaat om de infrastructuur en handhaving.
Asks about visibility of vehicle design speed to other road users, requirements for the 40 km/u roads, and simplifying the exemption procedure for road managers.
They ask whether it is not desirable for other road users to also be able to see whether an LBT may drive on a road given its design speed.
Zij vragen of het niet wenselijk is dat andere weggebruikers ook kunnen zien of een LBT gezien de constructiesnelheid mag rijden op een weg.
Questions the effect on road safety and argues the bill increases regulatory burden on agriculture; asks for exemption of narrow fruit-picking tractors from the license requirement.
Introducing the license requirement for this category means a substantial administrative burden, while in these members' view it makes little difference for road safety.
Invoering van de kentekenplicht voor deze categorie betekent een forse administratieve last, terwijl het voor de verkeersveiligheid in de ogen van deze leden weinig uitmaakt.

34469.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2014/56/EU and Regulation 537/2014 on statutory audits by amending the Wet toezicht accountantsorganisaties, the Wet op het accountantsberoep, the Wet tuchtrechtspraak accountants and Book 2 of the Civil Code. It strengthens auditor independence, creates a regime for audit firms from other EU states, and gives the AFM new enforcement powers, including banning directors from functions and ordering audit firms to stop audits.
34469.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as needed to implement EU law and to keep detailed technical rules in lower regulation, without stating specific parliamentary involvement.
q: Rules shall be laid down by or pursuant to a general administrative order on how the application for registration is submitted.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de aanvraag tot inschrijving wordt ingediend
d: Artikel I, B (art. 4a); Artikel I, F (art. 12e)
registration rules for audit firms from other member states
remuneration policy details for audit firms
detailed independence rules for audit firms
detailed independence rules for external auditors
rules on professional competence, objectivity and integrity of external auditors
p: The AFM may ban directors from functions for up to three years and order an audit firm to stop auditing a public-interest entity, after hearing the parties and subject to suspension pending appeal.
The AFM's power to impose penalty payments and administrative fines is extended to breaches of the EU Regulation and the new provisions.
The AFM may publish decisions in anonymised form in certain cases, and appeals outcomes are to be published.
Rules on information sharing and the ne bis in idem bar are adjusted so the AFM can share confidential information with EU and foreign authorities.

parties: Questions whether AFM sanctions reviewed only afterwards by administrative judges provide adequate legal protection, and whether AFM combining rule-setting, supervision and adjudication breaches separation of powers.
