Can the government elaborate on the underlying concern, raised by several parties, that the separation of powers appears to be at stake and the call for more checks and balances to be built in.
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de onderliggende zorg bij meerdere partijen dat de scheiding van machten in het geding lijkt raken en de roep om meer checks and balances in te bouwen.
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State and NBA objections to AFM sanctions being reviewed only afterwards by the administrative judge rather than in advance.

Can the government elaborate on the objections of the Council of State and the NBA, and which concrete objections does the government see to the route in which review takes place in advance by the judge.
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de bezwaren van de Raad van State en de NBA, en welke bezwaren ziet de regering concreet tegen de route waarbij toetsing vooraf door de rechter plaatsvindt.
Asks about the number of oob's to be covered by a future amendment, the relationship with recently debated firm rotation legislation, and whether AFM extra costs are charged to audit firms.

The CDA members ask whether the extra costs incurred by the AFM are charged to the audit firms concerned, or whether the AFM makes an effort to absorb the extra costs within the existing cost framework.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de extra kosten die de AFM maakt worden doorbelast aan de betreffende accountantsbedrijven, of dat de AFM een inspanning doet om de extra kosten binnen het bestaande kostenkader op te vangen.
Asks how divergent definitions between the EU directive, national law and professional rules can be improved over time, and how the professional-sceptical attitude requirements will be filled in.
These members understand the government's considerations but would like to hear how this can best be dealt with in the future.
Deze leden snappen de afwegingen van de regering, maar horen graag hoe hier richting de toekomst het best mee omgegaan kan worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementatiewet wijzigingsrichtlijn en verordening wettelijke controles jaarrekeningen, recommending alignment with the directive's definitions, justification or adjustment of several provisions (prohibited non-audit services, delegation for professional scepticism, dismissal procedure, legal protection, transposition tables) and removal of a pre-hearing procedure. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, including dropping the pre-hearing procedure, revising the dismissal power with appeal safeguards, and clarifying the Accountantskamer's role, while rejecting the advice to narrow the delegation on remuneration policy and to change terminology.
concerns: The Afdeling advised aligning the definitional framework closely with the directive because non-literal transposition creates ambiguity; the government kept most Dutch terms but aligned definitions where possible.

The Afdeling questioned whether a blanket ban on all non-audit services is justified under the regulation, asking for a reasoned justification; the government considered the regulation allows a general prohibition.

The Afdeling noted the entry-into-force of article 27(2) conflicts with the transposition deadline and the referenced royal decree route; the government removed the amendment and clarified the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling advised dropping or concretising the delegation for rules on professional scepticism; the government kept the delegation but tied it to existing professional regulation.

The Afdeling asked that the delegation on remuneration policy be limited to the proper policy and to the directive's requirements; the government limited it to a proper policy but refused the further limitation.
The Afdeling asked for clearer criteria and an explicit proportionality review by courts for the AFM's dismissal power; the government added a serious-violation threshold and appeal safeguards.

The Afdeling found the dismissal provision inconsistent with the directive's court procedure and not covering individual auditors; the government added suspension-pending-appeal provisions and clarified the competent authority.
The Afdeling advised removing the pre-hearing procedure for the general administrative measure, which was not needed for implementation; the government removed it.
The Afdeling gave redactional points and advised improving the transposition table in the explanatory memorandum; the government adopted the redactional changes.

34475-V.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting appropriations and commitments across policy and non-policy articles, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum explains the threshold used for justifying significant variances between the second supplementary budget and the current estimate.
34475-V.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, which require explanation of significant variances.
q: In accordance with the State Budget Regulations and the Accounting Act of 2001, notable differences between the previous (second supplementary budget) and current estimate must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de vorige (tweede suppletoire begroting) en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

34478.s: The bill repairs several technical inconsistencies in the Dutch childcare and playgroup quality act, including cross-references, the withdrawal of a publication duty for coercive orders, and background-check and personal register requirements. It also makes the childcare allowance percentage and the unemployment period adjustable by general administrative order (AMvB) subject to a parliamentary pre-consultation procedure.
34478.j: The memorandum justifies removing public disclosure of short-term orders on the grounds that such measures are of very short duration and disclosure for three years would not be correct or proportionate.
q: Data on these short-term measures imposed by the inspector being listed in the national register for three years, so they remain public, is not correct and not proportionate.

Gegevens over deze kortlopende maatregelen die door de toezichthouder worden opgelegd in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang en Peuterspeelzalen (LRKP) vermelden, waardoor deze gedurende drie jaar ... openbaar blijven, blijkt daarmee niet correct en ook niet proportioneel.
d: unemployment period defining childcare allowance eligibility
cases where childcare allowance may equal 33.3 percent of costs
p: I.I (art. 1.81, eerste lid; art. 2.28a, eerste lid)
Removes the public disclosure of coercive orders and orders to take measures issued by the inspector, shortening public visibility of enforcement against childcare providers.

parties: Asks whether proposed relaxation of sanctions and the removal of public disclosure for childcare violations still leaves effective enforcement against repeated minor infractions.
What sanction instruments remain if the law is changed and measures for accumulating violations keep piling up?
Welke sanctiemiddelen zijn er als de wet gewijzigd is als maatregelen als gevolg van overtredingen zich blijven opstapelen?
Asks about the powers of client councils versus parent committees at playgroups and whether parent committees must be established at all playgroups.
For clarification, these members ask whether, by repairing this omission, parent committees must be established at all playgroups.
Ter verduidelijking vragen de leden zich af of met het repareren van deze omissie er verplicht bij alle peuterspeelzalen oudercommissies ingesteld moeten worden.
Asks for the background to the repair legislation, the reasons for added flexibility, and the financial consequences of the bill.
Can the government indicate whether there are still financial consequences attached to this bill?
Kan de regering aangeven of er nog financiële consequenties zijn verbonden aan dit wetsvoorstel?
Notes that the law does not define when a host-parent arrangement ends, while municipalities can impose fines, and asks for clearer statutory rules.
Given that municipalities can impose fines, they would find it wise if the legal framework offered more clarity.
Gezien het feit dat gemeenten boetes kunnen opleggen, zouden zij het verstandig vinden als het wettelijk kader meer duidelijkheid biedt.

34496.s: The bill amends the Port State Control Act to move the rules for inspecting foreign-flagged ships in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba from the Shipping Act into this law, and to add a separate power to conduct limited, non-directive controls on foreign ships in Dutch European ports. It also renames the responsible inspectorate, adds new stop, detention and cost-recovery powers, and extends the dynamic reference to international conventions and the two Caribbean codes.
34496.j: The memorandum justifies the new control power by practical difficulty of following the rigid directive protocol in some cases, such as night-time inspections.
q: With this power limited or theme-based control actions can be carried out without the obligation to fully complete the separate aspects of the inspections under the directive.

Met deze bevoegdheid kunnen beperkte of themagerichte controleacties worden uitgevoerd zonder de verplichting om de afzonderlijke aspecten van de inspecties op grond van de richtlijn volledig te doorlopen.
d: which rules of the Port State Control regulation apply to ships in the Caribbean islands
tariffs for detention and inspection cost reimbursement
conditions set by flag state authority for transit to repair yard
p: Inspectors may subject any foreign ship needing a certificate to a control whose content is left entirely to the inspectorate, outside the fixed protocol of the directive.
Inspectors may control foreign-flagged ships in Dutch European ports without the procedural limits of the inspection regime, and such controls do not count toward mandatory inspections.
Inspectors may stop activities and detain ships on defined grounds of danger, with conditions attached to departure for repair."
Entry into ship living quarters follows the Caribbean Netherlands criminal procedure rules, with authorisation given by the procurator-general instead of a judge."

parties: Asks whether the new control power is truly necessary, how it affects inspection intensity given EU minimum inspection quotas, whether ILT has capacity, and whether it should apply in the Caribbean Netherlands too; also finds the definition of control too summary.
How can it then be maintained that this has no consequences for the intensity of supervision?
Hoe kan dan worden volgehouden dat dit geen gevolgen heeft voor de intensiteit van het toezicht?

Asks for clarification of the difference between 'controle' and 'inspectie', whether the new power carries the same follow-up powers and safeguards, and for the results of the consultation and enforceability test.
Finally, these members would like to know why the control power is linked to the same follow-up options and safeguards as the existing inspection power.
Ten slotte vernemen deze leden graag waarom aan de controlebevoegdheid dezelfde vervolgmogelijkheden en waarborgen zijn gekoppeld als aan de reeds bestaande inspectiebevoegdheid.

Critical that a lighter 'control' may undermine inspection quality and EU directive obligations; asks for the evidential basis for treating full inspections as burdensome, whether other member states do this, and why the government does not seek to amend the directive.
Can the government, with the introduction of a kind of 'inspection-light', really guarantee the quality of the control (namely whether the Port State Control Act is complied with)?
Kan de regering met deze introductie van een soort «inspectie-light» de kwaliteit van de controle (namelijk of er wel wordt voldaan aan de Wet havenstaatcontrole) wel garanderen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against sending the bill to parliament until its remarks were addressed, mainly because transferring port state control rules for the BES islands creates a new, third regime with unclear treaty coverage and insufficient justification for the new control power and for differing rules on entering living quarters. The government's reply accepted most points, clarifying treaty scope, aligning entry safeguards with the Dutch Penal Code BES, adding justification and amending the bill accordingly.
concerns: The need for the additional port control power for ships in European Netherlands was not justified in the explanatory memorandum and must be explained, given EU free movement of services.

Transferring BES port state control rules creates a new regime that includes treaties not yet valid for the BES islands, such as the Maritime Labour Convention, without formal extension being arranged."
Entry into living quarters of ships at BES ports lacks the statutory safeguards of the Algemene wet op het binnentreden that apply in European Netherlands, and no justification was given.
Multiple regimes across the Kingdom could cause practical problems and added burden for BES enforcement, which the explanatory memorandum did not address; the government disputed both concerns.
The provision on lifting detention or cessation decisions lacks rules for delivery when the captain cannot be reached and for notifying the flag state.
Implementation of the directive for ships of non-party flag states is inadequate because the provision does not clearly allow a comparable detailed or extended inspection.
Redactional remarks on the title, recital, article references and inspectorate name were adopted.

34568.s: The bill amends Table A of the Financiële-verhoudingswet to revise the characteristics used to set distribution criteria for the provincial fund, adding a own-assets income characteristic and removing the business-activity characteristic. It sets entry into force by royal decree, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2017 if entry is after that date.
34568.j: The memorandum justifies the new characteristics as making possible distribution criteria needed to implement the Jansen committee proposal and technical adjustments proposed by fund managers.
q: This table contains the characteristics that form the framework for the distribution criteria to be set by general administrative order.
In deze tabel zijn de kenmerken opgenomen die het kader vormen voor de bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen verdeelmaatstaven.
d: distribution criteria for provincial fund under Table A characteristics

parties: Asks whether the government has independent responsibility over the proposal and why the Rfv's two-year maintenance plan was not adopted, and questions how the model handles unexpected financial shocks and regional economic growth.
Why is the Rfv's proposal to come up with an action plan within two years not adopted?
Waarom wordt het voorstel van de Rfv om binnen twee jaar met een plan van aanpak te komen niet overgenomen?
Supports the goal of the bill but asks how and when maintenance of the model will take place and whether the model can absorb large financial shocks, citing the Zeeland energy company case.
It is not clear to the PvdA members how and when this maintenance will take place.
Het is de leden van de PvdA-fractie niet duidelijk hoe en wanneer dit onderhoud dan wel zal plaatsvinden?

Supports the simplification and provincial autonomy but asks the government to secure cost-orientation and to agree with the provinces on maintenance of the model by 2018, in line with the Rfv advice.
Can the government commit to entering into further consultation with the provinces in 2018 to agree, in light of the Rfv advice, on maintenance of the distribution model?
Kan de regering toezeggen in 2018 in nader overleg te treden met de provincies om, mede gelet op het advies van de Rfv, afspraken te maken over het onderhoud van het verdeelmodel

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the bill simplifying the provinciefonds distribution model to parliament, but asks for better justification on cost-orientation, the timing of model maintenance, and the removal of the 'bedrijvigheid' characteristic. The government's nader rapport defends the choices, accepts that the no-redistribution condition fits cost-orientation less well, and declines to set a maintenance deadline.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the no-redistribution condition does not fit the statutory cost-orientation principle; the government acknowledges this but justifies prioritising globality given provincial unanimity.
The Afdeling asks for a clear timeframe for maintenance of the model, while the government declines to set a deadline and rejects the Rfv and Jansen recommendation of a five-year cycle.

The Afdeling asks for further justification of removing the 'bedrijvigheid in de provincies' characteristic given the 2011-2015 administrative agreement on regional economy, which the government answers by saying the characteristic was already unused.

34577.s: The bill amends many social security, benefit, student finance and tax-benefit laws to deny or terminate benefits, allowances, pensions and study finance for persons classified as 'uitreiziger' (travelling to join a listed terrorist organisation), with reinstatement once the suspicion lapses. Eligibility is triggered by a notification from intelligence or police services to the executive, with the list of organisations set by the Minister of Justice and Security with Council of Ministers consent.
34577.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to reduce terrorism risk and the binding UN Resolution 1373, and says the executive may rely on the expertise of the CT-Infobox and AIVD notifications while courts retain review.
q: To establish whether there is a well-founded suspicion that someone has left the country to join a terrorist organisation and therefore no longer has entitlement to a benefit, allowance or study finance, implementing bodies need a reliable signal.

Om te kunnen nagaan of er een gegrond vermoeden bestaat dat iemand is uitgereisd met het doel zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie en derhalve geen recht meer heeft op een uitkering, toeslag of studiefinanciering, is het nodig dat de uitvoeringsinstanties een betrouwbaar signaal krijgen
d: rules on how data provision to the inspectorate is carried out
privacy safeguards for data processing on student finance
privacy safeguards for data processing on student finance BES
privacy safeguards for data processing on school cost allowances
Artikel I to XXI (definition of uitreiziger)
listing of organisations by Minister of Justice and Security with Council of Ministers consent
p: Artikel I to XXI, XXV (definition of uitreiziger and benefit exclusions)

Benefits can be terminated on the basis of intelligence or police notifications and an executive-maintained organisation list, with the suspicion standard set as a reasonable suspicion rather than proof.
Artikel XXII and XXIII (art. 2.17a WSF 2000, 2.10a WSF BES)
The Minister may decide a student is a uitreiziger, ending study finance, on the basis of a notification from security services.
Entry into force is set by royal decree, a routine executive timing power.

parties: Asks whether benefit termination can be applied to persons not yet in terrorist-controlled territory and whether the executing body can adequately assess police or AIVD evidence, including the risk of appeal reversal.
Which activities does the government consider to fall under this, and why does the bill not extend to those situations?
Welke activiteiten vallen daar volgens de regering onder en waarom strekt het wetsvoorstel zich niet uit tot die situaties?
Asks about the number and types of benefits already terminated, the expected increase after entry into force, and whether unlawfully received benefits can be reclaimed.
Does this bill also provide for the possibility of reclaiming benefits received unlawfully?
Voorziet dit wetsvoorstel ook in de mogelijkheid om onterecht ontvangen uitkeringen worden teruggevorderd?
Asks whether the measure is merely symbolic given existing terminations and whether the absence of prior judicial review for this administrative measure is correct.
Do the members understand correctly that there is no prior judicial review because this is an administrative law measure?
Begrijpen de aan het woord zijnde goed dat er vooraf geen rechterlijke toets plaatsvindt omdat dit een bestuursrechtelijke maatregel is?
Asks why no statutory basis is needed for processing sensitive personal data from police and AIVD reports, and whether privacy is guaranteed and the bill complies with the ECHR.
Can the government explain why not, and also guarantee that privacy is safeguarded in the implementation of this bill?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom niet en tevens garanderen dat de privacy met de uitvoering van dit wetsvoorstel gewaarborgd is?

Questions the legal protection of persons whose benefit is ended on the basis of secret intelligence information, which is hard to contest, and the risk that innocent family members suffer consequences.
After all, it is difficult to oppose a decision taken on the basis of secret information.
Het is immers lastig opkomen tegen een besluit dat is genomen op grond van geheime informatie.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill letting benefits, student finance and allowances be terminated for suspected jihadist travellers was not yet adequately justified, since existing termination grounds partly apply, and that the legal basis and privacy safeguards for processing special personal data by benefit bodies were insufficient, advising a revised bill. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the necessity objection, arguing the new ground closes gaps and gives a uniform signal, and accepts the privacy objection by pointing to existing legal bases and adding a statutory basis for student finance processing.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of a separate termination ground insufficiently argued, given existing termination possibilities, and advised a substantiated justification or withdrawal of the bill.

The Afdeling noted the affected person faces a difficult evidentiary position in litigation, which weighs against the measure's severity; the government relied on Awb confidential-information rules as sufficient safeguards.

The Afdeling held that processing special personal data by benefit bodies requires a statutory basis and adequate privacy safeguards under Article 23 Wbp, and the government added legal bases for the relevant student finance laws.

34595.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Rijnwaarden and Zevenaar into a new municipality of Zevenaar, dissolving the two old ones and making transitional and related arrangements (safety regions, electoral districts, tax and utility transfers). It delegates the effective date to a royal decree that may set different dates for different articles and grant retroactive effect to 2 January 2016.
34595.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by BMC research finding weak administrative capacity in several policy areas, but it does not justify the royal decree delegation for the effective date.
q: In this royal decree, retroactive effect may be granted to article 5, first paragraph, and article 6 of this law, up to and including 2 January 2016.
In dit koninklijk besluit kan aan artikel 5, eerste lid, en artikel 6 van deze wet terugwerkende kracht worden verleend tot en met 2 januari 2016.
d: effective date of articles by royal decree, possibly retroactive
p: The entry-into-force date is left to a royal decree that may vary by article and apply retroactively to 2 January 2016, though the retroactivity is bounded by a specified date.

parties: Asks for further explanation of the future development and positioning of Duiven and Westervoort, which are not part of the merger.
The VVD members would like further clarification on the future development and positioning of the municipalities of Duiven and Westervoort, which are not part of the merger.

De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag een nadere toelichting op de toekomstige ontwikkeling en positionering van de gemeenten Duiven en Westervoort, die nu geen onderdeel uitmaken van de samenvoeging.
Welcomes the bottom-up, voluntary character of the merger and asks whether Rijnwaarden should serve as an example for government policy.
The PvdA members believe the municipality of Rijnwaarden should serve as an example.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie menen dat de gemeente Rijnwaarden een voorbeeldfunctie zou moeten hebben.
Values reorganisations that arise from the bottom up and asks about the durability of the merger in light of the advisory committee's recommendations.
These members attach importance to municipal reorganisations arising from the bottom up and leading to recognisable, future-proof municipalities.
Deze leden hechten eraan, dat gemeentelijke herin-delingen van onderop tot stand komen en leiden tot herkenbare, toekomst-bestendige gemeenten.
Asks why a broader four-municipality merger lost support and whether the chosen two-municipality solution is durable.
However, the question remains how durable the chosen solution is.
Evenwel blijft de vraag hangen hoe duurzaam de gekozen oplossing is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill merging Rijnwaarden and Zevenaar to parliament but asked for a firmer justification of the 'durability' criterion, since the De Graaf committee had advised merging all four Liemers municipalities and the explanatory memorandum did not substantiate its claims. The minister's reply added supporting studies (provincial herindelingsscans and a BMC bestuurskracht study) and clarified the explanatory memorandum on scale and the end of the structure discussion.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must give a substantive justification that the merged municipality meets the durability criterion, which the minister addressed by adding supporting analyses.
The claim that the structure discussion in the region has ended is not justified and needs clarification, which the explanatory memorandum was revised to provide.

34694.s: The bill makes technical and mostly non-policy corrections to the Dutch Medicines Act (Geneesmiddelenwet), including corrected cross-references, terminology updates to EU references, and expanded definitions such as wholesale activities. It also raises the maximum fine to the sixth category of the Criminal Code, extends inspection and seizure powers for the Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid, and makes certain Medicines Act violations economic offences.
34694.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical corrections of erroneous references and redactional errors, stating that there is no change or extension of supervisory tasks or powers apart from very limited policy effects.
q: There is no change or extension of (supervisory) tasks or powers.
Er is geen sprake van wijziging of uitbreiding van (toezichts)taken of bevoegdheden.
d: data exclusivity for new indications of known substances
p: Raises the maximum administrative fine to the sixth category and extends the administrative fine powers to more articles, with the explanatory memorandum noting that IGZ may seize goods on the spot where evidence could disappear.

Grants the supervisory authority power to seize medicines and substances at any time and to order suspension or withdrawal of medicines from sale, without a further explicit procedural safeguard stated in the bill text.

parties: Asks how often fines have been imposed, how the policy rules were changed, and how the ceiling compares with other countries, probing enforcement practice.
Can the government indicate how often the EUR 450,000 fine ceiling has been imposed in recent years under the Medicines Act and for what types of violations?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe vaak het boetemaximum van € 450.000 in de afgelopen jaren is opgelegd in het kader van de Geneesmiddelenwet en voor welk soort overtredingen dit was?
Asks for a ten-year overview of fines and the probability of maximum fines, and wants fine revenue returned to healthcare rather than the treasury.
The PVV members would like fines imposed in the healthcare sector to flow back to healthcare rather than to the treasury.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zien graag dat opgelegde boetes in de zorgsector terugvloeien naar de zorg in plaats van naar de schatkist.
Asks how often the Inspectorate has actually imposed fines on manufacturers and how likely the maximum fine is, and whether fines have ever been imposed under the Warenwet.
How often has the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) actually imposed a fine on a pharmaceutical manufacturer to date?
Hoe vaak is inmiddels door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) daadwerkelijk een boete opgelegd aan een geneesmiddelenfabrikant?
Asks for a comparison with maximum fines in other EU member states, a list of past fines, and whether repeat offenders exist, questioning the deterrent effect.
Are there indications that a fine of at most EUR 820,000 works better as a deterrent than a fine of at most EUR 450,000?
Zijn er indicaties om aan te nemen dat een boete van ten hoogste € 820.000 beter werkt als afschrikmiddel dan een boete van ten hoogste € 450.000?
Asks how often the highest-category fine has been imposed and whether pharmaceutical companies provided input into the amendment, raising questions of undue industry influence.
The GroenLinks members ask whether pharmaceutical companies or their representatives provided input for the amendment of this law.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen of farmaceutische bedrijven of vertegenwoordigers van dergelijke bedrijven input hebben geleverd voor de wijziging van deze wet.

Welcomes the higher fine but questions why the Inspectorate never fined a culpable shortage, asks about enforcement adequacy and the expected deterrent effect, and asks how the effect will be monitored.
The Inspectorate has never previously imposed a fine for a culpable medicine shortage.
De inspectie heeft niet eerder een boete opgelegd voor een verwijtbaar geneesmiddelentekort.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on a bill raising the maximum administrative fine under the Medicines Act from €450,000 to €820,000 plus technical amendments, finding that the cited parliamentary motion did not justify such a broad increase and that necessity and proportionality must be independently reasoned. The minister's reply argues the motion's intent was to align with the Warenwet fine level, explains a two-step increase of fine norm amounts, and adds the required reasoning and a reference to Wet op de economische delicten in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling held that the cited parliamentary motion does not justify raising the statutory maximum fine for all Medicines Act violations, while the minister maintains the motion intended alignment with the Warenwet and a two-step approach is needed.

The Afdeling required independent substantive reasoning, concrete examples and a categorised structure showing why the higher maximum is necessary and proportionate, which the minister addressed by pointing to the existing fine-norm system and adding reasoning in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling noted that the maximum fine should be reasoned in relation to the maximum under the Wet op de economische delicten for the same offences, and the minister added this in the general part of the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling's redactional annex corrected cross-references between article 28 and article 34 of the directive, and the minister adopted the correction.

34725-X.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Chapter X) and the budget statements for the agencies DTO, DVD and Paresto, setting amounts in thousands of euros with effect from the day after publication. The explanatory memorandum states that the amendments are technical, bookkeeping or control-finding adjustments only, with policy spending changes handled in a separate document.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34739.s: The bill replaces the Dutch underground networks information exchange act with a new act covering information exchange on underground and above-ground network elements, implementing EU Directive 2014/61/EU on reducing costs of high-speed broadband deployment. It also amends the Telecommunications Act to require network operators to grant access to and coordinate civil works, and assigns dispute resolution to the Authority for Consumers and Markets and the Minister.
34739.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary for proper implementation of the EU directive and to allow technical detail and safety exemptions to be set out later.
q: A basis is proposed to provide, by general administrative order, for further regulation should it later prove that this directive has not been fully or correctly implemented by this bill.

Hierin wordt een grondslag voorgesteld om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur in een nadere regeling te voorzien voor het geval in de toekomst zou blijken dat deze richtlijn nog niet volledig of geheel juist is geïmplementeerd met onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
d: rules on information provision, access and polygons for network information exchange
designation of areas where safety reasons permit deviation from information rules
further regulation to properly implement the directive
further rules on implementation and exemption of physical infrastructure or civil works for safety reasons
procedures and conditions for access and coordination requests, inspections, third-party compensation
information and reservation of antenna sites
p: Property owners must tolerate third-party network installation on their premises when duplication is impossible or inefficient, and the precario-based removal protection for unused cables is replaced by an owner request mechanism.
Disputes over works access are referred to the regulator (ACM) for binding decision instead of the civil courts, with a two-month deadline.
The regulator decides disputes on access and coordination obligations with exclusive competence, and objection is excluded while appeal goes to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
The Minister resolves information-exchange disputes and supervises compliance with administrative enforcement and fines up to 450,000 euro, with appeal to a court.

parties: Questions why the 2016 transposition deadline was missed and asks what reasonable conditions and objective grounds for refusing access mean, and who decides disputes.
These members do regret the slow implementation of the broadband directive; it should already have been implemented on 1 January 2016.
Deze leden betreuren wel de trage implementatie van de richtlijn breedband; deze had namelijk al op 1 januari 2016 geïmplementeerd moeten zijn.
Asks whether a removal request by the obligated party must be reasonable and whether the balance of interests is preserved, and how sensitive critical infrastructure information is protected.
They ask to what extent the proposed text now ensures that a removal request by the obligated party is also made on reasonable grounds.
Zij vragen in hoeverre de voorgestelde wetstekst nu verzekert dat een verzoek van de gedoogplichtige tot verwijdering ook een verzoek op redelijke gronden is.
Opposes deleting article 3.24 because it has lowered broadcaster tariffs and prevented disputes, and asks the government to keep the provision.
Can the government maintain this provision?
Kan de regering deze bepaling in stand houden?
Worries that deleting article 3.24 without a replacement lets mast operators raise tariffs and asks for a statutory guarantee of transparent, non-discriminatory pricing.
Is the government willing to include in the law a guarantee that tariffs for use of these masts remain transparent, efficient and non-discriminatory
Is de regering bereid om in de wet een waarborg op te nemen zodat de tarieven voor het gebruik van deze masten transparant, efficiënt en non-discriminatoir blijven
Fears cost increases for mast sharing given the near-monopoly and asks the government to restore the reasonable-fee provision; also asks about the agricultural exemption from dig-up notification.
The SGP members fear cost increases for shared use, because as noted earlier there is in practice a monopoly.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vrezen kostenstijgingen voor het medegebruik, omdat zoals eerder aangegeven in de praktijk sprake is van een monopolie.
Asks why article 3.24 is being removed given its proven value, what happens to access to masts at reasonable prices, and whether removal requests must be reasonable and misuse prevented.
According to the VVD members, a request for removal of unused ducts or cables should be reasonable, which is not included in the proposed amendment.
Een verzoek tot verwijdering van ongebruikte buizen of kabels dient volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie redelijk te zijn, hetgeen niet is opgenomen in de voorgestelde wetswijziging.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill implementing the broadband directive (Wet informatie-uitwisseling bovengrondse en ondergrondse netten) be sent to parliament only after adaptation, raising concerns about the dispute procedure, vague security grounds, broad delegation to the ACM, and municipal powers. The minister's nader rapport accepted many points, partly followed others (dispute procedure, transposition delay, explanatory memorandum), and rejected the delegation-to-ACM and municipal-powers objections while explaining the reasons.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that the broad delegation of tasks and powers to the ACM by general administrative order should be regulated in the law itself, but the government kept the delegation provisions as they are.

The Afdeling objected that the dispute procedure in the draft gave the telecom company an independent right to carry out works without ACM ruling; the government redrafted article 5.3 so both parties can refer disputes to the ACM, including testing the duty to tolerate.

The Afdeling found the term 'veiligheid' in the exemption for critical national infrastructure vague (security versus safety); the government clarified in the explanatory memorandum that it is a broad concept.

The Afdeling said the scope of municipal powers over excavation works under the 'openbare orde en veiligheid' clause was unclear and too narrow; the government kept the provision unchanged as in the existing WION.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of the late transposition of the directive and fuller explanatory notes, including a transposition table; the government addressed the delay and added a transposition table and clarifications.
The Afdeling made numerous redactional remarks, most of which the government adopted, with exceptions for provisions copied unchanged from the WION.

34757.s: This omnibus bill amends the Aviation Act, the Railways Act, the Plant Protection and Biocides Act, the Port State Control Act, the Seafarers Act, the Recreational Craft Act 2016 and the Passenger Transport Act 2000 with mostly technical and textual corrections. Its main substantive change is to let the Minister order removal of a foreign ship from port when it lacks a required conformity document, and to require port operators to refuse such ships.
34757.j: The memorandum justifies the removal power as implementing EU Regulation 2015/757 and notes that the Inspectorate has assessed the change as enforceable.
q: The Minister may decide to remove a ship from a port if an inspection establishes that the certificate or conformity document required by the directive is not on board.

Onze Minister kan een besluit nemen tot verwijdering van een schip uit een haven indien bij een inspectie wordt vastgesteld dat het certificaat, bedoeld in bijlage IV, onder 41, van de richtlijn of het conformiteitsdocument, bedoeld in bijlage IV, onder 50, van de richtlijn, niet aan boord is.
d: removal orders for ships lacking conformity document
administrative sanctions for breach of STCW/SOLAS/MLC rules in English
p: Gives the Minister discretion to order removal of a foreign ship from port when a conformity document is absent during inspection.
Formalises that competence to assess train drivers rests with the rail operator under whose authority the function is exercised, replacing a ministerial mandate arrangement.

parties: Asks how a regional-consultation obligation for helicopter airports is lost and whether draagvlak will be secured; the VVD's own point concerns avoiding double burdens and keeping the Chamber informed.
The VVD members stressed during the AO on ship pollution of 5 September 2017 that the maritime sector must not be confronted with double burdens in any way.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben tijdens het algemeen overleg (AO) Scheepsverontreiniging van 5 september 2017 benadrukt dat de maritieme sector geenszins met dubbele lasten mag worden geconfronteerd.
Questions whether the change to Dutch-language penalties is strictly necessary and demands a sounder justification, given that penalty provisions should be in Dutch.

The CDA members would like a more concrete, sound justification that goes beyond difficult-to-translate English texts with the risk of discrepancies or confusion for the target group.](Note: justification is partly CDA-led.)

Graag zien de leden van de CDA-fractie een concretere, deugdelijke onderbouwing, die verder strekt dan moeilijk vertaalbare Engelse teksten met de kans op discrepanties of verwarring bij de doelgroep.
Presses for an automatic removal sanction for ships that repeatedly fail monitoring rules, criticises the non-automatic approach, and questions whether the ILT has capacity for the added tasks.

These members ask whether the government is willing to introduce the automatic sanction that, after ships fail monitoring and reporting rules for two consecutive periods and other enforcement measures have failed, removal will follow unless very exceptional circumstances apply.

Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is tot het invoeren van de automatische sanctie dat nadat schepen twee opeenvolgende rapportageperiodes niet aan de monitorings- en rapportagevoorschriften hebben voldaan en andere maatregelen ter waarborging van de handhaving hebben gefaald, een verwijdering zal volgen, tenzij sprake is van zeer bijzondere omstandigheden.

34766.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet SZW 2018) amends many social security, employment and benefits laws, including AOW, WW, Ziektewet, Participatiewet and the Remigratiewet, mostly with technical fixes, data-sharing and recovery tools. It also gives the SVB and UWV new enforcement and data powers and lets ministers set rules by ministerial regulation.
34766.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers mainly as cost savings, risk avoidance for the SVB and administrative efficiency, citing pilots and practical enforcement needs rather than detailed legal safeguards.
q: The main collection instrument is the power to issue a dwangbevel, which quickly, cheaply and simply yields an executory title.
Het belangrijkste invorderingsinstrument is de mogelijkheid om een dwangbevel uit te vaardigen waarmee op snelle, goedkope en simpele manier een executoriale titel kan worden verworven.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel A (Algemene Ouderdomswet, art. 7a, lid 2)
further increase of pensionable and starting age, announced in Staatscourant
designating administrations whose data exempt citizens from disclosure duty
designating administrations and authentic data exempting from disclosure duty
Artikel XIX, onderdeel A (Wet IOW, art. 12 lid 1)
designating administrations and data exempting from disclosure duty
Artikel XXI (WML) and Wet IOW/WIA lid-level delegations
defining income under Algemeen inkomensbesluit for WIA
Artikel XXV, onderdeel B (Wet SUWI, art. 30b lid 6)
opening vacancies only to specified age categories
Artikel XXVI (Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein, art. 3.1 lid 4 / 3.3)
rules on wage-cost allowances, moved to Minister of SZW
designating public-law body to support Zvw-pgb holders and funding
Artikel XXXI, onderdeel C (WIA, art. 21 lid 6)
defining income for WIA purposes, deeming unrealised income as earned
Artikel XIV, onderdeel C (Wet arbeidsvoorwaarden gedetacheerde werknemers, art. 4 and 8)
data processing and sharing with supervisory bodies
p: Conversion of old WW benefits to new law is left to a general administrative order, which can change the daily wage calculation without statutory rules.
Artikel IX (Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs, art. 7c)
Requires job seekers' identity documents to be verified and copied by intermediaries before placement, expanding state-mandated data processing on individuals.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (Algemene Kinderbijslagwet, art. 41a)
Transitional rule preserving the prior benefit regime for one prior year; minor.
Artikel II, onderdeel C (Algemene Ouderdomswet, art. 24a)
Lets the SVB recover unduly paid pension from heirs and enforce via dwangbevel, a fast executive enforcement route with limited review.
Artikel V, onderdeel E (Participatiewet, art. 47b and 47c)
Gives the SVB the college's sanction powers and spreading of benefit reductions over up to three months, shifting enforcement discretion to the SVB.
Artikel VI, onderdeel C (Remigratiewet, art. 6e lid 7-8)
Extends recovery limitation period to ten years for certain failures to disclose information, while shortening it for low-income debtors.
Artikel VIII, onderdeel C (Werkloosheidswet, art. 27 lid 7)
Introduces a warning power by UWV for failure to comply with the job-search obligation, expanding administrative sanctioning discretion.
Adds a warning power for failing to comply with an obligation under the Ziektewet, expanding sanctioning discretion.
Artikel XV, onderdeel C (Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, art. 38)
Lets the inspector set premium rates for government successor employers by administrative decision subject to objection, a routine administrative change.

parties: Asks how the SVB's new power to issue a dwangbevel relates to other social security laws and questions whether the warning power for sollicitatieverplichting is sufficiently incentivising.
The members ask to what extent this power of the SVB to issue a dwangbevel also applies under other social security laws and schemes in combination with death.

De leden vragen in hoeverre deze bevoegdheid tot het uitvaardigen van een dwangbevel door de SVB ook van toepassing is bij andere wetten en regelingen in het kader van de sociale zekerheid, in combinatie met overlijden?
Asks the government to make concrete and justify the claimed improvements to the WagwEU amendments and to separate small policy changes from technical ones.

The members of the PVV faction ask the government to make all supplemented provisions regarding the amendments to the WagwEU concrete and to justify in what way these are, according to the government, an actual improvement compared to the current situation.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen aan de regering alle aangevulde bepalingen ten aanzien van de wijzigingen in de WagwEU concreet te maken en te motiveren op welke manier deze volgens de regering een feitelijke verbetering zijn ten opzichte van de huidige situatie.

Asks for a clear schematic distinction between small policy changes and technical ones and seeks justification for delegating age-based vacancy rules to an AMvB, questioning compatibility with equal treatment.
Can the government also indicate how this proposal relates to the principle of equality and to age discrimination?
Kan de regering tevens aangeven hoe dit voorstel zich verhoudt tot het gelijkheidsbeginsel en tot leeftijdsdiscriminatie?

Asks whether the deurwaarder can still set the beslagvrije voet without the creditor information being removed, and whether the age-based vacancy power is necessary and how it fits the anti-discrimination action plan.
Raises questions on the compensation scheme's temporary limitation and whether it will reduce employer uptake.
Does this not carry the risk that employers will still make little use of the scheme, because it only applies for two years?
Brengt dit niet het risico met zich mee dat werkgevers alsnog weinig gebruik zullen maken van de regeling, omdat deze maar twee jaar geldt?

Questions whether the removal of the total claim disclosure in debt collection may cause debtors unnecessary costs and whether the dwangbevel is too severe during bereavement; also asks whether non-benefit recipients are excluded from the quota register.
Is the government aware that the obligation for the creditor to state their total claim disappears, while the bailiff needs this information to estimate whether to proceed to attachment?

Is de regering zich bewust dat de verplichting voor de instantie die verrekent om hun totale vordering te vermelden verdwijnt, terwijl de gerechtsdeurwaarder deze informatie nodig heeft om in te schatten of hij tot beslaglegging overgaat?

Asks why the age threshold for the compensation scheme is 56 rather than lower, whether the 'structural' surplus of the Anw fund is real, and requests a fuller response to employer organisations' criticism.
Asks about the effects of limiting wage offsetting for seasonal workers in agriculture and the feasibility of the voortschrijdend cumulatief rekenen method for private insurers.
They ask what options the government sees to preserve this favourable situation when the amendment to the Minimum Wage Act takes effect.
Zij vragen welke mogelijkheden ziet om deze gunstige situatie te behouden wanneer de wijziging van de Wet minimumloon in werking treedt.
Asks how the reference to actual worker productivity in the piece-rate norm fits the Van 't Wout-Heerma amendment's average-productive-worker standard, and what evidence employers must provide.
The VVD asks the government which data must appear in the documents employers must be able to produce, since the explanation on actual productivity raises questions.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering welke gegevens precies dienen te blijken uit de bescheiden die werkgevers moeten kunnen overleggen, nu de toelichting op het punt van de feitelijke productie vragen oproept.

Asks the government to explain the net-income effect of overtime offsetting and the limited competitiveness impact in agriculture, and the consequences for private implementers of ending the tolerated situation.
The SGP asks whether the government has considered the consequences for private implementers when the tolerated situation of the Belastingdienst is ended.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of de regering zich rekenschap heeft gegeven van de gevolgen voor private uitvoerders wanneer de door de Belastingdienst gedoogde situatie wordt beëindigd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the Verzamelwet SZW 2018 to parliament, with remarks on the age distinction for publishing vacancies in the Wet SUWI (the text was made to match the explanatory memorandum) and on the temporary extension of the sick-pay wage-cost compensation scheme to age 56 (the government replied that the explanatory memorandum was amended and that the scheme's target group is defined by birth dates, so the predicted gap does not arise). The minister's reply accepts the remarks and includes a redactional annex addressed in full.
concerns: The text of the proposed sixth paragraph of article 30b Wet SUWI made publishing vacancies mandatory for certain age groups, contrary to the explanatory memorandum, and was brought into line with the memorandum.

The temporary age-56 extension of the compensation scheme would cause people to drop out of the scheme and re-qualify later; the explanatory memorandum was amended and the government argues the gap will not occur because the target group is defined by birth date.
The Afdeling offered a set of redactional corrections in an annex (wording, numbering, consistency of order and references), which were followed.

34775-IIA.s: This bill sets the 2018 budget of the Staten-Generaal (States General, the Dutch parliament), fixing expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros by policy article. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and does not change oversight or checks on the executive.
q: Article 1: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2018 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34829.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Grootegast, Leek, Marum and Zuidhorn and merges them with part of Winsum into a new municipality called Westerkwartier, effective on a date set by royal decree. It also designates Leek as the reference municipality under the Wet algemene regels herindeling and assigns the new municipality transitional rules on local taxes, joint arrangements and utilities, plus a change to the Wet veiligheidsregio's annex.
34829.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by noting that the provincial financial supervision under the Gemeentewet finds the affected municipalities run sound finances, with no explicit justification for the royal decree timing power.
q: Based on the financial supervision carried out by the province of Groningen under the Municipalities Act, the province finds that the municipalities concerned pursue a sober and sound financial policy.

Op basis van het door de provincie Groningen gevoerde financieel toezicht op grond van de Gemeentewet constateert de provincie dat de betrokken gemeenten een sober en degelijk financieel beleid voeren.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Sees no reason for comments or questions, as the merger is voluntary and driven by the municipalities themselves.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Objects that the merger advice and the province's view were only published on a website and not attached to the explanatory memorandum, and asks that they be sent to the House.
They are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Zij zijn van mening dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
Welcomes the bottom-up process and expects a financially capable municipality; has no further questions at this stage.
They have no further questions at this stage of the process.
Zij hebben op dit moment in het proces geen nadere vragen.
Asks how residents, organisations and local politics were involved in the proposal and how access to facilities is guaranteed in the larger municipality.
These members ask the government to explain again how the residents, civil society organisations and local politics of the municipalities were involved in the proposal.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest.
Asks whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and why a merger was pursued without majority support.
According to the SP members, mergers should only take place from the bottom up, if the population supports them.
Herindelingen zouden volgens de leden van de SP-fractie alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Endorses the planned merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the planned merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.

34838.s: The bill creates a permit regime allowing the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management to authorise experiments on public roads with automated motor vehicles whose driver is outside the vehicle, with the permit able to exempt from provisions of the Road Traffic Act 1994 and other laws. It also extends the existing exemption framework and sets a five-year evaluation duty.
34838.j: The memorandum justifies the permit and exemption powers by the need for flexibility to test new automated technology whose driver is outside the vehicle, which existing exemptions cannot cover.
q: This bill makes it possible for the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management to grant a permit for experiments testing automated systems in motor vehicles without a driver inside.

Dit wetsvoorstel maakt het mogelijk dat voor experimenten voor het testen van geautomatiseerde systemen in motorrijtuigen waarin zich geen bestuurder bevindt door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat een vergunning kan worden verleend.
d: exemptions from provisions of the Road Traffic Act and other laws for experiments
rules on application procedure, documents, decision deadline and transmission of permits
p: The Minister may grant exemptions from several statutory provisions in a permit, limited to what is necessary for the experiment and agreed with the minister responsible for the affected law.
The Minister may revoke a permit when traffic safety is at risk, a broad discretionary power subject only to a last-resort principle stated in the explanatory memorandum.
Grounds for refusing a permit include the minister's own judgment on whether the experiment sufficiently contributes to innovation.

parties: Asks when a first evaluation is expected and whether the amendment leaves enough room for the future.
These members ask when a first evaluation can be expected and whether the proposed amendment offers sufficient room for the future.
Deze leden vragen wanneer een eerste evaluatie te verwachten is en of de voorgestelde wijziging voldoende ruimte biedt voor de toekomst.
Questions why liability rests with the driver rather than the manufacturer, and calls the 1942 Hoge Raad case outdated given hacking risks.
Why does the government choose to place liability entirely with the driver and not with the manufacturer?
Waarom kiest de regering ervoor om de aansprakelijkheid volledig bij de bestuurder te leggen en niet bij de fabrikant?
Worries about safety for other road users and unreliable technology, asks about recorders for traceable liability, and questions the lack of a marking requirement for self-driving vehicles.
These members share the Council of State's view that it is desirable to require such vehicles to be equipped so that the environment clearly recognises a vehicle with a remote driver.

De leden van de CDA-fractie delen het standpunt van de Raad van State dat een verplichting wenselijk is om de desbetreffende voertuigen zodanig uit te rusten dat voor de omgeving duidelijk is dat het om een voertuig met een bestuurder op afstand gaat.

Supports experiments but asks why the Council of State's advice on marking vehicles was not included, stresses optimal licensing decisions, and asks for EU coordination and information for road users.
Can the government indicate the reasons for not including this?
Kan de regering aangeven wat de redenen zijn om dit niet op te nemen?
Asks why the SWOV and road managers are not standardly involved in risk analysis, and whether vehicles must be recognisable as self-driving, and raises hacking and ethics questions.
Why does the government not choose, for reasons of care, to standardly involve the SWOV and relevant road managers?
Waarom kiest de regering er uit het oogpunt van zorgvuldigheid niet voor om standaard de SWOV en betrokken wegbeheerders in te schakelen?

v.summary: The Council of State's Advisory Division advised on a bill amending the Road Traffic Act 1994 to allow experiments with self-driving vehicles where the driver operates remotely from outside the vehicle; it found the current 'bestuurder' definition not necessarily in need of change but raised concerns on experiment scope, maximum duration, marking of vehicles, number of vehicles per operator, liability risks and competence allocation. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely adopted the advice, including a maximum three-year permit period, shifting competence to the Minister, and clarifying conditions, while not following the advice to mandate a marking requirement or set an end date for granting permits.
concerns: The Division asked for criteria in the statute for assessing permit applications and a clear sunset date for granting new permits; the government added refusal grounds but did not set an end date.
The Division asked for a maximum duration for individual experiments; the government added a three-year maximum.
The Division advised mandating that the environment be alerted that a vehicle is remotely driven; the government declined to make this a fixed requirement.
The Division flagged unresolved questions on the number of vehicles one remote driver may control; the government left this to case-by-case conditions.
The Division warned that accident liability must not leave victims worse off; the government required proof of adequate insurance and clarified liability rules.
The Division advised giving licensing competence to the Minister rather than the RDW to avoid conflicting decisions; the government did so.
Redactional points on terminology ('voorschriften' instead of 'voorwaarden') and cost recovery were adopted.

34847.s: The bill amends the Wft to implement the EU SFTR regulation, adding that certain private legal acts violating SFTR rules are not voidable for that reason alone and allowing an AMvB to extend professional bans for SFTR breaches to managers of non-financial firms. It also states that the regulation's own sanction rules are to be applied through a general administrative order.
34847.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the SFTR's requirement that supervisors can impose temporary bans on managers, and by limiting the AMvB to provisions where a binding EU act mandates such sanctions.
q: With the phrase 'to the extent a binding EU legal act requires it' it is intended to express that the power to name a regulation provision in an AMvB is used only where a binding EU legal act, almost always a regulation, mandates it.

Met de zinsnede «voor zover een bindende EU-rechtshandeling daartoe verplicht» is beoogd onder woorden te brengen dat van de bevoegdheid om bij amvb een verordeningsbepaling te noemen alleen dan gebruik wordt gemaakt, indien een bindende EU-rechtshandeling, vrijwel altijd een verordening, dat dwingend voorschrijft.
d: naming EU regulation provisions for professional bans on managers of other firms
p: Allows an AMvB to extend professional bans to managers of non-financial firms, limited to cases where the underlying EU regulation mandates it, restricting individuals' freedom to practise a profession.

parties: Asks why the power to ban persons from exercising functions was not previously codified in the Wft and about the direct and indirect financial and administrative burden on business.
The VVD members ask what the reason was that this power had not yet been codified in the Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft).
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wat de reden was dat deze bevoegdheid nog niet gecodificeerd was in de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft).
Asks for examples of non-financial undertakings that could face a possible management ban and whether other Wft provisions also apply to non-financial undertakings.
The CDA members ask for some examples of non-financial undertakings that in practice could face a possible management ban.](#)
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen naar enkele voorbeelden van niet-financiële ondernemingen die in de praktijk te maken kunnen krijgen met een mogelijk bestuursverbod.

Questions the financial system's shadow banking and the public benefit of such products, asks why the supervisor cannot impose a permanent management ban, and asks how enforcement of the ban power will be supervised.

The SP members ask the government why the supervisor cannot simply impose a permanent management ban on persons responsible for infringements of the reporting obligation prescribed in the regulation.](#)

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom de toezichthouder niet gewoon een definitief bestuursverbod op kan leggen aan personen verantwoordelijk voor inbreuken op de, in de verordening voorgeschreven, rapportageverplichting.

34874.s: The bill expands the enforcement toolkit of the Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg across more than twenty public health statutes, mainly by letting the Minister impose administrative enforcement orders (last onder bestuursdwang) to compel cooperation under Awb art. 5:20. It also gives inspectors access to prescriptions and donor records without patient consent, creates a GLP laboratory certification regime with cost recovery, and makes minor technical amendments.
34874.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the Inspectie's need for effective enforcement and the practical failure of criminal-only sanctions, and cites prior evaluations and a privacy-proportionality analysis for the record-access powers.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel C (art. 87a Wet BIG)
imposing administrative enforcement orders for cooperation duty
fee amounts for GLP laboratory certification
p: Artikel II, onderdelen A and B (art. 65a, 79 Wet BIG)
Allows the Minister to designate inspectorate officials with prosecutorial powers in disciplinary proceedings.

Gives inspectors access to prescriptions, overriding the professional secrecy exception that normally protects patient records, subject to necessity.  Bypasses the usual right to refuse under Awb 5:20(2).  Access is limited to what is necessary for the inspection task.  Patient consent is not required.  Confidentiality duties bind the official.  Compulsion is by daily penalty.  Accessible records are tied to supervision of the stated provisions only.  No judicial authorisation is required.  Cooperation duty backed by enforcement.  Scope is narrow but intrusive.
Artikel V, A (art. 10 para. 3 Wet donorgegevens kunstmatige bevruchting)
Gives inspectors access to donor records held by clinics and the donor registry without patient or donor consent, limited to necessity for supervision of the donor-data obligation.
Artikel I, II C, IV, V B, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X, XI, XII, XIII, XIV, XV, XVI, XVII, XVIII, XIX, XX B, XXVII, XXVIII, XXIX
Adds to many statutes a ministerial power to impose administrative enforcement orders to enforce the Awb 5:20 duty to cooperate with supervisors, replacing criminal-only enforcement.

parties: Asks whether the inspectorate's access powers to patient files are necessary, proportionate and subject to adequate checks and balances.
The right of access can be an important part of good supervision, but the VVD members believe its use must be applied carefully.
Het inzagerecht kan een belangrijk onderdeel zijn van goed toezicht, maar de leden van de VVD-fractie zijn van mening dat inzet daarvan zorgvuldig dient plaats te vinden.
Asks what safeguards ensure the inspectorate's access to prescriptions and records is used proportionately and only when strictly necessary.
These members ask what guarantees exist that the access power is used proportionately.
Genoemde leden vragen welke waarborgen er zijn dat de inzagebevoegdheid proportioneel wordt ingezet.
Stresses patient privacy and asks how proportionate use of inspectorate access powers is guaranteed and how often they have been used.
These members therefore see inspectorate access rights as an instrument to be used only in exceptional circumstances.
Recht op inzage voor de inspectie zien deze leden dan ook als een instrument waarvan alleen in bijzondere omstandigheden gebruik dient worden gemaakt.
Worries about medical confidentiality and patient privacy and questions whether inspectorate access to patient files is truly necessary and how proportionality is monitored.
The GroenLinks members express concern about safeguarding medical confidentiality and the privacy of patient data.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie uiten hun zorgen rondom de waarborging van het medisch beroepsgeheim en de privacy van patiëntgegevens.

Supports a strong inspectorate and mandatory publication of reports, but asks whether independent inspection must always occur after incidents and questions oversight of access powers and of Wmo supervision by municipalities.
These members favour a strong inspectorate.
Genoemde leden zijn voorstander van een sterke inspectie.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum misdescribes the Minister's instruction power over the health inspectorate IGZ, since a ministerial decree cannot remove the statutory power, and that the mandate regulation conflicts with the Besluit taakuitoefening IGZ. The government's nader rapport rejects both points, arguing the decree was meant to protect inspectorate independence and that the mandate concerns a different instruction power.
concerns: The Afdeling considers that the ministerial decree and its explanation wrongly suggest the Minister can no longer give instructions in specific cases, which a lower regulation cannot do given the statutory allocation of competence.
The Afdeling finds the mandate of the instruction power to the IGZ in the Mandaatregeling VWS inconsistent with the Besluit taakuitoefening IGZ and advises amending one of them.

The Afdeling advises adapting the explanatory memorandum to reflect that ministerial responsibility is unaffected and that the independence policy should be stated as a policy commitment rather than a decree.

34883.s: The bill implements the EU NIS Directive by creating the Cybersecurity Act (Cybersecuritywet), which imposes security requirements and incident reporting duties on essential service providers and digital service providers and designates the Minister of Justice and Security as central contact point and CSIRT. It sets up administrative enforcement (audits, binding instructions, orders under administrative coercion, fines) by sectoral competent authorities and rules on data processing and confidentiality of information.
34883.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to concretise the directive's security obligations per sector and to avoid duplication with sector-specific rules, and states that enforcement with binding instructions and fines is required by the directive.
q: By general administrative order or by decision of an administrative body named in that order, the following are designated
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur of bij besluit van een bij die maatregel genoemd bestuursorgaan worden aangewezen
d: designation of essential service providers and vital providers
disapplying security rules where sector-specific EU rules apply
designation of CSIRT for digital services
designation of other computer crisis teams to receive confidential data
further rules on security audits and their cost
designation of other computer crisis teams for forwarding voluntary reports
p: The Minister may share confidential provider data with other organisations or the public and sets aside the Public Access to Government Act for such data, subject only to consultation with the provider.
The competent authority may issue binding instructions to providers to take specified security measures within a set deadline.
Enforcement through orders under administrative coercion and administrative fines, subject to ordinary administrative law remedies.

parties: Asks how organisations can determine whether they fall under the DSP definition and what the differences are between the Wgmc and the Csw.
These members ask how organisations can check whether the DSP definition applies to them.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze organisaties kunnen toetsen of de definitie van een DSP op hen van toepassing is.
Questions the choice of multiple ministries as competent authorities, the dual reporting obligation, and whether the national cybersecurity strategy is still up to date.
Does the government recognise that this may lead to fragmentation and confusion for the AEDs dealing with the competent authority?
Ziet de regering in dat dit wellicht tot fragmentatie kan leiden en tot onduidelijkheid bij de AED's die met de bevoegde autoriteit te maken zullen krijgen?
Asks for clarity on the sharing of confidential data with the AIVD and on the breadth of the cloud service definition and the exemption of small DSPs.

Questions the necessity and proportionality of obtaining personal data incompatible with the original purpose, and asks about access, sharing and oversight by the Data Protection Authority; also asks for annual transparency reporting.
These members therefore ask the government for an analysis of the necessity and proportionality of this statutory power to request personal data whose disclosure conflicts with purpose limitation.

Voornoemde leden vragen de regering kortom naar een analyse van de noodzakelijkheid en proportionaliteit van deze wettelijke mogelijkheid om te verzoeken om persoonsgegevens waarvan verstrekking in strijd is met het beginsel van doelbinding.
Asks why water defences under regional water boards are excluded, whether the Data Protection Authority's advice on non-vital parties will be followed, and which body will act as CSIRT for DSPs.
These members note that the Data Protection Authority advised leaving parties other than vital providers and digital service providers outside the bill.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens heeft geadviseerd andere partijen dan vitale aanbieders en digitale dienstverleners onder het wetsvoorstel te laten vallen.
Focuses on administrative burden of multiple reporting obligations and on whether public access requests under the Wob could expose sensitive security information.

These members ask whether the number of reporting obligations can be reduced, or whether reports on one incident can be made once to the various bodies, to limit administrative burden as much as possible.

Deze leden vragen of er mogelijkheden zijn dit aantal meldplichten terug te dringen dan wel ervoor te zorgen dat meldingen die betrekking hebben op één incident in één keer gedaan kunnen worden bij de verschillende instanties, om de administratieve lasten zoveel mogelijk te beperken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the government to proceed with the Cybersecurity Act implementing the NIS Directive, but to amend provisions allowing DNB to share confidential supervisory information with the Minister of Justice and Security, which lacked limits on relevance, proportionality and confidentiality safeguards. In the nader rapport the government accepted the criticism and dropped the Wft information-sharing provision, while adding editorial and technical changes.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the sharing of confidential Wft supervisory information with the Minister and DNB-Cybertoezicht lacked limits on relevance, proportionality and safeguarding of confidentiality, security and commercial interests.
The Afdeling noted that the two overlapping information-sharing provisions in the Wft and the Csw are inconsistent and not explained, and asked for clarification or amendment.
The Afdeling made a series of editorial remarks, including corrections to cross-references, the transposition table and a definition, which the government largely adopted.

34937.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Defence by increasing expenditure by EUR 3.37 million, mainly for border supervision on Sint Maarten following hurricane Irma. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 17 April 2018 with retroactive effect where publication is late.
34937.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by the vulnerability of border supervision on Sint Maarten during reconstruction after hurricane Irma and a political condition set by the Dutch government.
q: For that reason the Countries consider it necessary that border supervision be substantially strengthened.
Om die reden achten de Landen het noodzakelijk dat het grenstoezicht substantieel wordt versterkt.

34950-X.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements (departmental budget of the Ministry of Defence and the agency budgets for DTO and Paresto) through a supplementary adjustment, setting amounts in thousands of euros and taking effect retroactively to 31 December 2017. It is a budgetary wrap-up law with no delegation of rule-making power and no shift of power towards the executive.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2017 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd

34982.s: The bill adds new criminal offences to the Dutch Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands Criminal Code for bringing or attempting to bring prohibited objects into prisons, juvenile institutions and psychiatric detention facilities, including bringing objects in outside the prescribed screening procedure. Penalties are up to six months detention or a third-category fine.
34982.j: The memorandum justifies the new offences by the need to protect order and security in institutions and to close gaps where screening cannot stop prohibited objects.
q: When it is established that a detainee has a prohibited object in his possession, a disciplinary measure or punishment may be imposed on him.
Wanneer wordt geconstateerd dat een gedetineerde een verboden voorwerp in zijn bezit heeft, kan aan hem een ordemaatregel of disciplinaire straf worden opgelegd.
d: prohibited objects and the rules for bringing objects into institutions
p: Criminal liability depends partly on prison directors' house rules and screening procedures, which broadens the scope of punishable conduct determined by executive regulation.
The Caribbean Netherlands offence likewise depends on applicable rules for bringing objects into institutions, extending criminal exposure through executive rules.

parties: Welcomes criminalising smuggling of contraband into prisons and asks only some clarifying questions.
With this bill this unjust situation is being corrected.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt deze onrechtvaardige situatie rechtgezet.

Asks whether staff of the prison service will be prosecuted only in exceptional cases, as the advice of the Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing recommended excluding staff, and asks about intent requirements that could catch unintentional carriers.
In the advice of the Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection, the CDA members read that it is advised not to bring prison staff within the scope of the proposed article.

In het advies van de Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming lezen de leden van de CDA-fractie dat geadviseerd wordt personeel van een justitiële inrichting niet onder de reikwijdte van het voorgestelde artikel te laten vallen.
