Not yet convinced of necessity; questions whether reversing the burden of proof for visitors who did not know they carried an item is compatible with the presumption of innocence under the Salabiaku case law.
They understand from the Salabiaku judgment that the legislature has some room to reverse the burden of proof, provided the presumption of guilt is sufficiently rebuttable.

Zij begrijpen uit het Salabiaku-arrest (arrest van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens van 7 oktober 1988, nr. 10519/83, Salabiaku tegen Frankrijk) dat de wetgever enige ruimte heeft om de bewijslast om te keren, mits het vermoeden van schuld maar in voldoende mate weerlegbaar is.

Asks how the prohibited-item rules, which can differ per prison as set by the director, will be made known to inmates, visitors and staff, and how the choice between disciplinary and criminal sanction will be guided.
Will the policy differ per facility as a result? If so, does the government consider this desirable?
Zal het beleid per inrichting verschillen met zich meebrengen? Zo ja, acht de regering dit wenselijk?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advises sending the bill on criminalising bringing prohibited objects into prison to parliament, but asks for better justification and adjustment on knowability of house rules, the added value of the new second paragraph, and the missing financial section. The minister's reply accepts all three points, adding a standard list of prohibited objects to the model house rules, clarifying the memorandum on non-compliant introduction of items, and adding a financial paragraph.
concerns: Prohibited objects vary per institution and house rules are not always easily accessible, so a standard list must be added to the model house rules for knowability and legal certainty.
The memorandum must clarify which situations the new criminal provision on non-compliant introduction covers beyond existing offences.
The explanatory memorandum must address the financial consequences for implementation and enforcement, as required by the legislative guidelines.

34991.s: The bill amends Dutch Civil Code Books 8 and 10, the Code of Civil Procedure and the Criminal Code to implement the Rotterdam Rules on international carriage of goods wholly or partly by sea. It largely replaces national sea-carriage provisions with cross-references to the convention, removes articles now covered by it, and adapts terminology to electronic transport documents.
34991.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary for the Netherlands to ratify the UN convention on carriage of goods by sea, with no new executive powers involved.

parties: Notes stakeholder concerns and asks the government to confirm it will not bring the treaty into force until neighbouring countries and major trading partners have ratified, to protect Dutch port competitiveness.

Asks about possible conflicts between the Rotterdam Rules and other transport conventions for multimodal carriage, about the protection afforded to volume contracts, and about who counts as the performing party in a chain of charter agreements.
These members ask the government what consequences this has for other conventions that apply to carriage of goods other than international carriage by sea.
Deze leden vragen de regering welke gevolgen dit heeft ten aanzien van andere verdragen die van toepassing zijn op vervoer van goederen anders dan internationaal over zee.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the Rotterdam Rules implementation bill to parliament but asked the explanatory memorandum to address the consequences for feeder carriers, who may face the higher maritime liability regime and lack a statutory recourse right. The government's reply (nader rapport) added a section on the Convention's effects on feeder transport, and the drafting remarks were followed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain the consequences for feeder carriers (aanvullend vervoerders) whose liability could rise under the Convention beyond maritime carriage.
Redundant proposed article 8:394 BW should be deleted because it overlaps with article 8:395(2) BW, and the distinction in article 8:398 should be clarified against article 15 of the Convention.

35279.s: The bill approves in Dutch law the Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement between the EU, Euratom and their member states, on one side, and Armenia on the other, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Whereas the Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement concluded in Brussels on 24 November 2017 between the EU, Euratom and their member states and the Republic of Armenia requires approval by the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de op 24 november 2017 te Brussel tot stand gekomen Brede en versterkte partnerschapsovereenkomst tussen de Europese Unie en de Europese Gemeenschap voor Atoomenergie en hun lidstaten, enerzijds, en de Republiek Armenië, anderzijds, ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks whether article 9 is essential to the agreement and whether financial assistance under title VII has already produced an available budget and how much.
The VVD members wonder what shows that article 9 forms an essential part of this agreement.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af waaruit blijkt dat artikel 9 «essentieel onderdeel vormt van deze overeenkomst».
Supports the partnership agreement but urges a faster Dutch embassy in Armenia and a stronger diplomatic presence than the government plans.
They again call on the cabinet to strengthen the diplomatic representation in Armenia.
Zij roepen het kabinet opnieuw op om de diplomatieke vertegenwoordiging in Armenië te versterken.
Asks how the agreement concretely advances human rights in Armenia and the rights of minorities, and whether the political dialogue offers enough room for human rights.
Does the regular political dialogue offer (sufficient) room to pay attention to human rights?
Biedt de reguliere politieke dialoog (voldoende) ruimte om aandacht te besteden aan mensenrechten?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the bill approving the Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement between the EU/Euratom and their member states and Armenia, and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Foreign Affairs transmits the advice and confirms that the advice gives no reason for remarks, so no substantive reply is needed.

35288.s: The bill updates the Wet strategische diensten to reference the codified EU anti-torture regulation 2019/125 in place of the earlier regulation 1236/2005. It amends the definition in article 1, the list of prohibited conduct in article 11, and cross-references in articles 14 and 15, with entry into force the day after publication.
q: this codification requires amending the criminalisation of violations of the regulation's articles in the Wet strategische diensten
noopt tot wijziging van de strafbaarstelling van overtreding van artikelen van die verordening in de Wet strategische diensten

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the bill codifying the EU anti-torture regulation into the Wet strategische diensten and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport simply forwards the bill and explanatory memorandum to parliament without further discussion.

35297.s: This bill replaces the Dutch secondary education acts (WVO and WVO BES) with a single new Wet voortgezet onderwijs, applying the European Dutch framework to the Caribbean Netherlands and reorganising the rules into a clearer structure. It also consolidates school types, curricula, governance, staffing, admission and special support provisions, with many details left to lower regulation.
35297.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies delegation to lower regulation by the need for a clear, durable statute with operational detail left to amvb and ministerial rules, in line with Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving.
q: The government therefore proposes to repeal the WVO BES and make the rules of the WVO 20xx applicable in the Caribbean Netherlands.
De regering stelt daarom voor de WVO BES in te trekken en de regels uit de WVO 20xx in Caribisch Nederland van toepassing te verklaren.
d: core objectives (kerndoelen) for first two years
subjects and study load of profiles in vwo and havo
subjects and profile structure in vmbo
school holiday periods and school days
deviation from national criteria for leerwegondersteunend onderwijs
p: Allows the samenwerkingsverband to set its own criteria and duration for assessing pupils for supported learning, departing from national rules, with consent of local school boards.
Gives regional special-support partnerships considerable discretion over placement and support decisions, subject to appeal to an advisory committee.

parties: Asks for clarification on the scope of the quality-care obligation in proposed article 2.92, without raising a check concern.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the present proposal and have a few more questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het onderhavige voorstel en hebben nog een enkele vraag.

Questions why only secondary education is modernised, citing the Council of State's advice that sector laws no longer fit together, and asks whether the quality duty implies a legal standard beyond legal compliance.
Together with the Council of State advisory division, these members ask the government why this modernisation is currently limited to secondary education only.

Met de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: Afdeling) stellen deze leden wel de vraag aan de regering waarom deze actualisering op dit moment alleen voor het voortgezet onderwijs wordt ingezet.
Asks whether the technical changes have practical effects for schools, inspectorate, teachers and pupils, and whether the aim is a single fundamental-education law.
The members of the D66 faction ask the government whether these technical changes have consequences in practice for, for example, secondary schools, the inspectorate, teachers and pupils.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering of deze technische wijzigingen gevolgen hebben in de praktijk op bijvoorbeeld middelbare scholen, de inspectie, leraren en leerlingen.
Argues the bill contains substantive changes despite being described as technical, relying on the Council of State's points, and asks for a response to each.
In its report the Council of State points to a number of matters through which more substantive amendments are proposed.
De Afdeling wijst in haar rapport op een aantal punten waarmee meer inhoudelijke aanpassingen worden voorgesteld.
Accepts the technical aim but asks whether changing the addressee of the WVO to the competent authority (bevoegd gezag) would better serve pupils, given concerns about school boards' spending.

They understand that with this extensive bill the government only aims at a technical amendment of the Secondary Education Act to make it more consistent and accessible and better aligned with the General Administrative Law Act.

Zij begrijpen dat de regering met dit omvangrijke wetsvoorstel slechts een technische wijziging van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs nastreeft opdat deze consistenter en toegankelijker wordt en beter aansluit op de Algemene wet bestuursrecht.

Warns that the new structure weakens the constitutional structuring of the dual education system and the legislator's guidance, and questions article 1.5 binding private competent authorities to statutory requirements without assessing necessity and proportionality.
On the basis of the Constitution they find it objectionable that this contains an automatism whereby statutory requirements apply directly and in full where a (funded) competent authority exists.

Zij vinden het op basis van de Grondwet bezwaarlijk dat hierin een automatisme vervat ligt dat wettelijke eisen direct en onverkort van toepassing zijn indien sprake is van een (bekostigd) bevoegd gezag.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Wet voortgezet onderwijs 20xx, a technical revision of the WVO that also integrates the WVO BES, arguing for an integrated legislative agenda and flagging several specific points such as increased inspectorate accountability, the reintroduction of 'bevoegdheid', and an overly broad aanwijzing power. The minister's reply (nader rapport) largely accepts the call for an agenda and adjusts the bill on most specific points, while defending some choices as purely technical.
concerns: The Council urged an integrated, cross-sector legislative agenda for education law beyond this technical revision; the minister accepts the need but says a rigid agenda could become a straitjacket and will examine how to incorporate the points.

The Council flagged that the zorgplicht on quality in article 2.92 extending to 'in elk geval' could imply a broader inspection remit; the minister clarified the wording reflects existing law and the commentary was adjusted.

The Council found the explicit obligation to comply with a ministerial aanwijzing too broad, enabling funding sanctions without a breach of statutory rules; the minister removed the explicit obligation while keeping the existing sanction power under article 10.1.
The Council noted that the duty to provide education to sick pupils was reworded from 'adequaat' to 'effectief' without explanation; the minister restored the original terminology.

The Council asked that the reintroduction of the term 'bevoegdheid' for teachers and the many new definitions be reconsidered; the minister defended both as technical improvements to readability while trimming several definitions.

35396.s: The bill converts ProRail from a private limited company into a public-law independent administrative body (zbo) with its own legal personality, a board of management and a supervisory board. It sets out ProRail's statutory tasks, its exemption power under Article 22 of the Spoorwegwet, governance and reporting rules, and the Minister's oversight powers, while keeping essential functions independent as required by EU rail directive 2012/34/EU.
35396.j: The memorandum justifies the independence of ProRail and the delegations by EU rail directive requirements and the need for clearer roles and public accountability.
q: The desired ministerial powers regarding the performance of tasks must also be proportionate to the scope of the Minister's responsibility.
De gewenste ministeriële bevoegdheden ten aanzien van de uitvoering van taken moeten bovendien in verhouding staan tot de reikwijdte van de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister.
d: ProRail tasks, tariffs and detailed rules
rules on information, transparency and access to rail capacity
conditions and tariffs for works for third parties
waiver of policy rules and annulment power for essential functions
budget, annual accounts, reserves, reporting and supervision rules
information duties and audits towards the Minister
incompatibility of board and supervisory board positions
designation of persons supervising compliance with Article 22
rules on exercise of fining power by the manager
Artikel VI, lid 3-4 / Artikel VII, lid 3
transitional rules and continued application of 2020-2021 management plan
p: Statutory tasks are transferred from the Minister to the new zbo ProRail, reducing direct ministerial control over operational rail management.
The Kaderwet's policy-rule and annulment powers and employee-law provisions are disapplied for ProRail's essential functions, removing ministerial oversight over those functions.[...]
A supervisory board with prior-consent rights over budget, plans and tariffs strengthens internal checks on the board of management.
Enforcement fines and penalties by the ACM apply to ProRail under the bill, creating external sanction powers.

parties: Asks whether the conversion is a principled choice rather than a necessity and how the independence of the rail infrastructure manager is guaranteed under EU law.
These members wonder to what extent this must be a principled choice.
Deze leden vragen zich af in hoeverre het hier moet gaan om een principiële keuze.
Questions why the conversion must go ahead despite opposition from the sector and the Council of State, and whether the minister will withdraw the bill if a Chamber majority asks.
These members ask whether the government is willing to withdraw this proposal if a majority in the Chamber calls for it.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is dit voorstel in te trekken wanneer een meerderheid in de Kamer daartoe oproept.
Asks what problem the bill solves, how seriously the government weighs the Council of State's advice and risks, and whether existing steering instruments are insufficient.
Does the government think it is taking a major risk with this bill?
Vindt de regering dat zij een groot risico neemt met dit wetsvoorstel?
Sees the conversion as improving the Chamber's control over rail spending, but asks how users' interests and information flows to stakeholders will be safeguarded, including via a user council.
The intention improves the position of the House of Representatives regarding control and oversight of spending on rail infrastructure in our country.
Het voornemen verbetert de positie van de Tweede Kamer aangaande de controle en het toezicht op de besteding van gelden voor de spoorweginfrastructuur in ons land.
Not yet convinced there is a problem requiring conversion; stresses the Council of State's strong advice to reconsider and the risks to cooperation with NS.
However, these members are not yet convinced that there is or threatens to be a problem that can or must be solved by changing the legal form and steering.
Deze leden zijn er echter vooralsnog niet van overtuigd dat er nu een probleem is of dreigt, dat met een wijziging van de rechtsvorm en aansturing kan of moet worden opgelost.
Rejects the conversion, citing broad sector opposition, risks to NS cooperation, unclear financial consequences and unclear legal basis for cooperation obligations.

The conversion of ProRail into a zbo cannot count on these members' support without substantive argumentation, given the resistance of the entire sector and the verticalisation of relations between ProRail and NS.

De omvorming van ProRail tot zbo kan zonder inhoudelijke argumentatie, de weerstand van de gehele sector en de verticalisering van de verhoudingen tussen ProRail en NS niet rekenen op de steun van deze leden.
Asks why an agency form was not chosen instead, and how the conversion helps the client role of provinces and resolves disputes such as the Kamperlijn case.
Does the government in principle not consider conversion into an agency, with appropriate safeguards on capacity allocation decisions and independence of oversight, the better option?

Acht de regering ten principale de omvorming naar een agentschap, met daarbij vanzelfsprekend goede waarborgen inzake bijvoorbeeld de besluitvorming over de capaciteitsverdeling en de onafhankelijkheid van het toezicht, niet de betere optie?
Asks why the strengthened cooperation between ProRail and carriers will not be jeopardised by the structural change and why the current framework cannot be improved instead.

These members would like to hear why the government believes the sharply improved cooperation between ProRail and rail operators in recent years will not be jeopardised by the proposed structural change.

Deze leden horen graag waarom de regering van mening is dat de in de afgelopen jaren sterk verbeterde samenwerking tussen ProRail en de spoorvervoerders door de voorgestelde structuurwijziging niet op het spel gezet wordt.
Questions the justification for the conversion, the lack of sector support, and asks for a full written analysis and answers to be given question by question to Parliament.
Can the government send that to the Chamber urgently, so the Chamber can follow its reasoning and weighing?
Kan de regering die alsnog met spoed naar de Kamer sturen, zodat de Kamer haar redenering en afweging kan volgen?
Asks what changes for parliamentary accountability and influence, requests tax rulings and the full fiscal agreements be shared, and asks for advice from the Raad van State and Algemene Rekenkamer.
These members ask the government how accountability to the Chamber and the Chamber's influence changes compared with the current situation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering hoe de verantwoording naar de Kamer en de invloed van de Kamer verandert ten opzichte van de huidige situatie.
Supports direct public steering in principle but asks what concrete gain in parliamentary instruments the conversion brings, and whether the risks to the rail chain outweigh the benefits.

These members ask how the potentially large problems for travellers from conflicts and cooperation problems between the new zbo ProRail and the operators should be weighed against the benefits of more public steering?

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe de potentieel grote problemen voor reizigers door conflicten en problemen bij de samenwerking tussen de nieuwe zbo ProRail en de vervoerders gewogen moeten worden ten opzichte van de voordelen die meer publieke aansturing met zich meebrengt?
Doubts the necessity of the conversion and argues that consumer and stakeholder advisory rights would be reduced to once every four years, asking for these rights to be legally guaranteed.
The SP members note that the advisory rights of consumer organisations would be reduced in the bill compared with the current situation.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de adviesrechten van consumentenorganisaties er in het wetsvoorstel op achteruitgaan ten opzichte van de huidige situatie.
Questions whether the bill solves any problem, asks why the 2020 position against a private-law zbo changed, and notes the absence of a five-yearly evaluation clause.
The PVV members note that the bill contains no evaluation provision.
De leden van de PVV-fractie constateren dat er geen evaluatiebepaling is opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel.

Asks for a clear comparison of the publiekrechtelijk and privaatrechtelijk options and for motivation of necessity and proportionality, citing Raad van State concerns about the dual role of the Minister.
In the present bill the GroenLinks-PvdA members see, together with the Raad van State, a dual role for the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management.
In het thans voorliggende voorstel zien de leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie samen met de RvS dat er een dubbelrol is voor de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat.
Opposes the conversion and argues that existing instruments such as statutes, shareholder meetings and concession terms could give stricter steering without reorganisation.
The VVD members ask why the government believes sharper, clearer and simpler steering of ProRail is not possible with existing instruments.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom de regering van mening is dat een scherpere, verduidelijkte en vereenvoudigde aansturing van ProRail niet mogelijk is met bestaande instrumenten.
Questions the real independence of ProRail given the Minister's retained powers over budget and performance indicators, and asks for safeguards against ministerial interference.
The BBB members ask the government what concrete safeguards exist to prevent the Minister from using her powers to steer ProRail in a way that harms its independence.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering welke concrete waarborgen er zijn om te voorkomen dat de Minister haar bevoegdheden gebruikt om ProRail te sturen.
Asks how overlap and tension between public and private law regimes and between the state's roles as shareholder and concession-giver will be managed, citing the Raad van State.
The Raad van State points, for example, to the tension between the different roles the state holds, as shareholder (private law) and as concession-holder and subsidy provider (public law).
De RvS wijst bijvoorbeeld op de spanning tussen de verschillende rollen die het Rijk heeft, als aandeelhouder (privaatrechtelijk) en als concessiehouder en subsidieverstrekker (publiekrechtelijk).
Misses a convincing analysis of why the private-law zbo form was chosen over other organising options and asks how it fits the coalition programme.
The CDA members miss a convincing analysis of why the private-law form of zbo was chosen.
De leden van de CDA-fractie missen een overtuigende analyse waarom is gekozen voor de privaatrechtelijke vorm van een zbo.
Asks why the government retains the previous plan for a private-law zbo rather than a public-law one, given no acute problem and strong criticism.
These members ask the government why it has chosen to pursue the previous government's existing plan for a private-law zbo rather than a public-law zbo.
Deze ledenvragen de regering waarom zij ervoor heeft gekozen om het bestaande voornemen van de vorige regering, een privaatrechtelijk zbo, door te zetten en niet kiest voor een publiekrechtelijk zbo.
Asks what the bill means for the Chamber's information position and accountability, whether the dual steering role of the Minister worsens, and whether the Minister's responsibility increases.
The NSC members ask what consequences this bill has for the Chamber's information position.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen welke gevolgen dit wetsvoorstel heeft voor de informatiepositie van de Kamer.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised reconsidering the bill transforming ProRail into a public-law zbo, arguing the explanatory memorandum insufficiently justified the costly, risky structural change given ProRail's good performance. The minister's reply defends the change as necessary for clearer steering, accountability and information flows, and states amendments were made, though the reply does not fully abandon the proposal.
concerns: The Afdeling found insufficient analysis of shortcomings in existing steering arrangements and of the added value of the zbo conversion relative to its costs and risks; the minister added historical context and a fuller justification but kept the core decision.

The Afdeling noted that several important elements are left to ministerial regulation, making the added value hard to assess; the reply added clarifications and specifications in the bill and memorandum.
Various technical and redactional amendments were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum to clarify and update provisions.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the third amendment note to the bill on converting ProRail into a public-law body, which now keeps ProRail as a private-law BV designated as a zbo, raising concerns about the motivation for the zbo status, the Minister's dual role as shareholder and regulator, excessive delegation, and the advisory task. The government's nader rapport largely accepts these points, adding justification, separating ministerial approval powers from company competences, moving some matters to rules, but keeping the advisory task and rejecting the call to remove delegation on sector cooperation and detailed governance rules.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the motivation for establishing ProRail as a private-law zbo be explained more fully, which the government addressed by expanding the justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling flagged the Minister's dual role as shareholder and regulator and the risk of tension with the company's independence; the government clarified the split and agreed to working agreements, but argued the arrangement is workable.

The Afdeling advised that key matters such as administrative fines and board incompatibility rules be set in statute and that several delegations be dropped; the government kept most delegations, arguing that detailed governance rules are needed.

The Afdeling advised that the statutory advisory task of ProRail be deleted because policy advice belongs in the ministry; the government kept the task, arguing it is needed for structural cooperation, so this point was not followed.

35459.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations to fund food aid and liquidity support for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom during the COVID-19 crisis. It adds about 51.2 million euros in spending commitments, mainly for loans and guarantees to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and includes retroactive effect from 1 May 2020.
35459.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendment by the COVID-19 impact on the Caribbean countries and their solidarity request under Article 36 of the Statute, advised by the financial supervisory colleges.
q: Under Article 36 of the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the countries invoked solidarity within the Kingdom.
De landen hebben op grond van artikel 36 van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een beroep gedaan op de solidariteit binnen het Koninkrijk.

35468.s: The bill amends the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes to add a proportionality and balancing-of-interests duty for the tax authority when issuing decisions, a general hardship clause allowing the Minister of Finance to issue policy rules for groups of cases, and a hardship allowance scheme for childcare benefit overpayments older than five years. It also creates a framework for a residual exceptional-cases allowance to be set by general administrative order after parliamentary pre-consultation.
35468.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for tailored remedies for hardship caused by childcare benefit enforcement and by the government's commitment to resolving affected parents' situations following court rulings and advisory reports.
q: No objection or appeal is open against a refusal to apply the hardship clause and thus against not adopting a policy rule to address an overriding unfairness.

Tegen een afwijzing van een verzoek tot toepassing van de hardheidsclausule en daarmee tegen het niet vaststellen van een beleidsregel om tegemoet te komen aan een onbillijkheid van overwegende aard staat geen bezwaar en beroep open.
d: policy rules for hardship cases under income-dependent schemes
allowance for hardship in groups of cases under specified provisions
further rules for applying the childcare hardship scheme
exceptional allowance for very distressing childcare benefit cases
p: The Minister of Finance may issue policy rules for unforeseen hardship cases, with consultation of the other responsible ministers but no parliamentary approval and no appeal against refusal.
Exceptional allowances may be set by general administrative order after a four-week voorhang period, with the criteria left largely to the executive.

parties: Asks about legal basis, criteria and objectivity of the commissions and the procedure for the vangnetbepaling, and about how discretion is exercised.
The VVD members ask on the basis of which criteria a judgement is made whether it is manifestly unreasonable for parents to bear the cost.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen op basis van welke criteria een afweging wordt gemaakt of het voor ouders overduidelijk onredelijk is deze voor rekening van de ouders te laten.
Questions whether implementation regulations were tested for feasibility and whether staff involved in the earlier cases are objectively assessing new cases, calling for independent oversight.
Can the government test the whole body of laws and regulations for feasibility before a vote in the House of Representatives?
Kan de regering het geheel van wet- en regelgeving ... toetsen op uitvoerbaarheid voordat er een stemming in de Tweede Kamer plaatsvindt?
Asks how the Commissie van Wijzen assesses institutional bias and how parents are informed of its provisional findings, seeking safeguards for fair individual assessment.
The D66 members ask how parents, if the provisional view is that they are not in a comparable situation to CAF 11, are informed of the reasons underlying such a decision?

Deze leden vragen hoe ouders, als het voorlopige oordeel is dat zij niet in een vergelijkbare situatie als CAF 11, worden geïnformeerd over de redenen die ten grondslag liggen van een dergelijk besluit?
Asks whether citizens have enough insight into their files to judge whether they are comparable cases and suggests the files be made public in anonymised form.
Should those files not simply be made public (anonymised)?
Zouden die dossiers niet gewoon (geanonimiseerd) openbaar moeten zijn?

Criticises the split between CAF and non-CAF compensation, the use of the opzet/grove schuld label without parents being able to defend themselves, rejected applicants without objection rights, and the lack of attention to discretion and the proportionality principle.
The SP members are very disappointed in the compensation and restoration scheme, because it is based on an improper distinction.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn zeer teleurgesteld over de compensatie- en herstelregeling, omdat deze gebaseerd is op een oneigenlijk onderscheid.
Asks whether the AUT requested and was given access to individual files of CAF cases other than CAF 11 when judging comparability.
Did the AUT ask to inspect individual files in CAF cases other than CAF-11, to assess whether other CAF cases were comparable to CAF 11?
Heeft de AUT gevraagd om individuele dossiers in andere CAF-zaken dan CAF-11 in te zien, om te beoordelen of andere CAF-zaken vergelijkbaar waren met CAF 11?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the Wet hardheidsaanpassing Awir, which introduces a hardship scheme and safety-net provision for childcare benefit cases, warning that this may undermine formal legal finality (formele rechtskracht) and create precedent. The government's reply accepts the advice, adds discussion of formal legal finality and precedent to the explanatory memorandum, and adds a transitional article for pre-entry hardship requests.
concerns: The hardship scheme may undermine the formal legal finality of final decisions and set precedent for future hardship cases, so the explanatory memorandum should address this.
Requests for hardship compensation submitted before the scheme's entry into force raised admissibility questions, addressed by a new transitional article II.
Several redactional changes and clarifications were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35477.s: The bill adds a general power for administrative bodies to waive (kwijtschelden) a monetary debt when enforcement consequences are disproportionate to its aims, and lets bodies suspend advance payments while a serious suspicion of grounds for withdrawal exists. It also adds a five-year limit on cost recovery after administrative enforcement, a one-year limitation period for penalty payments with extensions during pending proceedings, and related technical amendments to the General Administrative Law Act.
35477.j: The memorandum justifies the waiver power by citing evaluation findings and advice from the Council of State that people with debts can face disproportionate consequences, and it stresses that the power is meant only for exceptional cases.
q: The newly proposed article 4:94a provides that an administrative body may, unless otherwise provided by statute, waive a monetary debt in whole or in part if the adverse consequences of enforcement are disproportionate to the aims the enforcement serves.

Het nieuw voorgestelde artikel 4:94a bepaalt dat een bestuursorgaan, tenzij bij wettelijk voorschrift anders is bepaald, een geldschuld geheel of gedeeltelijk kan kwijtschelden indien de nadelige gevolgen van de invordering onevenredig zijn in verhouding tot de met de invordering te dienen doelen.
d: waiver of monetary debts by administrative bodies
p: Gives administrative bodies a discretionary power to waive debts where enforcement effects are disproportionate, limited by a proportionality standard and by statutes that may exclude it.
Allows suspension of advance payments for up to thirteen weeks upon a serious suspicion of grounds for withdrawal or amendment, with suspension ending when a decision is published.

parties: Asks whether Raad van State members advising on the bill can later sit on cases interpreting the same provisions, raising impartiality and separation concerns.

Can the government confirm that when interpretation of articles 4:94a, 5:35 and 5:37a Awb arises in a concrete case before the Administrative Jurisdiction Division, state councillors involved in advice on this bill will not take part in those decisions?

Kan de regering bevestigen dat wanneer wetsinterpretatie van de artikelen 4:94a, 5:35 en 5:37a van de Awb aan de orde is in een concrete zaak bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak, staatsraden die betrokkenheid hadden bij de adviezen over dit wetsvoorstel, geen betrokkenheid zullen hebben bij de beslissingen
Asks how the 'serious suspicion' threshold for suspending advance payments is interpreted in case law and how quickly an authority must withdraw or amend a suspended decision.
There must be a serious suspicion, they note, before a decision can be suspended.</evidence_en>
Er moet een ernstig vermoeden bestaan, zo lezen zij, om een beschikking op te kunnen schorten.
Supports conservatory measures but worries suspension of advance payments could harm families and asks what safeguards prevent drastic disruption of recipients' lives.
However, they ask whether a temporary suspension of advance payments could have negative consequences for people and their social lives, including families with growing children.
Echter, zij vragen of een tijdelijke opschorting van bevoorschotting geen negatieve gevolgen kan hebben voor mensen en hun sociale leven, waaronder gezinnen met opgroeiende kinderen.

Warns of parallels with the childcare benefits affair, asks whether recipients will be informed of suspicions, given access to their file, and whether they get statutory interest if payments are later found lawful.
The members cannot overlook the parallels with the childcare benefits affair, since that affair also caused much suffering because of suspicions.
De aan het woord zijnde leden kunnen de paralellen met de toeslagenaffaire niet over het hoofd zien, daar werd immers ook veel leed veroorzaakt vanwege vermoedens.

Worries suspension could repeat past errors; asks whether it is limited to individual suspicions, whether decisions are reasoned with a right to object, and whether citizens get a chance to remedy administrative shortcomings first.
May suspension only take place when it concerns a suspicion of irregularities in an individual file?
Mag opschorting enkel plaatsvinden wanneer het een vermoeden van onregelmatigheden op een individueel dossier betreft?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the General Administrative Law Act following evaluation of the rules on administrative monetary debts, recommending a general remission regime and extension of the limitation period when an enforcement decision is suspended at the offender's request, plus clarification on interruption of limitation. The Minister's nader rapport adopts the remission provision (new art. 4:94a Awb), adds the suspension-based extension, and clarifies the limitation rules, with redactional changes.
concerns: The Afdeling advised extending the limitation period when the enforcement decision is suspended by the administrative judge at the offender's request, to avoid limitation running before the main case is decided; the government added this provision.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of whether a notice by the authority claiming the penalty interrupts limitation; the government did not interrupt limitation by such notice for legal certainty reasons but added a provision extending the period during appeal proceedings.
The Afdeling advised a general remission regime for administrative monetary debts, which the government added as new article 4:94a Awb.
The Afdeling made redactional comments on terminology and references in article 5:37, which were adopted.

35549.s: The bill extends the validity of articles 33 and 34 of the Temporary COVID-19 Justice and Security Act, which would otherwise lapse on 1 September 2023. It amends article 35 so that those provisions expire at the start of the third calendar month after a future amending act takes effect, with a royal decree allowing the date to be set up to two months later.
35549.j: The memorandum justifies the continued powers by the need to keep the clarity on the chairman's authority and the ability to prosecute infection-related offences after 1 September 2020, without addressing the 2023 extension.
q: These articles share that under article 35, sixth paragraph, under b and c, of the Temporary Act they lapse on 1 September 2020, unless before that date a bill has been submitted to the House of Representatives regulating their subject.

Deze artikelen hebben gemeen dat zij ingevolge artikel 35, zesde lid, onder b respectievelijk onder c, van de Tijdelijke wet op 1 september 2020 vervallen, tenzij voor deze datum een wetsvoorstel bij de Tweede Kamer is ingediend.
d: Artikel I (artikel 35, zesde lid, onder b)
setting the lapse date of articles 33 and 34 by royal decree
p: Artikel I (artikel 35, zesde lid, onder b)
Allows a royal decree to postpone the lapse date of the emergency provisions by up to two months without further parliamentary action.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending the duration of provisions in articles 33 and 34 of the Temporary COVID-19 Justice and Security Act, and raised no remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) merely forwards the bill to the Tweede Kamer, with no further points to answer.

35567.s: This is an incidental supplementary budget amendment to the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding COVID-19 measure expenditure and revenue to the departmental budget statement. The explanatory memorandum also records state guarantees for COVID-19 measures, including extensions of their duration and the Ministry's role in administering a risk scheme.
35567.j: The memorandum justifies the extensions and the intertemporal shift of expenditure by the ongoing uncertainty about medicine availability in a possible second COVID-19 wave.
q: The scheme is extended until 31 July 2021. This was decided in view of the continuing uncertainty about the availability of certain medicines in the event of a second wave.
De regeling wordt verlengd tot en met 31 juli 2021. Hiertoe is besloten gezien de aanhoudende onzekerheid over de beschikbaarheid van bepaalde geneesmiddelen in het geval van een tweede golf.

35576.s: The bill introduces a reduced 2% transfer tax rate and a one-time starter exemption for buyers under 35 who declare they will use the home as their main residence, while adding anti-abuse rules for resale within six months. It also sets a sunset date of 1 January 2026 for the starter exemption, subject to evaluation.
35576.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation on the content of the declaration as a technical implementation matter needed to administer the exemption.
q: By ministerial regulation, further rules will be set regarding the content and manner of submitting the written declaration.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot de inhoud en wijze van aanleveren van de schriftelijke verklaring.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 15a, derde lid, WBR)
content and submission of the written declaration
p: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 15a, tweede lid, WBR)

A buyer who cannot show an unforeseen circumstance is deemed to have used the home as main residence only if the written declaration is accepted, shifting proof burdens onto taxpayers, while appeal remains open.

parties: Asks how the one-time exemption can be checked by the tax authority and how effects on the housing market will be monitored.
The VVD members stress that the starter exemption can only be used once.
De leden van de VVD-fractie benadrukken dat de vrijstelling voor starters maar eenmalig te gebruiken is.
Asks for research on price-raising and price-lowering effects of the measure.
Has the government investigated what the possible price-increasing effect consists of and its size?
Heeft de regering onderzocht waaruit het mogelijke prijsopdrijvende effect bestaat en wat de omvang daarvan is?
Questions the legal justification for the age distinction and the enforceability of the hoofdverblijf criterion, which is hard for the tax authority to verify.
Such a distinction between buyers and the infringement of equal treatment requires a very strong justification.
Een dergelijk onderscheid tussen kopers en aantasting van de rechtsgelijkheid noopt tot een zeer sterke rechtvaardiging.
Asks about expected housing market developments and whether thresholds or alternative age limits were considered.
The D66 members ask what the expected developments on the housing market are regarding price trends and supply and demand for 2021 and 2022.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen wat de verwachte ontwikkelingen zijn op de woningmarkt wat betreft de prijsontwikkeling en de vraag- en aanbodzijde voor jaren 2021 en 2022.
Doubts the measure's effectiveness and fears it will push prices up as starters bid higher.
These members, however, have doubts about the effectiveness of the bill as it now stands.
Deze leden hebben echter twijfels bij de effectiviteit van het wetsvoorstel zoals dat nu voorligt.
Argues the age criterion is ineffective and discriminatory, and that landlords can exploit the exemption under false pretences with weak enforcement.
They note that because the tax authority, the Kadaster and other implementing bodies cannot properly identify landlords, a draconian instrument is being used.
Zij constateren dat, omdat de Belastingdienst, het Kadaster en andere uitvoeringsorganisaties niet in staat zijn om huisjesmelkers goed te identificeren, een draconisch middel wordt ingezet.
Supports the aim but asks why the bill does not follow earlier amendments and whether housing corporations can be exempted.
The PvdA members ask why the bill did not follow the Nijboer amendments.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom niet is aangesloten bij de amendementen-Nijboer.
Welcomes the measure but raises concerns about effects on housing corporations and on prices.
The ChristenUnie members have questions about the effects of this bill on starters over 35, housing corporations and the housing market as a whole.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben een aantal vragen over de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel voor starters boven de 35 jaar, woningcorporaties en de verhoudingen op de koopwoningmarkt als geheel.
Asks about expected price effects and alignment with the gift exemption age limit.
Argues the differentiation is perverse because genuine starters over 35 are excluded and wealthy buyers can benefit.
Because genuine starters aged 36 or older also cannot benefit from the exemption, the members conclude that the proposed differentiation is perverse.

Omdat tevens échte koopstarters van 36 of ouder niet kunnen profiteren van de vrijstelling, concluderen de leden dan ook dat de differentiatie van de overdrachtsbelasting zoals voorgesteld pervers is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet differentiatie overdrachtsbelasting, which raises the general transfer tax rate to 8% and restricts the 2% rate to owner-occupiers, with a five-year starter exemption; it raised concerns about effectiveness, enforceability, and evaluation and advised against submission unless amended. The government's reply addresses each point, adding justification, enforcement timelines, and an evaluation section, but did not adopt the advice to reconsider the measure's effectiveness.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the effectiveness and efficiency of the starter exemption, including lack of a cap and overkill, and advised reconsidering; the government justified the measure but did not reconsider it.
The Afdeling flagged fraud sensitivity of the hoofdverblijf declaration and lack of enforcement until 2023; the government added BSN data requirements and explained the phased enforcement plan.

The Afdeling advised an evaluation clause with clear scope, methods and an earlier evaluation after two or three years; the government added an evaluation paragraph and moved the evaluation start to autumn 2024.
The Afdeling raised negative spillover effects on the owner-occupied and rental markets and regional differences; the government added explanation of price effects but limited further analysis.

35585.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (third incidental supplementary budget on COVID-19 measures), adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros with effect from 28 September 2020. The accompanying memorandum describes government guarantees for COVID-19 testing capacity and test materials, with time horizons of six months to 30 April 2021.
35585.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantees as necessary to secure sufficient laboratory testing capacity as part of the government's COVID-19 control strategy, with the framework sent to parliament after cabinet decision.
q: The Minister of VWS guarantees the costs incurred from the agreed amounts linked to the agreed minimum purchase of PCR tests.
De Minister van VWS staat hiermee garant voor de gemaakte kosten die voortkomen uit de overeengekomen bedragen gekoppeld aan de afgesproken minimum afname van het aantal PCR tests.

35594.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 to require small consumers to have a meter able to measure electricity fed in and taken off the grid separately, enabling the phase-out of net metering (salderingsregeling). It also lets the Minister impose penalties and obtain personal data from grid operators and suppliers for enforcement, and allows general administrative orders to set the minimum level of the compensation for feed-in.
35594.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of the compensation floor to lower regulation as an implementation detail offering flexibility to respond to developments, and the enforcement powers as necessary to secure compliance.
q: For enforcement purposes, the supervisor gains access under this bill to the names and addresses of small consumers who lack the correct meter.
Ten behoeve van de handhaving krijgt de toezichthouder met dit wetsvoorstel toegang tot naam en adresgegevens van kleinverbruikers die niet over de juiste meetinrichting beschikken
d: ARTIKEL I, E (artikel 31c, vierde lid Elektriciteitswet 1998)
rules on level or calculation of reasonable compensation for feed-in
ARTIKEL I, A (artikel 5, zevende lid Elektriciteitswet 1998)
Minister designates officials to supervise compliance
ARTIKEL I, D (artikel 26ae, zesde lid, referenced in memorandum)
fee for installing meter at a non-planned time
p: ARTIKEL I, G (artikel 78, vijfde lid Elektriciteitswet 1998)
Minister may require suppliers to disclose personal data of small consumers lacking a compliant meter, enabling enforcement against individuals.
ARTIKEL I, F (artikel 77h, tweede lid Elektriciteitswet 1998)
Minister may impose an order subject to a penalty payment on small consumers who breach the meter obligation.
Sets a statutory basis for lower-level rules fixing a floor on compensation for feed-in, without fixing the level in the statute itself.

parties: Asks whether the phase-out could push payback beyond nine years and how the minimum compensation is monitored and set.
These members further ask what can be done if at some point during the phase-out the payback period turns out to be longer than nine years.
Deze leden vragen voorts wat er gedaan kan worden als blijkt dat op een bepaald moment in de afbouw de terugverdientijd langer dan negen jaar zal zijn.
Asks how the phase-out will be evaluated, why no evaluation clause is included, and whether the Raad van State's advice on the housing sector was adequately answered.
Supports the move towards prosumers but asks about unresolved risks, the Raad van State's critique on the housing sector and uncertainty in TNO's payback estimates.
The Council of State advisory division advised conducting research into the effects of the phase-out on the rental sector.
De Afdeling Advisering heeft geadviseerd om een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de gevolgen van de afbouw van de salderingsregeling voor de huursector.
Asks for a fuller government response to the SEO second opinion and to municipal concerns about falling interest in solar panels.
Can the government give a comprehensive response to this second opinion study?
Kan de regering een uitgebreide reactie geven op dit second opinion onderzoek?
Views the phase-out as a disguised budget cut with unrealistic assumptions, criticises the exclusion of the social rental sector, and questions the mandatory smart meter and privacy risks.
The Council of State advisory division also criticises the deficient justification.
Ook de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State uit kritiek op de gebrekkige onderbouwing.

Questions reconciling the phase-out with a reliable government, asks about effects on lower-income groups and the lack of an interim evaluation, and asks for research on the rental sector as advised by the Raad van State.
Does the government agree that an interim evaluation before the regular five-year period is important, given the considerable uncertainty of the bill's effects?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat een tussentijdens evaluatie vóór de reguliere termijn van vijf jaar van belang is, gezien de grote onderheid van de effecten van het wetsvoorstel?
Values citizen investment in solar panels and asks for a firmer evidence base on the assumed reasonable compensation and future rentability, and how storage and smart grids will be stimulated.
In short, the ChristenUnie members expect a solid justification for this crucial premise of the bill.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie rekenen kortom op een stevige onderbouwing van deze cruciale notie onder dit wetsvoorstel.
Argues the phase-out is premature given climate targets and wants it postponed to 2030 and linked to phasing out all fossil fuel tax measures.
Therefore these members believe a phase-out path for net metering should only be introduced if the start date is postponed to 2030.
Daarom vinden deze leden dat een afbouwpad voor salderen alleen in het leven geroepen mag worden als de begindatum wordt uitgesteld naar 2030.
Asks for a full response to the SEO second opinion and the Fakton report on housing corporations, and how lower-income households' payback risk is assessed.
These members would welcome a comprehensive response to the SEO second opinion study.
Deze leden ontvangen graag een uitgebreide reactie op het secondopiniononderzoek van SEO.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in June 2020 that the bill phasing out net metering (salderingsregeling) for small consumers should address uncertainties in the TNO payback-time research and examine effects on the rental sector before submission. The minister's reply of October 2020 added TNO monitoring recommendations and a KWINK study on rental housing, concluding corporations will keep investing in solar panels.
concerns: The Afdeling advised addressing uncertainties in the payback-time research (possible 2 to 4 year effects by 2030) and the need for monitoring; the minister added monitoring via the KEV and a five-yearly evaluation but argued the payback time is only a tool.

The Afdeling advised investigating the effects of the phase-out on the rental sector, where the TNO research did not apply; the minister commissioned a KWINK study and added clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
Amendments were made on the netbeheerder's access to customer names and on the entry-into-force provision, following the Afdeling's and other points.

35648.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistratie personen (BRP) and the Wet basisadministraties persoonsgegevens BES to improve implementation, including mandatory ex officio briefadres registration, a new deadline for registering stillborn or deceased children, expanded data sharing with Caribbean authorities, and a new experiment article allowing temporary deviation from the statute by general administrative order for up to four years. The bill also changes deadlines and procedures for citizens' access requests and departure notification.
35648.j: The memorandum justifies the experiment power by the need to pilot BRP developments that current detailed rules prevent, and points to the Grondwet requirement for a formal statutory basis and the safeguards of time limit, parliamentary consultation and evaluation.
q: The experiment article contains the necessary safeguards for this purpose.
Het experimenteerartikel bevat daartoe de nodige waarborgen.
d: experiments deviating temporarily from BRP provisions
data disclosure to authorities in Caribbean Netherlands and Aruba/Curaçao/Sint Maarten
cases where access request may be refused on security grounds
special cases exempting minors from in-person departure notification
further rules on death notifications from civil registry
p: Allows the minister, by general administrative order, to temporarily set aside BRP statutory provisions for up to four years for experiments, subject to a four-week parliamentary submission period, equivalent safeguards for data subjects' rights, and an evaluation report to parliament.
Creates a statutory basis for the executive to regulate disclosure of BRP data to authorities in Caribbean Netherlands and other Kingdom countries, with details left to regulation.
Lets the municipality refuse citizens access to records of disclosures where needed for state security or crime prevention, with conditions to be specified by regulation.

parties: Asks how fraud and involuntary departures will be prevented when in-person registration duties are relaxed, and why digital data and experiments are not included in the bill.
How is fraud prevented in this context? How is it prevented that signals of involuntary departure are missed?
Hoe wordt fraude in dezen voorkomen? Hoe wordt voorkomen dat signalen over niet-vrijwillig vertrek worden gemist?

Supports mandatory registration of homeless persons and stillborn children, but questions the desirability of experiments with real personal data, the risk of legal inequality between municipalities, and the status of a central complaints point.
Why would pilots and experiments need to be conducted with real personal data?
Waarom zouden pilots en experimenten moeten worden gehouden met reële persoonsgegevens?

Asks whether the experimentation provisions are really experiments or situations of flexible norm-setting, and whether individuals should be able to have their origin data erased from the BRP on their own initiative.
Said members ask whether the examples the government provides are specifically meant as an experiment or as situations where the government needs flexible norm-setting
Genoemde leden vragen of de voorbeelden die de regering aandraagt, ook specifiek bedoeld zijn als experiment of als situaties waarin de regering behoefte heeft aan flexibele normstelling

Supports giving parents more room in registering stillborn children, but asks about the risk of enforcement against people using a mailing address in illegal occupation and about the reliability of records when gender entries can be deleted.
These members ask why it would be wise to be able to delete all historical data regarding gender entries based on paragraphs three and four.
Deze leden vragen waarom het verstandig zou zijn dat op basis van de leden drie en vier alle historische gegevens inzake de geslachtsvermelding te kunnen verwijderen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet BRP and Wet bap BES, criticising the broad experimental clause (artikel 4.16a) as too vague and lacking safeguards, and finding the justification for transfers of data to Caribbean Dutch public bodies and other Kingdom countries inadequate under the GDPR. The government's nader rapport largely accepted these points by narrowing the experimental clause with a closed list of purposes, a four-year limit, evaluation criteria, equivalent safeguards, and additional justification for data transfers.
concerns: The experimental clause was too broad and lacked a precise statutory purpose, which the government addressed by adding a closed list of purposes, a four-year maximum duration, and clearer evaluation rules.
Experiments deviating from privacy safeguards require a specific statutory basis and equivalent alternatives protecting data subjects' rights, which the government incorporated into artikel 4.16a.

Transfers of personal data to Caribbean Dutch authorities lack adequacy under the GDPR, so the government had to justify appropriate safeguards, which it provided in the explanatory memorandum without a full adequacy basis.

Excessive reliance on delegation to general administrative orders for experiments was constrained by listing the Wet BRP provisions that may be deviated from and requiring the order to set out evaluation criteria.

35657.s: The bill amends the Dutch party financing act (Wfpp) to tighten transparency of party funding, ban donations from outside the EU/EEA, and require disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners and EU donor data. It also raises party subsidy amounts, extends the advisory committee's remit, and requires a periodic evaluation report to parliament.
35657.j: The memorandum justifies the measures by the aim of greater financial transparency and preventing foreign influence on Dutch democratic decision-making, and it weighs the rights limitations against EVRM and GDPR requirements.
q: to prevent foreign influence on political decision-making and the democratic process in the Netherlands
om buitenlandse beïnvloeding van de politieke besluitvorming en het democratische proces in Nederland tegen te gaan
d: Artikel I, onderdeel H (Artikel 13) and I (Artikel 14)
adjustment of subsidy amounts over quarters
p: Parties must refuse and transfer non-EU donations to a ministerial account, extending state control over party funding while limiting donor rights.
Artikel I, onderdeel O and P (Artikel 25, 28)

parties: Asks whether the foreign-donation ban can be circumvented via Dutch nationals abroad and whether decentralised parties are covered, questioning effectiveness.
It cannot be ruled out that through these exceptions donations from outside the EU/EEA still reach political parties and their affiliated institutions.
Niet is uitgesloten dat via deze uitzonderingen toch giften van buiten de EU/EER terechtkomen bij de politieke partijen en de neveninstellingen.
Supports tighter transparency on intermediaries and beneficial owners and the foreign-donation ban, asking how enforcement and the definition apply.
These members ask how this ban relates to the definition of 'ultimate beneficial owner'.
Deze leden vragen, hoe dit verbod zich verhoudt tot de definitie van «uiteindelijk belanghebbende».
Doubts the need for moving subsidies to Foreign Affairs, fearing instrumentalisation of parties, and wants independent oversight of party financing via the supervisory body.
These members are not yet convinced of the necessity or added value of this proposal.
Deze leden zijn vooralsnog niet overtuigd van de noodzaak of meerwaarde van dit voorstel.
Asks whether donations via foundations and indirect in-kind support such as advertising remain untransparent.
Is the picture correct that, even after the amendment, political parties can receive money via legal entities without it being known who finances those entities?

Klopt het beeld van de aan het woord zijnde leden dat, ook als de wet is gewijzigd, politieke partijen via rechtspersonen geld kunnen ontvangen zonder dat bekend is wie de financiers van die rechtspersonen zijn?
Objects to unwanted foreign interference and asks why EU-member donations are not banned and how financing constructions via EU states are prevented.
The members also ask how it is prevented that a financing structure from unfree countries is set up by donating money to a Dutch political party via an EU member state.

Daarnaast vragen de genoemde leden hoe voorkomen wordt dat er een constructie voor financiering uit onvrije landen kan worden opgezet door via een EU-lidstaat alsnog geld aan een Nederlandse politieke partij te schenken.
Questions whether exempting Dutch voters abroad from the ban creates a risk of foreign financing and whether transparency measures will reduce evasion.
Asks why local parties are excluded from the Wfpp, whether local branches can circumvent donation rules, and why a full ban rather than one limited to unfree countries.
Is it correct that the law has a gap in this respect?
Klopt het dat de wet hierin een lacune heeft?
Worries that moving foreign-activity subsidies to Foreign Affairs, with its geographic limits, will endanger established democratic networks and increase ministerial steering of party foundations.
It appears the government intends, with this amendment, to exert further steering over the activities of foreign foundations.
Het lijkt erop of de regering voornemens is met deze wetswijziging verdergaande sturing te geven aan de activiteiten van buitenlandstichtingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Evaluatiewet Wfpp, a bill amending the Dutch political party financing law, including a ban on donations from outside the EU/EEA, expanded transparency, and subsidy changes; it raised concerns about necessity, justification of the non-EU/EEA ban under free movement of capital, data protection proportionality, property rights, and splits from parliamentary groups, recommending revision. The minister's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adding justification, retention limits, and a transparency rule for individual splits, while defending the EU/EEA distinction and keeping the subsidy rule with extra explanation.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of the necessity of banning donations from outside the EU/EEA, and of the distinction with EU/EEA donors, given the small number of substantial foreign donations.

The Afdeling found the distinction between EU/EEA and third-country donors and the transparency rules insufficiently justified under the free movement of capital (Art. 63 TFEU) and the grounds invoked (Art. 65 TFEU).
The Afdeling asked for justification of the proportionality of expanded disclosure of donor personal data and of the absence of a retention period, and adjustments where needed.

The Afdeling noted the infringement of privacy and data protection through disclosure of donor and beneficial-owner data and asked for effective safeguards, which the government addressed by limiting disclosed address data and setting a ten-year retention period.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the restriction on the property right under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and Article 17 of the EU Charter arising from transferring prohibited foreign donations to the State.

The Afdeling warned that the ban is hard to enforce, citing circumvention via intermediaries and local branches, and suggested a donation cap and rules for local branches; the government explained these would go in a future Wet op de politieke partijen.

The Afdeling asked the government to explain why the subsidy rule on defections from parliamentary groups is included now, given the complexity of the matter and the prohibition of binding mandate; the government added explanation in the text.

35684.s: This second incidental supplementary budget amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to add roughly 934 million euros in expenditure, mainly for COVID-19 measures such as health care and an EUR 80 million subsidy scheme to create about 5,000 temporary support jobs in care. The bill itself only approves the revised budget statement and sets its effective date, with the detailed allocations set out in the attached budget tables.
q: Through a subsidy scheme the cabinet makes EUR 80 million available to enable care employers to create about 5,000 full-time equivalent extra temporary jobs in support roles, on top of existing initiatives.

Via een subsidieregeling stelt het kabinet € 80 miljoen beschikbaar om werkgevers in de zorg in staat te stellen om bovenop de bestaande initiatieven ongeveer 5.000 voltijds fte aan extra tijdelijke banen in ondersteunende functies te creëren.

35693.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet voorraadvorming aardolieproducten 2012 to implement EU implementing directive 2018/1581 on how oil stock obligations are calculated, by replacing references to annex C point 3.1 and annex B point 4.1 with chapter 3.4 of annex A and changing the stock year start from 1 April to 1 July. It makes the change retroactive to 1 July 2020 for the stock year definition.
35693.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as necessary implementation of the EU directive and states it has no effect on enforcement, execution or supervision.
q: The implementing directive has no effect on enforcement, execution and supervision.
Van de uitvoeringsrichtlijn gaat geen effect uit op handhaving, uitvoering en toezicht.

parties: The VVD has no remarks or questions on the bill.
It gives them no reason to make remarks or ask further questions.
Het geeft hen geen aanleiding voor het maken van opmerkingen of stellen van nadere vragen.
The CDA has no questions at this stage.
They have no questions about this at this moment.
Zij hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
The PvdD questions the climate and financial rationale of keeping oil stocks, asks for quantities and costs, and asks the government to amend the bill to allow sustainable storage options.
These members point out that keeping a stock of crude oil means oil is pumped up and stored, while it could and should stay in the ground to solve the climate crisis.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat het behouden van een voorraad aardolie inhoudt dat aardolie opgepompt en opgeslagen wordt, terwijl deze in de grond kan en moet blijven om de klimaatcrisis op te lossen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet voorraadvorming aardolieproducten 2012 to implement Directive 2018/1581/EU, and raised no remarks. The advice is to submit the bill to the Tweede Kamer, and the text contains no separate government reply (nader rapport) to address any points.

35747.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding a fourth supplementary budget of EUR 388.8 million for the temporary fixed-cost allowance (Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten). It takes effect on 2 March 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35756.s: The bill amends the Wet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden to add a definition of professional user that includes biocides, to make biocide tariff rules optional, to adjust article 37 on trial exemptions, and to make biocide use rules optional rather than mandatory. It also creates a statutory basis allowing the minister to ban or restrict non-professional (private) use of plant protection products in floodplains and beyond, excluding professional agricultural use.
35756.j: The memorandum justifies the new basis by the Tweede Kamer's wish to introduce a ban on non-professional use and the Raad van State's earlier finding that no legal basis existed, so the basis is created for a later measure.
q: By amending article 80a this basis is nevertheless created, so that a ban or another measure can be imposed at a later time.
Door aanpassing van artikel 80a wordt deze grondslag alsnog gecreëerd, om op een later tijdstip een verbod of een andere maatregel te kunnen stellen.
d: restrictions or bans on plant protection product use in floodplains and outside them for non-professional users
p: Creates a statutory basis allowing the executive to ban or restrict private use of plant protection products outside floodplains, with no parliamentary approval required for the resulting measures.

parties: Asks how the government respects the Ctgb's independent authorisation role and whether existing instruments are insufficient, and worries a blanket ban could endanger development of biological products.
These members ask how the government views the role of the Ctgb in the context of the present bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de regering de rol van het Ctgb beziet in de context van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes the statutory basis and asks about timing, which substances are covered, monitoring of water quality effects, and enforcement by NVWA and ILT.
These members are pleased that this amendment creates a statutory basis for restrictive measures on private use.
Deze leden zijn verheugd dat met deze wijziging een wettelijke grondslag wordt gecreëerd voor beperkende maatregelen voor particulier gebruik.
Questions the necessity of a new basis given Ctgb authorisation, the scope including biological and low-risk products, and consistency with the Van den Anker/Ziengs motion.
Wants stronger action against pesticide use, including an immediate ban on private use and a campaign, and asks why the private-use ban was not included directly.
Why has the government not included the ban for private individuals directly in this amendment?
Waarom heeft de regering het verbod voor particulieren niet direct in deze wetswijziging meegenomen?
Argues that a ban should follow from this amendment rather than remain uncertain, and asks about professional requirements and the vague definition of professional use.
The GroenLinks members therefore continue to believe that a ban should follow from this amendment.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie blijven dan ook van mening dat een verbod zou moeten volgen uit deze wetswijziging.
Asks why a ban is uncertain given earlier motions, why agricultural use is not restricted, and whether veterinary pesticides can also be banned.
Supports the ban on private use and asks about discount-store sales, household substitutes like vinegar, and labelling.

Argues a generic ban on professional non-agricultural use does not respect the Ctgb's authorisation judgement and that exceptional situations are not present; asks about biological products and availability for pest control.
Supports tackling non-agricultural use but prioritises enforcement and information over bans, and questions how the bill relates to the Ctgb's authorisation of products.
The Ctgb after all determines the admissibility of pesticides to the market.
Het Ctgb bepaalt immers de toelaatbaarheid tot de markt van bestrijdingsmiddelen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wgb to allow rules on pesticide use, including by private individuals, and raised a point about the EU overwriting prohibition regarding advertising rules in article 72. The government's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the private-use rationale and the overlapping article 72 provision was removed, following the advice.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not show whether and when a private-use ban or other measure would be necessary; the government supplemented the memorandum with the rationale from the final evaluation and the Kamerbrief.
The proposed article 72 duplicates article 66 of Regulation 1107/2009, breaching the EU overwriting prohibition; the government removed that part of the bill.

35765.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act so that institutions with a capacity limit may select applicants on qualitative criteria, pure lottery, or a combination of both, instead of only qualitative selection. It also updates a cross-reference in the Experiment Act and sets out a transitional rule depending on the timing of a related bill on language and accessibility.
35765.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to a ministerial regulation by saying the weighted lottery method and organisation of lotteries can be further detailed there, and that the Inspectorate will supervise the selection procedure.
q: The manner in which the weighted lottery is to be carried out may be further elaborated by ministerial regulation.
De wijze waarop de gewogen loting uitgevoerd dient te worden kan bij ministeriële regeling nader worden uitgewerkt.
d: rules on conducting lottery and weighted lottery procedures

parties: Questions whether the government's evidence base, including the ResearchNed study, justifies changing the law and whether the inspectorate's selection-methods research should have been awaited.

What is the motivation for reintroducing lottery if, according to the explanatory memorandum, scientific research shows that selection at Maastricht University has good predictive value and at the same time guarantees equal opportunity, because one cannot prepare for it?

Wat is de motivatie voor het terugbrengen van loting als het blijkens de memorie van toelichting bij de regering bekend is dat uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek blijkt dat selectie aan de Universiteit van Maastricht een goede voorspellende waarde heeft en tegelijk kansengelijkheid waarborgt, omdat je je er niet op kan voorbereiden?

Asks how the government addresses the Council of State's recommendations to improve selection effectiveness, require justification of criteria publicly, and cap the number of criteria, and how it handles the combination of selection and lottery.

The D66 members note that the Council of State advises improving the effectiveness of selection procedures and having institutions publicly account for their selection criteria and the instruments they achieve.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State adviseert om de effectiviteit van selectieprocedures te verbeteren en om instellingen zich in het openbaar te laten verantwoorden over de selectiecriteria en de daarmee behaalde instrumenten.
Supports the bill in principle as implementing the motion but questions whether combining selection and lottery is excluded by the explanatory memorandum and asks for evaluation of the methods.
Can the government explain why this risk leads to rejecting the combination of selection and lottery, while at the same time maintaining decentralised selection as such?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom dit risico leidt tot het afwijzen van de combinatie van selectie en loting, maar tegelijkertijd tot het handhaven van decentrale selectie an sich?

Prefers lottery as the fairest method and asks whether the government will permit only lottery until alternatives are shown not to create inequality, and how medezeggenschap and visitatiecommissies will check selection justification.
As far as the members are concerned, decentralised lottery is fairer than other selection methods.
