Wat de leden betreft is decentrale loting meer rechtvaardig dan andere selectiemethodes.

Sees value in conditional lottery because decentralised selection on motivation letters and tests has reduced diversity and access for certain groups, and asks about the consequences of fully unweighted lottery for matching.

The members find that lottery under conditions can have added value, precisely because decentralised selection based on recommendation letters, motivation letters, CVs and the like has been shown to make the student population of capacity-limited programmes less diverse than that of other programmes.

De leden vinden dat loting onder voorwaarden een toegevoegde waarde kan hebben, juist omdat decentrale selectie op basis van aanbevelingsbrieven, motivatiebrieven, curricula vitae en dergelijke, ertoe blijkt te hebben geleid dat de studentenpopulatie van opleidingen met een capaciteitsfixus minder divers is dan van andere opleidingen.

Questions whether the bill truly improves access and diversity, prefers selection done well over lottery, and asks whether other options such as normed criteria were considered, citing the Council of State.
Does the government agree with these members that selection, if well implemented, is preferable to lottery?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat selectie, mits goed uitgevoerd, de voorkeur geniet boven loting?
Asks whether diversity goals may override quality, whether unweighted lottery is only permitted where it serves quality, and why the conditional nature of lottery is not stated more clearly.
These members note that unweighted lottery is included as an option in the proposal without conditions.
Deze leden constateren dat de ongewogen loting ongeclausuleerd als optie is opgenomen in het voorstel.

Welcomes lottery for fairness and equal chances, but doubts objective application of criteria, asks who supervises use of evidence-based methods, and criticises institutions' discretion and non-binding student council advice.
The BIJ1 member does not believe in the objective application of selection based on qualitative criteria.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie gelooft niet in de objectieve toepassing van de selectie gebaseerd op de kwalitatieve criteria.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against adopting unweighted lottery as a standalone selection tool in higher education, arguing it conflicts with the principle of the right student in the right place and that the case for kansengelijkheid is not evidenced. The Minister's reply largely rejects these objections, keeps the proposal, and adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum and some text changes.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the evidence shows kansenongelijkheid caused by decentralised selection and that lottery would improve equal opportunity; the government accepts uncertainty but judges the signals serious enough to proceed.

The Afdeling advises against allowing unweighted lottery as a standalone selection method because it departs from the principle of the right student in the right place; the government rejects this and keeps unweighted lottery.
The explanatory memorandum says weighted lottery requires at least two qualitative criteria, which the statutory text does not state; the text and explanation were aligned.

The combination of selection and lottery is unclear on whether candidates may be rejected before the draw; the government clarified that no pre-lottery rejection is allowed and the memorandum was amended.
The argument about tailored policy (maatwerk) needed further explanation; the government clarified the wording and expanded the memorandum without changing the underlying rationale.
Redactional comments on the number of selection procedures and the nature of unweighted lottery were incorporated into the explanatory memorandum.

35783.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/2034 and Regulation 2019/2033 on prudential rules for investment firms into the Dutch Wft, redefining investment firm categories, moving systemically significant firms under the bank-style capital regime, and reassigning supervisory roles between DNB and AFM. It adds DNB discretionary powers to apply the CRR to large investment firms, measures to impose capital and liquidity requirements, and consolidated supervision provisions.
35783.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need for a proportionate, risk-sensitive regime and harmonised application across member states, and the AFM is given an advisory role on the new DNB powers.
q: The regime is moreover too heavy and complex for investment firms and entails high implementation costs.
Het regime is voor beleggingsondernemingen bovendien te zwaar en complex en brengt hoge uitvoeringskosten met zich.
d: DNB discretion to apply CRR requirements to large investment firms
DNB may set additional reporting and evaluation rules for investment firms
DNB may impose prudential measures on investment firms
DNB sets own funds level and guidance for investment firms
definitions adjusted under general administrative order
p: DNB may decide to subject investment firms to the bank-style CRR regime based on asset size and criteria in the directive.
DNB obtains broad power to impose a list of prudential measures on investment firms, including restrictions on dividends and business activities.

parties: Asks how DNB's discretionary power to place firms under the capital requirements regime will be exercised and safeguarded against disproportionate use, and about administrative sanctions and harmonisation.
How is it guaranteed that this power is not used disproportionately?
Hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat deze bevoegdheid niet disproportioneel wordt ingezet.
Welcomes the framework but asks for justification of DNB's exclusive power to set up colleges of supervisors, the AFM/DNB task division, and the criteria for publishing sanctions.
Can the government explain why only DNB has been given the option to set up a college of supervisors?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom ervoor gekozen is om enkel DNB de mogelijkheid te geven om een college voor toezichthouders op te richten?

Asks how DNB will decide whether a firm is brought under the capital requirements regime and on what conditions, and questions whether the Netherlands correctly applied the remuneration member-state option.
The PVV members want to know whether it is correct that the member-state option is thereby applied incorrectly.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten of het klopt dat hiermee de lidstaatoptie onjuist wordt toegepast.

Questions the basis for extending the framework to fund managers against the Council of State's advice, and asks how implementation via general administrative measures will remain workable and subject to political control.
The CDA members see that the implementation of this law will move further away from political control.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zien daarmee dat de invulling van de uitvoering van deze wet verder van de politieke controle af komt te staan.
Wants rules for investment firms not to be much more favourable than for banks and pension funds to avoid supervisory arbitrage, and asks about categorisation thresholds and systemic relevance.
Care must be taken that the rules for investment firms are not much more favourable than for banks and pension funds.
Er moet voor worden gewaakt dat de regels voor beleggingsondernemingen niet veel gunstiger zijn dan voor bijvoorbeeld banken en pensioenfondsen.
Questions why the market cannot control these risks, whether Basel III suffices, and why such firms need a specific framework and legal certainty when risk-taking is their core activity.
The SP members ask the government why the market cannot itself control these risks.
De leden vragen de regering waarom de markt deze risico’s niet zelf kan beheersen.

Asks what specific cases allow supervisors to apply the capital framework to group firms, the basis for the discretionary power, and a fuller justification for not following the Council of State's advice on fund managers.
These members therefore ask the government for a fuller justification of the decision not to follow this advice.
Deze leden vragen de regering dan ook om een uitgebreidere onderbouwing van het besluit om aan dit advies geen gehoor te geven.

Asks whether the extension to fund managers is a non-essential national addition, requests an overview of member-state options on remuneration, and asks how the 10% threshold follows from the directive given the Council of State's objection.
These members also ask how the government derives from the directive its choice to lower the variable pay threshold from 25 to 10 percent.
Tevens vragen deze leden hoe de regering de gemaakte keuze omtrent het verlagen van de drempel van een variabele beloning van maximaal 25 procent naar maximaal 10% afleidt uit de richtlijn.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on 16 December 2020, that the bill implementing the EU investment firm prudential directive and regulation should drop the provision extending the prudential regime to fund managers providing investment services, and should justify or drop the lower bonus-exemption threshold for staff and clarify the prudential/conduct split in the bedrijfsvoering rules. In its reply of 24 March 2021 the Minister of Finance largely maintained the bill, adding justification and clarifications to the explanatory memorandum while rejecting the claim that the fund-manager provision is new national policy.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that extending the prudential regime to fund managers providing investment services goes beyond EU implementation and should be dropped, while the minister maintains the long-standing equalisation as policy-neutral.

The Afdeling objects that the lower 10% variable-pay threshold for staff misapplies the member-state option and is insufficiently justified, while the minister defends it and adds explanation in the memorandum.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum clarify how conduct and prudential business-conduct requirements are split between DNB and the AFM, and the minister added clarifying text.

35792.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (sixth supplementary budget), adding €401 million in commitments and expenditure for a voucher credit facility and €1.0 million for RVO TOGS appeals handling and a sample audit. It sets the budget unit in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 6 April 2021.

35819.s: The bill implements EU anti-money-laundering directive rules by creating a public-facing register of ultimate beneficial owners of trusts and similar legal arrangements, administered by the Chamber of Commerce. It obliges trustees to register and update information, sets access limits for the FIU and competent authorities, and provides administrative and criminal enforcement against non-compliance.
35819.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by stating that the detailed rules are better set in a general administrative order than in statute and that they are needed for implementation and workability of the registration obligation.
q: Since these rules are of a high level of detail, laying them down in a general administrative order is considered more appropriate than at statute level.
Daar deze regels van een hoog detailniveau hebben, wordt vastlegging in een algemene maatregel van bestuur passender geacht dan op wetsniveau.
d: classes of economic interest in trust
categories of documents evidencing economic interest
designation of competent authorities with full access
retention period for requester personal data
shielding of beneficial owner data by ministerial decision
registration decision by Minister of Finance
manner of providing insight into access counts
management, form and technical set-up of register
mandate to Chamber of Commerce chair to decide and litigate
p: The Minister of Finance decides on shielding beneficial owner data from public view on request, under criteria left to a general administrative order, with appeal available under the General Administrative Law Act.
Decision-making and litigation powers are mandated from the Minister to the Chamber of Commerce chair, with a sub-mandate possible to staff.

parties: Asks about the authorisation system for restricted data, risk of leaks, and the consequences of other member states not applying the same options.
What will this authorisation system look like? How will the risks of leaking data of persons facing a concrete or foreseeable threat, minors and persons lacking legal capacity be mitigated?

Hoe zal dit autorisatiesysteem eruitzien? Hoe worden hierbij de risico's op het lekken van gegevens van personen waarbij sprake is van een concrete of voorstelbare dreiging, minderjarigen en personen die handelingsonbekwaam zijn gemitigeerd?
Stresses that proportionality must be kept in mind and questions how authorities access the register and whether unnecessary look-ups can be sanctioned.
They believe this law can contribute to combating money laundering and terrorist financing, but that proportionality must be kept in mind at all times.

Zij menen dat deze wet een bijdrage kan leveren aan de bestrijding van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering, maar dat wel te allen tijde de proportionaliteit in het achterhoofd gehouden dient te worden.
Asks how commercial use of public beneficial-owner data will be prevented and who can demonstrate a legitimate interest.
The PVV members want to know how it will be prevented that this information is used for commercial purposes.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten hoe voorkomen zal worden dat deze informatie gebruikt zal worden voor commerciële doeleinden.
Doubts the added value of a fully public register given privacy and misuse risks, and wants more justification for not using the member-state option to restrict access.
The added value of a register accessible to everyone has not yet been demonstrated for the CDA members.
De meerwaarde van een voor eenieder toegankelijk centraal register blijft echter nog niet aangetoond voor de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Questions the effectiveness of the UBO register compared with a shareholder register and asks about privacy safeguards such as address data.
To what extent can it be ensured that information that should not be public is not made public?
In hoeverre kan worden geborgd dat informatie die niet openbaar zou moeten zijn, dat ook niet wordt?
Supports the bill as a step forward but asks what legitimate interest means and whether journalists can access restricted data.
Can the government guarantee that (investigative) journalists have access to the register, including to data that has been shielded for privacy reasons?
Kan de regering garanderen dat (onderzoeks)journalisten toegang hebben tot het register, ook met betrekking tot gegevens die zijn afgeschermd bijvoorbeeld uit privacyoverwegingen?
Raises doubts about enforceability and verification of data, citing the Tax Authority's implementation assessment that the bill is fraud-sensitive.
The GroenLinks members have critical questions about the enforceability of this bill.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks hebben kritische vragen over de handhaafbaarheid van onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Highlights pending court cases on privacy and disproportionality of the UBO register and asks whether publication should await the rulings.
They therefore ask the government whether it has considered keeping the trust register closed for now or waiting to implement it pending the rulings.
Zij vragen de regering daarom of is overwogen om het trustregister voorlopig besloten te houden of te wachten met implementatie, in afwachting van de uitspraken.
Asks whether UBOs can learn who consulted their data and how the privacy impact of a public register was weighed against costs.

To what extent does the broad access to information, such as the nature and extent of the interest, the citizen service number of UBOs and other personal information infringe on the privacy of those involved?
In hoeverre maakt de ruime toegang tot informatie, zoals aard en omvang van het belang, het Burgerservicenummer van UBO's en andere persoonlijke informatie inbreuk op de privacy van betrokkenen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Implementation Act for registering ultimate beneficial owners of trusts, raising concerns about the limited shielding of data in risky situations and about how the accuracy of trustee-supplied data is verified. The government's reply, the nader rapport, states that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on shielding, verification mechanisms, and the role of the trust register manager, and that the bill was adjusted in several places.
concerns: The Council considered the shielding regime too narrow because the directive allows protection for risks of fraud, blackmail or intimidation, not only where police protection is needed; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but kept the police-protection criterion.

The Council questioned whether the register is sufficiently accurate because the state does not verify trustee-supplied data at intake and sanctions apply only after other evidence emerges; the government pointed to documentary proof requirements, automated checks, reporting duties and sanctions, and expanded the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
The Council asked for the explanatory memorandum to be self-contained on shielding, which the government addressed by supplementing paragraph 3.5.3.

35828.s: The bill approves in Dutch law three 2020 treaties enabling direct Eurostar train services from the Netherlands to London with juxtaposed UK and Dutch border controls at Amsterdam and Rotterdam stations. It also amends the Code of Criminal Procedure so that foreign officials may arrest persons in the Netherlands outside cases of hot pursuit, with those arrested to be brought directly before a Dutch prosecutor.
35828.j: The memorandum justifies the new arrest powers as necessary for the treaty's juxtaposed controls and notes that the treaties require an implementing legal basis for these powers.
q: A treaty basis is however required for this form of arrest.
Wel wordt een verdragsbasis vereist voor deze vorm van aanhouding vereist.
p: Foreign officials may arrest persons in the Netherlands outside hot-pursuit cases, limited to treaty-specified offences and requiring the person be brought directly before a Dutch prosecutor.
Foreign public officials may continue an on-board arrest on Dutch territory, to be handed over promptly to Dutch investigators and detained at most six hours.

parties: The VVD has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions about it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hier verder geen vragen over.

The CDA asks whether the treaties can be implemented in practice and whether Dutch consent is required for each on-board train inspection by another state, which bears on oversight of foreign enforcement on Dutch territory.
These members ask the government to clarify whether, for example, the Netherlands must consent each time to an inspection action by another country on our territory.
Deze leden vragen de regering te verduidelijken of bijvoorbeeld Nederland per keer moet instemmen met een controleactie van een ander land op ons grondgebied.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive remarks on the bill approving two treaties on cross-channel rail traffic and border controls with the United Kingdom and advised submitting it to the House. The government's reply notes only that a Tractatenblad reference was added to article 1, paragraph 2.

35850-X.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (first supplementary budget), raising spending and commitment appropriations for the armed services and central departmental lines, with a retroactive effective date of 1 June 2021. It is a budgetary adjustment that delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power away from oversight bodies.
q: If services or goods must be procured in addition to or deviating from regular operations, or costs are incurred, and these have a direct relation to COVID-19, they must be traceable immediately and afterwards.

Indien diensten of goederen aanvullend of afwijkend op de reguliere bedrijfsvoering moeten worden aangeschaft of kosten worden gemaakt en deze een directe relatie met COVID-19 hebben, moeten deze meteen en achteraf traceerbaar zijn.

35864.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (Chapter XII), adding funds for COVID-19 testing for travel in a fifth incidental supplementary budget. It sets budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2021.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for 2021 (Fifth incidental supplementary budget on COVID testing for travel)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2021 (Vijfde incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake COVID-testen reizen)

35873.s: The bill repeals the employment-related investment allowance (BIK) in the income tax act, the payroll tax act and the Belastingplan 2021, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2021, because of uncertainty over EU state aid rules. The explanatory memorandum argues that the allowance may be incompatible with EU law and that businesses cannot rely on legitimate expectations.
35873.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal by the uncertain outcome of EU state aid review and the risk that businesses would have to repay allowances with interest.
q: In summary, the chance of a positive Commission assessment of the BIK in its current form is highly uncertain, and a final ruling by the European court will take years.
Samengevat is de kans op een positief oordeel van de Commissie over de BIK in zijn huidige vorm hoogst onzeker en zal een uiteindelijk oordeel van de Europese rechter jaren op zich laten wachten.

parties: Asks what analysis the government made following the Raad van State advice on the bill.
The VVD members ask what analysis the government made following the Council of State's advice on the bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke analyse de regering heeft gemaakt naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether a national route exists for firms to successfully invoke legitimate expectations despite EU rules.
These members ask whether a national route is possible for entrepreneurs to successfully invoke 'legitimate expectations'.
Deze leden vragen of er een nationale route mogelijk is voor ondernemers om succesvol een beroep te doen op «opgewekt vertrouwen».
Questions the cabinet's unilateral use of unspent budget for the Awf reduction without parliamentary consent or supplementary budget.

Can the government explain on what basis the caretaker cabinet feels unilaterally entitled to use 2 billion euro of not-yet-released budget in advance, without the approval of the House of Representatives.

Kan de regering aan deze leden toelichten op grond waarvan het demissionaire kabinet zich eenzijdig gerechtigd voelt om 2 miljard euro nog niet vrijgevallen budget reeds op voorhand, zonder instemming van de Tweede Kamer
Objects that the alternative use of 2 billion euro was implemented by ministerial regulation without parliament's involvement or formal consent, and asks about accelerated legislation options.
This alternative use is already implemented from 1 August 2021 by ministerial regulation, without the House having been involved in the decision-making or formally consenting.

Deze alternatieve aanwending wordt door een ministeriële regeling reeds per 1 augustus 2021 uitgevoerd, zonder dat de Kamer bij de besluitvorming hierover betrokken is geweest of hiermee formeel heeft ingestemd
Asks about firms in the SME segment that may face problems from retroactive withdrawal and whether government will prevent or remedy these.
These members ask the government whether it has examined if there are SME firms that may run into problems as a result.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij heeft onderzocht of er bedrijven in het mkb-segment zijn die hierdoor mogelijk in problemen komen
Criticises the very careless legislative process, including absence of EU law review and late advice from the Commission.
The PvdA members further ask the government how it is possible that the legislative process could take place so incredibly carelessly.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering voorts hoe het mogelijk is dat het wetgevingstraject zo ongelooflijk onzorgvuldig plaats kon vinden.
Criticises the very sloppy policy and decision process and asks whether the cabinet gave the House less than two weeks to respond, questioning checks and balances.
Does the government think this is sufficient in light of the current debate on power and counterpower and the now caretaker status of the cabinet?
Is de regering van mening dat dit voldoende is in het licht van de huidige discussie over macht en tegenmacht en de inmiddels demissionaire status van het kabinet?
Asks the government to reflect on lessons learned on policy content and on procedure and implementation from the precautionary withdrawal.
These members ask the government to address lessons in terms of policy content and in terms of procedure and implementation.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarbij in te gaan op de lessen op beleidsinhoudelijk gebied en de lessen op het gebied van procedure en uitvoering.
Asks about the effects on innovation and whether all entrepreneurs get the same Awf reduction.
The Groep Van Haga members request the government to provide more insight into the effects of the bill on innovation.
De leden van de Groep Van Haga verzoeken de regering om meer inzicht te geven in de invloeden van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel op innovatie.
Understands the withdrawal but stresses that expectations created among entrepreneurs must be honoured and the freed budget should relieve SMEs.
Nevertheless these members wish to stress that sufficient justice must be done to the expectations that the original plan created among those entrepreneurs.
Toch wensen deze leden te benadrukken dat er voldoende recht moet worden gedaan aan de verwachtingen bij die ondernemers door het oorspronkelijke plan zijn gewekt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division gave an opinion on a bill amending the wage tax and premium reduction act and repealing the Baangerelateerde Investeringskorting, raising no remarks and advising submission to the House. The government's nader rapport thanks the Council and notes only minor editorial and technical improvements to the explanatory memorandum.

35891.s: The bill ratifies by statute article 5 of the Besluit benoemingsprocedure SER, which governs incompatibility of other functions with membership of the Social-Economic Council. It also replaces the post-adoption approval procedure in the Wet op de SER with a pre-submission (voorhang) procedure for future amendments.
35891.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural change because the post-adoption ratification procedure dates from 1950 and the voorhang procedure is now standard practice for parliamentary involvement in delegated rules.
q: With this in mind, the so-called heavy nahang procedure is replaced by a voorhang procedure.
Met het oog hierop wordt de zogenoemde zware nahangprocedure vervangen door een voorhangprocedure.
d: Artikel 6, eerste lid, Wet op de SER (referenced in memorandum)
incompatibility of SER membership with other work
Artikel 6, tweede lid, Wet op de SER (as amended by Article II)
SER appointment procedure general administrative order
p: Ratifies by statute an existing executive order on SER incompatibility rules, giving parliament a direct vote on it.
Replaces the post-adoption approval procedure with a pre-submission voorhang procedure, requiring the draft to be laid before parliament four weeks before it is made.

parties: Asks about the status of motion Tielen on giving self-employed people an equal position in the SER, possible legal obstacles, and the timeline for achieving this.
Can the government indicate by what date it expects self-employed people to actually be able to take an equal position in the polder, or in the Sociaal-Economische Raad?
Kan de regering aangeven op welke termijn zij verwacht dat zelfstandigen daadwerkelijk een gelijkwaardige positie in de polder, casu quo de Sociaal-Economische Raad in kunnen nemen?
Has no questions about the bill.
These aforementioned members have no questions about this bill.
Deze eerdergenoemde leden hebben geen vragen bij dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the change affects the States General's influence over SER appointments and whether parliament gains or loses influence.
Can the government indicate whether the States General will have more or less influence over the appointment procedure as a result?
Kan de regering aangeven of de Staten-Generaal hiermee meer of minder invloed op de benoemingsprocedure krijgen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill ratifying part of the SER appointment procedure decree and replacing the approval procedure with a pre-consultation procedure in the Sociaal-Economische Raad Act, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport confirms that the proposal gave no occasion for substantive comments and forwards the bill to parliament.

35918.s: The bill amends the Dutch Excise Duty Act and the VAT Act, and related laws, to implement three EU directives: the Horizontal Excise Directive 2020 (introducing certified consignor and consignee and automating intra-EU movements via EMCS), the revised alcohol excise directive 2020/1151 (changing the beer tax base to alcohol content), and the 2019 directive on defence efforts within the Union framework (exempting EU armed forces from VAT and excise). It also makes terminology changes and sets entry-into-force dates, mostly 1 January 2022, 1 July 2022, 1 January 2023 and 13 February 2023.
35918.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to fill in technical detail and to follow EU implementing and delegated acts still to be adopted by the European Commission.
q: Further rules may be set by ministerial regulation for the implementation of this article.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld ten behoeve van de uitvoering van dit artikel.
d: rules for determining alcohol content of beer
replacing GN-code dates with version dates
further rules for intra-EU movements of duty-paid goods
obligations for goods supplied for commercial purposes
duties of fiscal representative and how foreign consignors register
I, onderdeel NN (artikel 50h, derde lid; 50j, derde lid)
administration and control requirements for certified consignees and consignors
I, onderdeel NN (artikel 50i, derde lid; 50k, derde lid)
conditions for excise exemption for alcohol used in specified products
labelling, denaturing and further rules on exemptions
conditions for reduced rate for small alcohol producers

parties: Asks the government to justify with research the budget neutrality, cost reductions and fraud claims, and to share analyses with industry.
These members are critical of the measures that will hit small breweries hard and ask the government to reconsider the measures that particularly affect that sector.
Deze leden zijn kritisch ten aanzien van de maatregelen die kleine brouwerijen hard zullen treffen en vragen de regering om de maatregelen die specifiek die sector hard raken te heroverwegen.
Welcomes harmonisation but asks questions on competitiveness of small breweries and fraud amounts, and on the fiscal representative and delegated acts.
They do however worry about the competitive position of small breweries.
Zij maken zich wel zorgen over de concurrentiepositie van kleine brouwerijen.
Asks for competitiveness comparisons, the EY study and a test against the Comptabiliteitswet on efficiency.
The PVV members request the government to further test the bill against article 3.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet.
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering het wetsvoorstel nader te toetsen aan artikel 3.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet.
Supports simplification but seeks quantified effects on small, medium and large breweries before deciding.
These members have concerns about the effects of these measures on small breweries and therefore ask for further explanation.
Deze leden hebben zorgen over de effecten van deze maatregelen op kleine brouwerijen en vragen daarom nadere toelichting.
Doubts that the measure creates a level playing field and questions the choice of 7.49 euro over the EY figure of 7.12 euro.
Does the government really think that abolishing the reduced rate for small brewers leads to a more level playing field?
Denkt de regering werkelijk dat het schrappen van het verlaagde tarief voor kleine brouwers leidt tot een gelijker speelveld?
Supports the anti-fraud and simplification measures in principle but is critical of the abolition of the reduced rate for small brewers.
The PvdA members support these measures in broad outline.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen deze maatregelen op hoofdlijnen.
Asks why the government did not secure its preferred outcome on the defence exemption and whether lobbying strength shaped the policy.
Why did it not succeed? And why does the explanatory memorandum not state that the government would actually have preferred it differently?
Waarom is het niet gelukt? En waarom staat niet in de memorie van toelichting benoemd dat de regering het eigenlijk liever anders had gezien?
Supports the alcohol-content basis but raises the risk of cross-border shifting and the design of brewery certificates.
They note a tension between abolishing the low rate for small breweries on the one hand and obtaining a certificate as compensation on the other.
Zij constateren een spanning tussen enerzijds het afschaffen van het lage tarief voor kleine brouwerijen en anderzijds het ter compensatie verkrijgen van een certificaat.
Opposes harmonising excise across Europe and questions whether the 2 million euro gain outweighs the loss of entrepreneurship.
The Groep Van Haga wants to stimulate entrepreneurship and innovation, which often starts small with the necessary imperfections in the production process.
De Groep Van Haga wil ondernemerschap en innovatie stimuleren en dat begint vaak klein met de nodige imperfecties in het productieproces.
Argues the bill is not budget neutral and that the government consulted about small brewers without involving them, and questions whether lobbying strength should shape policy.
What stands out in particular is that there was talk about the small breweries but not with them, the BBB member observes.
Wat vooral opvalt is dat er óver de kleine brouwerijen is gepraat maar niet mét hen, zo stelt het lid van de BBB-fractie vast.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing excise directives (horizontal excise directive, alcohol excise directive, and defence VAT/excise directive) and raised no substantive objections, only redactional and technical remarks. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën replied in a nader rapport, adopting the drafting remarks and making minor changes such as adjusting the beer excise rate and a transitional date.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for numerous redactional and technical corrections to the bill, its explanatory memorandum and the transposition tables, which the government adopted.

35927.s: This Dutch tax bill (Belastingplan 2022) amends income, wage, corporate, transfer, car and environmental taxes, along with income-dependent benefit rules, mainly to implement purchasing-power measures and technical fiscal changes for 2022 onward. It adds some delegation-based and administrative provisions, including an indirect delegation to set further rules for walstroom and energy storage and a deferral of tax-withholding rules.
35927.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as technical implementation of tax rules and the need to fix rules for shore power and energy storage in line with the 2022 budget.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order to be established on the proposal of the Minister, conditions and restrictions will be set that an organisational unit operating an energy storage facility must meet.

Bij of krachtens op voordracht van Onze Minister vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur worden voorwaarden en beperkingen gesteld waaraan een organisatorische eenheid die een energieopslagfaciliteit exploiteert moet voldoen.
d: conditions for shore-power installations and metering equipment
Artikel XXII, onderdeel B (artikel 50, zevende lid Wbm)
conditions and restrictions for energy storage facility operators
Artikel VI, onderdeel C (artikel 31a, dertiende lid Wet LB 1964)
replacing the per-day home-working allowance amount at the start of each year
Artikel IX, onderdeel E (artikel 15, veertiende lid Wet Vpb 1969)
further rules for corporate tax collection in fiscal unities, including carry-forward of withholding taxes
Artikel XIV and XVII, XX (artikel 9 Wet BPM 1992)
annual indexation of car tax bracket amounts by 2.35 percent
correcting article references caused by overlapping amending laws in 2021
p: Artikel IX, onderdeel H (artikel 15ak en 15al Wet Vpb 1969)
The inspector may set carried-forward withholding-tax amounts without an appealable decision, limiting taxpayers' immediate legal remedies, though appeal is partly preserved at a later stage.
Artikel IX, onderdeel I (artikel 25a en 25b Wet Vpb 1969)
Withholding taxes may only be offset up to the amount of corporate tax due and the inspector may revise the carry-forward decision within a five-year window.

parties: Asks the government for effects, evaluations and control mechanisms on several measures, including how the Belastingdienst will check partner status and prevent misuse of the IACK.
Asks how signals from the Belastingdienst are followed up and how they enter government decision-making, and what the risks of the MIA under EU law are.

These members further ask how follow-up is given to signals from the Tax Authority, how these signals travel upward, and whether they are given a structured place in the government's decision-making process.

Deze leden vragen voorts op welke wijze opvolging wordt gegeven aan signalen vanuit de Belastingdienst, hoe deze signalen omhoog komen en of deze signalen op gestructureerde wijze een plek krijgen in het besluitvormingsproces van de regering.
Asks about enforceability and fraud-resistance of the IACK partner rule, flagged as red in the implementation test, and about the EU notification timing for the MIA.
The CDA members see in the implementation test that the proposed scheme is difficult to enforce and not fraud-resistant, and as a result contains two red flags.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zien in de uitvoeringstoets dat de voorgestelde regeling moeilijk handhaafbaar en niet-fraudebestendig is en als gevolg daarvan twee rode vlaggen bevat.
Criticises the government's limited income policy and housing choices, and asks for effects, timelines and whether the trust sector will be abolished, questioning the government's priorities.
As far as the PvdA members are concerned, these are not the right choices.
Wat betreft de leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn dit niet de juiste keuzes.
Urges human-scale handling when stopping or recovering tax benefits so that situations like the childcare-benefits scandal are not repeated, and asks how hardship is prevented.

However, the SP members ask the government to apply a human touch when stopping and possibly recovering tax benefits that were received in excess, and not to create again distressing situations such as in the childcare benefits scandal.

Evenwel vragen de leden van de SP-fractie de regering om bij het stopzetten en eventueel terugvorderen van teveel ontvangen belastingvoordeel de menselijke maat te hanteren en niet opnieuw schrijnende situaties te creëren zoals in het toeslagenschandaal.
Asks about the climate effects of the car-tax measures and the evaluation of the gebruikelijkloon scheme for innovative start-ups.
The GroenLinks members further ask the government to inform the House about the results of the evaluation of the gebruikelijkloon scheme.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen de regering voorts om de Kamer te informeren over de resultaten van de evaluatie van de gebruikelijkloonregeling.
Cites critical advice from the Register Belastingadviseurs on the IACK partner rule and asks the government to respond, while supporting the climate aims of the car measures.

The RB wonders whether the IACK, among other things in view of this but also because of income differences between single- and dual-earner households, could not better be abolished and merged into the labour tax credit?

Het RB vraagt zich af of de IACK onder andere met het oog hierop maar ook vanwege de inkomensverschillen tussen huishoudens met een- en tweeverdieners niet beter kan worden afgeschaft en opgaan in de arbeidskorting?
Asks about the budgetary effects of the MIA and the car-tax cap and the complexity and tax-deduction treatment of the home-working allowance.

Can the government confirm that because of the further proposed 128-day system, the complexity of the scheme is such that this proposal scores negatively on reducing administrative burden and on feasibility?

Kan de regering bevestigen dat vanwege het voorts voorgestelde systeem van 128 dagen, de complexiteit van de regeling zodanig is dat dit voorstel negatief scoort qua reductie administratieve lasten en qua doenvermogen?
Asks for budgetary and effect figures on the car-tax incentives, the home-working allowance and the temporary expansion of the free space in the werkkostenregeling.
Can the government tell the PVV members what the budgetary aspects are of a permanent increase in the free space?
Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven wat de budgettaire aspecten zijn van een permanente verhoging van de vrije ruimte?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2022 package, raising objections to the package's composition, the broad use of goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten, the stock option regime, the voorheffingenbeschikking, and the overdrachtsbelasting evaluation timing. The government's nader rapport accepts several points, removing two bills from the package and separating the stock option and delegation provisions, while defending other choices.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the Belastingplan package bundles measures without budgetary urgency; the government removed the Toeslagen and Douane bills from the package.

The Afdeling warned that goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten deviating from statute undermine the legality principle and parliament's role; the government accepts more restraint and will develop a framework.

The Afdeling found the stock option measure's effectiveness and purpose insufficiently substantiated and advised a standalone bill; the government separated the measure but gave limited further justification.
The Afdeling asked for a clearer and better bounded delegation basis for stock option situations; the government separated the delegation provisions into a separate bill.
The Afdeling asked justification for the complex voorheffingenbeschikking choice given IT capacity strain; the government added explanation of alternatives but kept the chosen approach.
The Afdeling asked that the overdrachtsbelasting evaluation be brought forward; the government explained data limits but committed to annual publication of monitoring data.
The Afdeling asked justification for removing the time limit in huurtoeslag recovery and its housing market effects; the government addressed this in the memorie van toelichting.

35945.s: The bill gives De Nederlandsche Bank the power to determine whether a non-significant bank or investment firm is failing or likely to fail, as required under the European resolution framework. It also amends the Bankruptcy Act so that interest claims are automatically filed and verified in bank bankruptcies and allows the curator to make interim payments with the supervising judge's permission.
35945.j: The memorandum justifies the new DNB power as required by the BRRD and SRMR framework, with the Commission's services advising that national supervisors be given this competence.
q: This proposal aims to do exactly that.
Dit voorstel strekt daartoe.
p: Gives DNB, the supervisory authority, the power to assess whether a non-significant bank is failing or likely to fail, a determination that triggers resolution.
Automatically files interest claims in bank bankruptcies and verifies non-secured interest pro memorie, reducing creditors' and the bankrupt party's active role.
Allows the curator to make interim payments on claims only with the supervising judge's consent and subject to stated conditions.

parties: The bill is clear to the VVD and raises no questions.
According to these members the bill is clear and raises no further questions.
Het wets voorstel is volgens deze leden duidelijk en roept verder geen vragen op.
Asks about the effects of giving DNB the power to determine failure, and whether the price effect claim rests on research.
Can the government explain whether it believes a change like the one proposed should be based on more research than a first impression?
Kan de regering toelichten of de regering van mening is dat een wijziging zoals die wordt voorgesteld op meer onderzoek gebaseerd moet zijn dan een eerste indruk?
Asks why DNB's power to judge non-viability of small banks was not formalised earlier and whether other member states do the same.

Regarding the first change, formally establishing that DNB is competent to determine when a small bank is no longer viable, the CDA members ask the government why this was not formally recorded earlier.

Ten aanzien van de eerste wijziging, het vastleggen dat de DNB bevoegd is vast te stellen wanneer een kleine bank niet meer levensvatbaar is, vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering waarom dit niet eerder formeel is vastgelegd.
Questions the government's ability to know when banks fail, the definition of the public interest, and whether the no-creditor-worse-off principle serves society.
These members ask the government to define the public interest within the framework of this law.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering vanuit het kader van deze wet het algemeen belang te definiëren.
Asks how the changes affect the balance between creditor types, including subordinated creditors and SMEs.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to explain further what the changes mean for the balance between different types of creditors.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om nader in te gaan op wat de wijzigingen betekenen voor de balans tussen verschillende soorten schuldeisers.
Asks whether the implementation has been tested against practice and whether it changes regulatory burden.
This member asks whether the government can explain further whether this implementation creates more or less regulatory burden.
Dit lid vraagt of de regering nader kan toelichten of deze implementatie voor meer of minder regeldruk zorgt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the government should better justify, and consult the European Commission and ECB on, a proposed power for DNB to determine that non-significant banks are failing or likely to fail, and should explain why public consultation was initially skipped. The Minister's reply states that consultation with Commission services and the ECB occurred, the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, and the bill was subsequently published for internet consultation.
concerns: The Council of State asked for justification that the EU framework (BRRD/SRM/SSM) does not already confer the failure-determination power on ECB or DNB, and for reporting of Commission and ECB consultation outcomes; the reply reports informal Commission advice and an ECB statement that it lacks competence, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Council of State asked for public consultation to be held or justified; the government then ran an internet consultation from 22 April to 3 June 2021 and explained the earlier omission.
The Council of State proposed a wording change in article I (3A:20A) to refer to the entities in article 7(3) of the SRM Regulation, which the government adopted as a redactional point.

35963.s: The bill extends the legal basis for processing data in the register of education participants, connecting private, foreign and international schools (B3/B4) to the register to improve truancy enforcement and reduce administrative burden. It also allows data sharing with higher education institutions, designated organisations, pension administrators and Belgian authorities, with some recipients designated by general administrative order (AMvB).
35963.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility, citing the register's shift to general administrative order specification, and by the Raad van State's advice to define criteria for designated organisations as narrowly as possible.
q: Organisations to be designated by general administrative order.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzen organisaties.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 23 WRO, lid 1 onder e en lid 12)
designating organisations entitled to receive base data for research
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 23 WRO, lid 5)
Minister decides by besluit on data provision to listed bodies
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 24b WRO, lid 2)
rules on data provision to Belgian supervisory authorities and designation of recipient bodies
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 24a WRO, lid 2)
rules on data provision to pension administrators and the data to be provided
p: Changes data provision to administrative bodies from mandatory to discretionary, allowing wider sharing of pupil data by the Minister.
Extends pupil data sharing to private organisations, with the Minister deciding on access, the designation of additional organisations left to AMvB, and conditions that can be attached and withdrawn.

parties: Asks how private organisations are selected for access to pupil data, how their careful handling is checked, and whether participants can opt out.
How does the government check that these organisations handle such data carefully?
Hoe controleert de regering dat deze organisaties zorgvuldig met dergelijke gegevens omgaan?
Asks for legal certainty and foreseeability, and whether organisations with structural access will be designated by law rather than AMvB.
They also ask whether the government, for legal certainty, foreseeability and privacy protection, will periodically designate by statute the organisations structurally given access by AMvB.](#)

Zij vragen tevens of de regering – vanuit het oogpunt van rechtszekerheid, voorzienbaarheid en privacybescherming – periodiek de bij AMvB 4 aangewezen organisaties die structureel toegang tot het register krijgen bij wet zal aanwijzen.
Accepts the proposed changes and has no further questions.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen nadere vragen.
Worried about pupil and student privacy, asks how the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens advice was handled and how government control over data is maintained.
They are worried about the privacy of pupils and students and have some further questions and remarks.
Zij maken zich zorgen over de privacy van leerlingen en studenten en hebben hierover nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen.
Welcome connecting private and foreign schools, but ask whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens was convinced by the government's proportionality and subsidiarity reasoning.
It seems valuable to them that private, foreign and international schools are also connected to the register of education participants
Het lijkt hun waardevol dat ook particuliere, buitenlandse en internationale scholen worden aangesloten op het register onderwijsdeelnemers
Ask for clarification of whether the 'bestuur' definition is used, which affects scope, and question the added value of the expanded data sharing.
These members ask the government to reflect on this and explain why the definition of bestuur from the law was not followed.
Deze leden vragen de regering hierop te reflecteren en aan te geven waarom niet is aangesloten bij de definitie van bestuur uit de wet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the criterion 'gewichtig maatschappelijk belang' for designating organisations to receive register data for education research is too vague and should be narrowed in the law, and that the government explain the timeline for connecting Caribbean Netherlands schools to the register. The government's nader rapport accepted restricting recipients to non-profit organisations, added named organisations and a designation basis via amvb, and expanded the memorie van toelichting on the Caribbean pilot.
concerns: The criterion 'gewichtig maatschappelijk belang' is too indeterminate in light of privacy and delegation requirements and should be narrowed in the law.
Disclosure of personal data to designated organisations must be clearly provided for by law to meet Article 8 ECHR, Articles 7-8 Charter and Article 10 Constitution requirements.
The delegation of regulatory power to designate organisations by amvb should be bounded as concretely and precisely as possible.
The explanatory memorandum should explain when and how the register will be connected to schools in Caribbean Netherlands, given the pilot results and the importance of early entry into force.

35972.s: The bill repeals the fourth paragraph of article 58ra of the Public Health Act, removing the works council's right of consent (instemmingsrecht) over deploying corona access certificates in vocational and higher education. This prepares for mandatory certificate use in education, to be enabled by an AMvB and implemented by ministerial regulation.
35972.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the worsening epidemiological situation and the need to deploy certificates quickly, with the works council's consent right deemed incompatible with mandatory use.
q: and with a view to that, to abolish the consent right of works councils of education institutions
met het oog daarop het instemmingsrecht van medezeggenschapsorganen van onderwijsinstellingen te schrappen
d: extend corona access certificate use to vocational and higher education
detailed rules on corona access certificate use in education
p: Removing the works council's consent right over certificate deployment in schools and colleges shifts a workplace check to the executive's chosen approach, while the memorandum points to proportionality and advice requirements as remaining safeguards.

parties: Asks how the Chamber will be involved in the AMvB and ministerial regulation and whether a shorter pre-consultation procedure is possible, and how necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity will be justified.
How is the Chamber involved in the AMvB and the ministerial regulation, and how can it still influence them, since much will be elaborated there?
Hoe wordt de Kamer betrokken bij de AMvB en de ministeriële regeling en hoe kan zij daar nog invloed op uitoefenen, omdat daarin veel nog uitgewerkt zal worden?
Asks for justification of subsidiarity and purpose of the certificate, and whether institutions retain discretion over online versus in-person teaching.
In what way is the subsidiarity of deploying the coronatoegangsbewijs weighed?
Op welke manier wordt de subsidiariteit van de inzet van het coronatoegangsbewijs gewogen?
Opposes removing co-determination consent, arguing that participation is essential for legitimacy and enforcement of such far-reaching measures.
Consent is indispensable for the support for such measures.
Instemming is onontbeerlijk voor het draagvlak van dergelijke maatregelen.
Asks why the government changed its position on trust in consultation with education institutions and whether the consultation period could be shortened instead of removed.
Does the government no longer trust cooperation with education?
Vertrouwt de regering niet meer in de samenwerking met het onderwijs?
Raises serious doubts about feasibility, proportionality and necessity, and asks whether students retain the right to education without vaccination or testing.
They still have serious doubts about the feasibility of the coronatoegangsbewijs in mbo and ho, and about the proportionality and the usefulness and necessity of the underlying proposal.
Zij hebben nog ernstige bedenken bij de uitvoerbaarheid van het coronatoegangsbewijs op het mbo en ho, en over de proportionaliteit en het nut en de noodzaak van het onderliggende voorstel.
Argues that removing the consent right hollows out procedural safeguards and due care that were deliberately built into the law.
Removing these requirements means that, as time passes and temporary legislation keeps running, procedural safeguards are stripped from the law to impose burdensome measures without resistance.

Het schrappen van deze eisen betekent dat met het verstrijken van de tijd en het alsmaar voortduren van een als tijdelijk gepresenteerde wetgeving procedurele zekerheden zonder pardon uit deze wet worden gesloopt om verzwarende maatregelen zonder weerstand te kunnen invoeren.
Questions whether the enabling law provides sufficient statutory basis for the pre-published AMvB, that the justification is inadequate, and that the purpose contradicts the law's aim.
These members believe it cannot therefore be assumed in advance that the legal framework provides sufficient basis for the pre-submitted decision.
Deze leden menen dat daarom niet op voorhand verondersteld kan worden dat het wettelijk kader voldoende grondslag biedt voor het voorgehangen besluit.
Objects in principle to denying students access to education based on vaccination status, citing right to education and risk of a two-tier system.
These members see the proposal as a step toward an infringement of the right to education and find the possible two-tier system and vaccination pressure extremely objectionable.
Deze leden zien het voorstel als een opmaat naar een inbreuk op het recht op onderwijs en achten de mogelijke veroorzaakte tweedeling en vaccinatiedwang uiterst kwalijk.
Calls the removal of co-determination rights unacceptable, argues the measure is ineffective and endangers health, and advises withdrawing the bill.
The BIJ1 member therefore considers it undesirable and unacceptable to withdraw the consent rights of the parties involved.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie acht het daarom onwenselijk en onacceptabel om het instemmingsrecht van betrokken partijen in te trekken.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill that removes the co-determination (medezeggenschap) consent right over COVID certificate use in vocational and higher education, which it could largely accept, but asked for the explanatory memorandum to clarify how staff and students will be involved. The government's reply states it has added a section on consultation with co-determination bodies and other parties, and has made minor redactional changes.
concerns: The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to elaborate on the manner and content of involvement of employees and students if the certificate is made mandatory by ministerial regulation, and the government added a consultation section.

35990.s: The bill allows children to take a combined surname made of both parents' surnames in a freely chosen order, extending parental name-choice options in Boek 1 and Boek 10 of the Civil Code and the Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba code. It also creates a legal choice-of-law basis for children with multiple non-Dutch nationalities and requires the minister to report on effects five years after entry into force.
35990.j: The memorandum justifies the new combined surname option by pointing to the expressed bond with both parents, problems faced by people with multiple nationalities, and EU free-movement case law.
q: A combined surname can express the bond with both parents.
Met een gecombineerde geslachtsnaam kan de verbondenheid met beide ouders tot uitdrukking worden gebracht.
d: entry into force by royal decree, possibly differentiated by article

parties: Asks about the position on the default surname rule, costs of a transitional regime, and international private law consequences.
The VVD members took note with interest of the amendments to provisions in Books 1 and 10 of the Civil Code concerning the choice of surname.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van de wijziging van enige bepalingen in Boek 1 en Boek 10 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek
Regrets the absence of a transitional regime with retroactive effect, asks for the scenario analysis requested by a motion, and argues the default rule is not gender neutral.
Expresses disapproval, questions the added value and possible conflict with the rule that a new surname must not already exist in the Netherlands, and raises stigmatisation concerns.
The CDA members took note with disapproval of this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Supports the bill but argues for a gender-neutral default surname rule rather than the father's name, and asks about changing names of existing children.
The PvdA members took note with approval of this bill.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het voorliggend wetsvoorstel.
Asks why no transitional regime is provided, whether the procedure fees can be lowered or waived, and whether registration can be done by one parent.
The SP members share this sentiment and ask the government why it chooses not to apply a transitional regime.
De leden van de SP-fractie delen dit sentiment en vragen de regering waarom zij ervoor kiest om geen overgangsregeling te hanteren
Asks about necessity, the basis for the 2/3 public support figure, the two-surname limit, and whether the regime should apply in Caribbean Netherlands by default.
These members have questions about the necessity and desirability of this proposal.
Genoemde leden hebben vragen over de noodzakelijkheid en de wenselijkheid van genoemd voorstel
Welcomes the bill but questions the retained default surname rule for its gender effects and asks for an evaluation including lawfulness and equality under CEDAW.
The Volt faction endorses parents' responsibility for name choice but also sees that retaining the default rule may create an unequal relationship between men and women.
De Volt-fractie onderschrijft de verantwoordelijkheid van ouders voor de naamkeuze, maar ziet tegelijkertijd ook dat door het handhaven van de vangnetnorm een ongelijke verhouding kan ontstaan
Questions the necessity of the bill, argues the child's interest and the stability and traceability of surnames are insufficiently weighed, and asks about the hyphen and EU name-inflection issues.
It is not clear to these members what the necessity would be for a generic flexibilisation and expansion of the statutory rules on surnames.
Het is deze leden niet duidelijk wat de noodzaak zou zijn voor een generieke flexibilisering en uitbreiding van de wettelijke regeling inzake geslachtsnamen.
Welcomes the bill but argues the retained default rule that the child takes the father's name is discriminatory on grounds of sex in equal cases.
There is therefore unequal treatment of equal cases, a textbook example of direct sex discrimination.
Er is dus sprake van ongelijke behandeling in gelijke gevallen, een schoolvoorbeeld van directe seksediscriminatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill introducing a combined surname (gecombineerde geslachtsnaam) in Book 1 and Book 10 of the Civil Code and in the Civil Code of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and found no remarks to make. The Minister for Legal Protection stated in the nader rapport that the Afdeling raised no reason for comments and asked that the bill be sent to the Tweede Kamer.

36089.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, adding a 698.25 million euro supplementary appropriation for gas storage fill measures and a value-increase scheme. It sets the amendment's effective date and states that figures are in thousands of euros.
36089.j: The memorandum justifies the 623.25 million euro needed for gas storage and EBN compensation as a budget adjustment, with spending falling automatically if prices develop normally.
q: Two measures require 623.25 million euros in 2022, of which 366 million for the subsidy scheme and 257.25 million for compensation to EBN.
Voor de twee maatregelen is € 623,25 mln nodig in 2022, waarvan € 366 mln voor de subsidieregeling en € 257,25 mln voor de vergoeding aan EBN.

36120-IX.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a first supplementary budget, changing expenditure, revenue and commitment figures in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes mainly by new policy on cash-payment supervision, the Ukrainian hryvnia exchange scheme and corrections following the Auditdienst Rijk review of the 2021 annual report.
36120-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to new policy, the Ukrainian hryvnia exchange scheme recommended by the European Commission, and corrections after the Auditdienst Rijk audit, without invoking any delegated power.
q: In line with the European Commission's Council recommendation, a scheme is being set up for Ukrainian displaced persons to exchange cash Ukrainian currency (hryvnia) for euros.
Conform de raadsaanbeveling van de Europese Commissie wordt er een regeling opgezet voor Oekraïense ontheemden om contante Oekraïense valuta (hryvnia's) om te kunnen wisselen voor euro's.

36179.s: The bill establishes a new independent administrative appeals body, the Beoordelingscommissie dopingzaken, to hear appeals against appealable decisions of the Dopingautoriteit as required by the WADA Code, so that appeals are decided by an institutionally and operationally independent body. It also sets out its composition, procedural rules, hearing and review framework, and transitional arrangements for pending cases.
36179.j: The memorandum justifies the new body and its appointment arrangements by the need to meet WADA Code requirements of institutional and operational independence quickly, and it treats the ministerial powers as safeguards for good decision-making.
q: This bill therefore aims to comply as soon as possible with the abovementioned WADA Code requirement that decisions of the Dopingautoriteit which the WADA Code makes appealable must be reviewed on appeal by a body operationally and institutionally independent of the Dopingautoriteit.

Dit wetsvoorstel heeft daarom als doel zo spoedig mogelijk te voldoen aan de eerdergenoemde eis uit de WAD-code houdende dat besluiten van de Dopingautoriteit waarvan de WAD-code bepaalt dat ze appellabel zijn, in beroep beoordeeld moeten worden door een commissie die operationeel en institutioneel onafhankelijk is van de Dopingautoriteit.
d: appointment, suspension and dismissal of expert panel members
rules on compensation for expert panel members
commission must observe WADA Code and international standards
p: The Minister appoints, suspends and dismisses the expert panel that decides appeals, giving the executive a role in staffing the appeal body, though removal is limited to incapacity or serious personal grounds.
Appeals do not suspend the contested decision unless the Beoordelingscommissie decides otherwise, which is a standard administrative-law rule adapted to the WADA Code.

parties: Worried that the bill's legal feasibility and enforceability are under pressure given the Raad van State's serious objections, and asks what the consequences are if the bill proceeds unchanged.
The VVD members find it worrying to read that the Council of State's advisory division has serious objections to the proposal.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het zorgelijk te lezen dat de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State ernstige bezwaren heeft tegen het voorstel.

Finds it worrying that the bill follows a process the Raad van State considers unsuitable under the Awb, and asks why the broader review requested by motion Westerveld was not pursued and whether the Raad van State should re-advise.
The D66 members find it worrying that this bill seems to opt for a process that, in the view of the Council of State, is not suitable within the framework of the General Administrative Law Act (Awb).

De leden van de D66-fractie vinden het zorgelijk dat er met dit wetsvoorstel gekozen lijkt te zijn voor een proces dat naar oordeel van de Raad van State niet passend is in het kader van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb).

Asks whether appeal to the ordinary administrative court already suffices for independence, why a separate zbo is proportionate for very few cases, and what the outcome of consultation with the Dopingautoriteit on non-compliance was.
Both the Council of State and the government itself state that the current possibility of appeal to the administrative court already guarantees the independence of an appeal procedure.

Zowel de Raad van State als de regering zelf geven aan van mening te zijn dat met de huidige mogelijkheid van beroep bij de bestuursrechter onafhankelijkheid van een beroepsprocedure al gegarandeerd is.

Asks what concrete independence requirements and selection criteria apply to the chair, what quality safeguards exist beyond ministerial control, and how privacy, information security and the rights of amateur athletes without legal support are protected.
They ask the government, however, which concrete requirements will be set for the chair to guarantee his or her independence.
Zij vragen de regering echter welke eisen concreet gesteld zullen worden aan de voorzitter om diens onafhankelijkheid te garanderen.
Supports the amendment in principle but stresses transparency, the composition of the Beoordelingscommissie and the ability to exercise control over its functioning.
In general, the BBB member can therefore support this amendment of the law.
In zijn algemeenheid kan het lid van de BBB-fractie deze wetswijziging dan ook steunen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft law creating an independent Beoordelingscommissie dopingzaken as a zbo to hear appeals against Dopingautoriteit decisions, concluding that the proposal was a form of administrative appeal incompatible with the Awb and that it could not be advised positively (dictum D). The minister's nader rapport accepts the Awb-qualification and largely rewrites the bill, removing procedural rules duplicating the Awb, but maintains the zbo as necessary for WAD-code compliance and for the data-processing legal basis.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the doping decisions are Awb-besluiten, not private-law acts, so the Awb framework governs and the proposal must be assessed under it.

Creating an independent body that hears objections against the Dopingautoriteit amounts to administrative appeal, which conflicts with the Awb's main system of objection before the same authority followed by judicial appeal.
The necessity of establishing a zbo must be justified with a thorough exploration of alternatives, which the explanatory memorandum does not provide adequately.
Procedural rules copied from Awb chapters 6.2 and 7.2 should be removed to preserve unity of legislation.
Data processing requires a public-law legal basis because consent and contract are not freely given; the Afdeling questioned excluding the legitimate-interest basis, which the government explained.

36197.s: The bill repeals the coal plant production limit early, moving its end date to the day after publication with retroactive effect to 21 June 2022, and allows the government to sub-delegate detailed rules for the coal workers fund. It also makes three technical corrections to the Coal Ban Act concerning CO2 measurement and transitional provisions.
36197.j: The memorandum justifies early repeal by the need to avoid higher crisis levels later amid gas supply risks from developments in Ukraine, and justifies sub-delegation by the difficulty of predicting when coal plants will close.
q: Repealing the production limit is proposed to avoid, as far as possible, having to declare higher crisis levels at a later time.
Het intrekken van de productiebeperking wordt voorgesteld om zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen dat op een later moment hogere crisisniveaus moeten worden afgekondigd.
d: rules for coal workers fund, allowing sub-delegation by government
p: Ends the coal production limit and its enforcement by the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit before its original date, removing a binding constraint on electricity producers and the supervisory body's enforcement role.

parties: Asks how much gas the measure saved, and whether the government reflects on its security-of-supply assessment and the risks of removing capacity.
The VVD members are critical of the way the Dutch government assesses security of supply.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn kritisch op de manier waarop de Nederlandse regering de leveringszekerheid toetst.
Asks about the legitimacy of compensation claims, the framework for future closure decisions, and the effect of profit margins and environmental damage on compensation.
The SP members ask whether an appeal to the general interest sufficiently outweighs the compensation for closing coal plants.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of een beroep op algemeen belang voldoende boven de nadeelcompensatie voor sluiting van kolencentrales staat.
Argue the withdrawal is disproportionate to the climate objective set by the Urgenda ruling, and worry that retroactive withdrawal creates an undesirable precedent for climate policy.
These members fear this course of action creates an undesirable precedent for future situations and could make climate policy uncertain.
Deze leden vrezen dat deze gang van zaken een onwenselijk precedent schept voor toekomstige situaties en zo klimaatbeleid onzeker kan maken.
Says the government ignores the court's reduction order (Urgenda) and that the gas crisis gives no excuse to reverse the cap; questions how the extra emissions will be compensated.
The gas crisis gives the government no excuse to set aside the court's reduction order and reverse the production cap on coal plants.
De gascrisis biedt de regering geen enkel excuus om het reductiebevel van de rechter naast haar neer te leggen en de productiebeperking voor kolencentrales weer terug te draaien.
Supports keeping coal plants open for security of supply and criticises climate-driven CO2 reduction policy, asking the government to keep the withdrawal permanent.
The PVV members ask whether the government agrees that we cannot do without coal.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering de conclusie deelt dat wij niet zonder kolen kunnen.
Asks how compensation claims will be affected, whether the government can engage owners on long-term perspectives, and how extra emissions fit long-term climate policy.
They ask the government to clarify the effect of withdrawing the production cap on the requested amount of compensation.
Zij vragen de regering om te verduidelijken wat het effect van het intrekken van de productiebeperking is op het aangevraagde bedrag aan nadeelcompensatie.
Understands the withdrawal given reliance on one gas supplier, but judges the original cap unwise and asks how the extra emissions will be compensated under the Urgenda ruling.
These members also ask how the extra emissions of greenhouse gases will be compensated.
Deze leden vragen zich daarnaast af op welke manier de extra uitstoot van broeikasgassen zal worden gecompenseerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the coal phase-out act to end the production limit early, adjust the coal fund delegation and make three implementation fixes, and raised no remarks. The Minister for Climate and Energy's reply forwards the advice and confirms the bill will be submitted to the Tweede Kamer without substantive changes.

36269.s: The bill replaces the designation procedure for special mopeds (bijzondere bromfietsen) with a type-approval procedure administered by the RDW, and creates the statutory basis for a future light electric vehicle (LEV) framework, including possible registration and licence requirements to be set later by general administrative order. Transitional rules keep existing designations in force for a limited period and phase out the old Chapter IIA.
36269.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set later LEV rules flexibly and to draw the line between light and heavy pedal-assisted bicycles on technical criteria, with the voorhang procedure giving Parliament a say.
q: For that reason the delegation power is proposed so that the line between light and heavy pedal-assisted bicycles can be set further by general administrative order.
Daarom wordt de delegatiemogelijkheid voorgesteld om de afbakening tussen lichte en zware fietsen met trapondersteuning bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nader te kunnen vaststellen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (Artikel 1a, tweede lid)
characteristics of pedal-assisted bicycles excluded from LEV rules
Artikel I, onderdeel G (Artikel 37, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 1°)
categories of light electric vehicles exempt from registration plate requirement
Artikel I, onderdeel H (Artikel 48, eerste lid, onderdeel b, en vijfde lid)
categories of light electric vehicles subject to minimum age of sixteen for registration in the vehicle register
Artikel I, onderdeel I (Artikel 108, eerste lid, onderdeel a)
light electric vehicles designated for driving licence exemption
Artikel I, onderdeel P (Artikel 186f, vierde lid)
rules on applying for first registration and ownership transfer of pre-existing special mopeds
p: The Minister's designation power for special mopeds is replaced by RDW type approval, moving the decision to an independent agency but leaving designation of earlier vehicles as an exception to ordinary approval rules.
Artikel I, onderdeel P (Artikel 186f, eerste–derde lid)
Transitional provisions exempt special mopeds placed on the market before entry into force from approval, type-compliance and registration requirements for a limited period.

parties: Asks which vehicles fall under the new framework, the impact on road safety and nuisance of approved vehicles, and how independence and expertise are guaranteed in practice.
The VVD members read that safeguarding independence is an important principle when admitting new vehicles.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat het borgen van de onafhankelijkheid een belangrijk principe is bij het toelaten van nieuwe voertuigen.
